ruby: います。アドヴァイタ・ヴェーダーンタは、この
cards.tipJa: 「境界・輪郭がぼやける」の形で、はっきりしていたものが曖昧になる。
cards.enTarget: They say that as you continue meditating, there are moments when the boundary between self and world gradually blurs.

words.defJa: 疑いもなくそうだと思うさま

cards.ja: 中世の人々は、てっきり地球は平らだと信じていたのだろう、と私たちは思いこみがちである。しかし、紀元前三世紀のエラトステネスは、二つの都市で測った影の角度の違いをもとに、地球の大きさをほぼ正確に見積もっていた。中世の学者たちも、大地が球であることは疑わなかったのである。確かな根拠のない思いこみこそが、歴史を実際より単純な物語に変えてしまう。歴史の常識を疑うことは、学びの出発点である。
cards.en: We tend to assume that people in the Middle Ages surely believed the earth was flat. Yet Eratosthenes, in the third century BC, estimated the size of the earth almost accurately from the difference in the angle of shadows measured in two cities. Medieval scholars too did not doubt that the earth is a sphere. It is assumptions without firm grounds that turn history into a simpler story than it really was. Doubting what passes for common knowledge in history is the starting point of learning.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: いこみがちである。しかし、
cards.tipJa: 「てっきり〜と思った」の形で、あとで外れた確信を表す。
cards.enTarget: We tend to assume that people in the Middle Ages surely believed the earth was flat.

words.defJa: さわやかで気持ちがよい

cards.ja: 朝の五時に起きて、まだ人のいない公園を歩くと、頭の中のもやが晴れていくのがわかります。空気は冷たく、鳥の声だけが響き、街が動き出す前の澄んだ静けさに包まれます。そんなすがすがしい時間に考えごとをすると、昨夜まで難問だったことが、意外にすんなり整理されるのです。これは気分転換というより、頭の整理そのものだと私は感じています。夜に考えて行き詰まった問題こそ、朝に持ち越してみる価値があります。
cards.en: If you get up at five in the morning and walk through a park where no one is about yet, you can feel the fog in your head clearing. The air is cold, only birdsong rings out, and you are wrapped in the clear stillness before the city starts moving. If you think things over in such a refreshing hour, what was a hard problem last night gets sorted out surprisingly smoothly. I feel this is less a change of mood than the very tidying of the mind. A problem you got stuck on at night is exactly the kind worth carrying over to the morning.

cards.tipJa: 朝の空気や気分に使い、「すがすがしい朝・気分」の形が多い。
cards.enTarget: If you think things over in such a refreshing hour, what was a hard problem last night gets sorted out surprisingly smoothly.

words.defJa: 細部まで妥協せず執着する

cards.ja: 半導体の世界で、台湾のTSMCは、回路の微細化に徹底してこだわる企業として知られています。最先端の工場では、ナノメートル単位の精度が求められ、ごくわずかな誤差が製品全体の歩留まりを左右します。だからこそ、各国の企業は、少しでも早く最新の生産ラインを確保しようと競っているのです。細部に妥協しない姿勢が、そのまま国の産業力に直結する時代になったと言えるでしょう。
cards.en: In the world of semiconductors, Taiwan's TSMC is known as a company that is thoroughly particular about shrinking its circuits. At cutting-edge factories, precision on the scale of nanometers is required, and the slightest error affects the yield of the whole product. That is exactly why companies in many countries are competing to secure the newest production lines even a little sooner. We can say we have entered an age in which an attitude of never compromising on details connects directly to a nation's industrial strength.

cards.enTarget: In the world of semiconductors, Taiwan's TSMC is known as a company that is thoroughly particular about shrinking its circuits.

words.defJa: 態度や言葉がはっきりしたさま

cards.ja: ブッダは、答えるべきでない問いは、きっぱり退けたと伝えられています。たとえば「世界は永遠か」といった形而上学的な問いです。彼はこれを毒矢のたとえで説明しました。毒矢で射られた人が、矢を放った者の素性を知ってからでないと矢を抜かせないと言うなら、その前に命が尽きてしまうでしょう。肝心なのは、答えの出ない議論に時間を使うことではなく、いま目の前の苦しみを取り除くことだったのです。
cards.en: It is said that the Buddha flatly set aside questions that should not be answered. One example is a metaphysical question such as whether the world is eternal. He explained this with the parable of the poisoned arrow. If a man shot with a poisoned arrow says he will not let it be pulled out until he knows who fired it, he will be dead before then. What mattered was not spending time on endless debate but removing the suffering right in front of him.

words.defJa: 力強く頼もしい

cards.ja: 最近のロボットって、昔の想像よりずっとたくましいと思いませんか。二足歩行で階段を上るし、転んでも自分で起き上がるじゃないですか。しかも、動きの学習はAIがやっているらしくて、人が細かく教えなくても、失敗を繰り返しながら猛烈な勢いで覚えていくんですよ。ちょっと怖いけど、あの粘り強さを見ていると、応援せずにはいられません。あの姿が、人間の仕事を奪うのか、それとも助けてくれるのかは、まだ誰にもわかりません。
cards.en: Don't you think recent robots are far more sturdy than we used to imagine? They climb stairs on two legs, and even when they fall they get up by themselves, right? On top of that, apparently AI handles the learning of movement, so even without people teaching them in detail, they learn at a fierce pace while repeating failures. It is a little scary, but watching that persistence, I can't help rooting for them. Whether that figure will take away human jobs or help us, nobody can yet say.

words.meaning: as if, with an air of
words.defJa: いかにもそれらしいさま

cards.ja: 人は、知らないことを聞かれると、さも知っているかのように答えてしまうことがあります。心理学では、これを自分の無知を隠そうとする防衛反応のひとつとして説明します。ところが、知ったかぶりを続けていると、学ぶ機会そのものがやせ細っていきます。「それはわかりません」と素直に言える柔軟さのある人ほど、実は成長が早いのです。私自身、会議でうなずいたあと、あわてて調べ直した経験が何度もあります。
cards.en: When asked about something they do not know, people sometimes answer as if they knew it perfectly well. Psychology explains this as one kind of defensive reaction to hide one's own ignorance. But if you keep pretending to know, the very chance to learn grows thin. Those with the flexibility to say honestly, I don't know, are in fact the ones who grow fastest. I myself have often nodded in a meeting and then scrambled to look things up again.

words.meaning: to get complicated, to take a turn for the worse
words.defJa: 物事が複雑になり悪化する

cards.ja: 第一次世界大戦は、サラエボでの暗殺事件から始まった、とよく説明されます。ところが実際には、バルカン半島をめぐる列強の対立が長年こじれていて、同盟の網が小さな事件を大戦へと広げてしまいました。猛烈な軍拡競争も不信を深め、各国は動員の準備を進めざるを得なくなったのです。きっかけは小さくても、背景にある不信は一夜にして消えるものではありません。外交の教訓は、小さな不信を放置しないことにあります。
cards.en: The First World War is often explained as having begun with an assassination in Sarajevo. In reality, though, the rivalry among the great powers over the Balkans had long been tangled, and the web of alliances spread a small incident into a great war. A fierce arms race also deepened the distrust, and each country had no choice but to press ahead with preparations to mobilize. Even if the trigger is small, the distrust behind it does not vanish overnight. The lesson for diplomacy is not to leave small distrusts unattended.

cards.enTarget: In reality, though, the rivalry among the great powers over the Balkans had long been tangled, and the web of alliances spread a small incident into a great war.

words.defJa: 柔らかく弾力があるさま

cards.ja: ロボット工学の分野で、しなやかに動く手の開発が進んでいる。従来の産業用ロボットは硬い金属の部品で作られていたため、卵のように壊れやすい物をつかむには不向きだった。そこで研究者たちは、柔軟な素材と人工筋肉を組み合わせ、人の指に近い動きの再現を目指している。とはいえ、触覚をもとに力加減を判断するAIの精度には、なお課題が残るとされる。実用化にはなお時間がかかるが、介護や調理の現場からの期待は大きい。
cards.en: In robotics, development of hands that move supplely is progressing. Conventional industrial robots were built from hard metal parts, so they were ill suited to grasping fragile things like eggs. Researchers are therefore combining pliable materials with artificial muscles, aiming to reproduce movement close to that of human fingers. That said, challenges are still said to remain in the accuracy of AI that judges how much force to use from the sense of touch. Practical use will still take time, but expectations from nursing care and cooking settings are high.

cards.tipJa: 「しなやかに動く」のように、柔らかさと強さを兼ねた動きや体を表す。
cards.enTarget: In robotics, development of hands that move supplely is progressing.

words.defJa: 苦労せず簡単にできる

cards.ja: 専門用語を並べて話すのは、案外たやすいものです。本当に難しいのは、同じ内容を中学生にもわかる言葉に置き換えることです。たとえば半導体を「電気の流れを調節する小さな門番」と言えば、予備知識のない人にも情景が浮かびます。そのためには、自分がその仕組みを根っこから理解し、柔軟に言い換えられなければなりません。話し方を磨くとは、結局、考えを磨くことにほかならないのです。
cards.en: Stringing together technical terms is surprisingly easy. What is truly hard is to put the same content into words even a middle schooler can follow. If you call a semiconductor a small gatekeeper that regulates the flow of electricity, a picture forms even for someone with no background. For that, you must understand the mechanism from the roots and be able to rephrase it flexibly. Polishing how you speak is, in the end, nothing other than polishing how you think.

words.defJa: 粘り強くなかなか屈しない

cards.ja: 恥ずかしい失敗の記憶は何年たってもしぶとく残るのに、覚えたい単語は一週間もすれば消えてしまいます。これは、脳が感情の動いた出来事を優先して保存するためだと言われます。ならば、単語にも感情を結びつけてやればいいのです。好きな歌の歌詞や、旅先で聞いた思いがけない一言と一緒に、そのときの場面ごと覚えるに限ります。ただ同じカードを何度も繰り返すだけでは、時間を浪費しがちです。
cards.en: The memory of an embarrassing failure, even years later, lingers stubbornly, yet a word you want to learn vanishes within a week. This is said to be because the brain preferentially stores events that stirred emotion. In that case, you only need to tie emotion to words as well. Nothing beats learning a word along with its scene, together with a favorite song lyric or an unexpected phrase heard on a trip. Merely repeating the same flashcard over and over tends to waste time.

words.defJa: 穏やかでのんびりしたさま

cards.ja: 話し方教室で元局アナの講師がまず勧めるのは、のどかな景色を思い浮かべながら声を出すことです。広い草原や、静かな浜辺で波が寄せる様子を頭に描くと、肩の力が抜け、声が自然に低くやわらかくなるといいます。緊張しているときの声は、のどが締まって高くなりがちです。だからこそ、人前に立つに際して、心のなかに穏やかな場所を一つ用意しておくとよいのです。これは、緊張を緩和する、いちばん手軽な準備運動です。
cards.en: The first thing the instructor, a former station announcer, recommends at a speaking class is to produce your voice while picturing a tranquil landscape. When you imagine a broad meadow or waves rolling in on a quiet beach, the tension leaves your shoulders and your voice, they say, naturally becomes lower and softer. A nervous voice tends to rise because the throat tightens. That is exactly why, when you stand before people, it is good to prepare one calm place in your mind. This is the easiest warm-up for easing tension.

words.defJa: 生まれて一年目の年齢

cards.ja: 数え年の世界では、生まれたその日に一歳になる。数え年では年齢を元日に一括して加えるため、大みそかに生まれた子が翌日には二歳になる計算だった。母の胎内にいた月日も人生の一部と見なす、この考え方は東アジアに広く共有されていた。満年齢への切り替えを法律が促したのは明治三十五年だが、民間では戦後に至るまで数え年が生き続けた。年齢の数え方一つにも、命をどこから始まりとするかという哲学が潜んでいる。
cards.en: In the traditional kazoedoshi system of reckoning age, a child becomes one year old on the very day of birth. Because everyone's age was added in one go on New Year's Day, a baby born on New Year's Eve counted as two the next day. This view, which counts the months spent in the mother's womb as part of life, was widely shared across East Asia. It was in 1902 that a law encouraged the switch to counting by completed years, yet among ordinary people the old system lived on until after the war. Even in a single way of counting age, a philosophy lurks about where life is taken to begin.

words.defJa: すべての人。多くの人

cards.ja: 「やさしい日本語」は、一九九五年の阪神・淡路大震災をきっかけに生まれた考え方です。避難の情報が外国人住民に伝わらなかった反省から、短く、曖昧さのない言い方が研究されました。たとえば「高台に避難してください」は「高いところへ逃げてください」と言い換えます。万人に通じる日本語は存在しないとしても、通じる人を一人でも増やす工夫はできるのです。ぞんざいな言い換えでは意味が崩れるので、相手の立場を想像しながら言葉を選ぶ必要があります。
cards.en: Plain Japanese is an idea that grew out of the 1995 Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake. From the regret that evacuation information had not reached foreign residents, ways of speaking that are short and free of ambiguity came to be studied. For example, 'Please evacuate to high ground' is rephrased as 'Please run to a high place'. Even if there is no Japanese that gets through to everyone, effort can still be made to add even one more person who understands. Careless rephrasing breaks the meaning, so you need to choose words while imagining the other person's position.

ruby: はできるのです。ぞんざいな
cards.tipJa: 「万人向け」「万人に通じる」。例外なくすべての人、という硬い言い方。
cards.enTarget: Even if there is no Japanese that gets through to everyone, effort can still be made to add even one more person who understands.

words.defJa: 要求を通すために捕らえられた人

cards.ja: 「人質」という一見物騒な語は、字を分解すると意味が見えてくる。「質」は質屋の質と同じ字で、もとは約束を守る証として差し出す担保を指したことから、それは人間そのものを担保に差し出すことだった。戦国時代の大名が、同盟の証として妻子を送り合ったのは、まさにこの仕組みである。現代の事件報道で使われる意味は、そこから脅迫の側面だけが肥大した姿にほかならない。語の成り立ちを知れば、ぞんざいに読み流していた言葉にも、歴史の層が見えてくる。
cards.en: The somewhat ominous word hitojichi reveals its meaning when you break down the characters. The character for shichi is the same as in pawnshop; it originally referred to a pledge handed over as proof that a promise would be kept, so it meant a human being handed over as the pledge itself. It is precisely this mechanism that the daimyo of the Sengoku period used when they exchanged wives and children as proof of an alliance. The meaning used in today's crime reporting is nothing other than that form with only the aspect of coercion swollen. Once you know how a word is built, layers of history show even in words you had been skimming past carelessly.

cards.tipJa: 字の成り立ち（人＋質）から意味を考える。「人質に取る」「人質になる」と組む。
cards.enTarget: The somewhat ominous word hitojichi reveals its meaning when you break down the characters.

words.defJa: 公の機関が書類や金銭を渡すこと

cards.ja: 国は熊本に建つ半導体工場に対し、巨額の補助金を交付することを決めた。補助の対象は、建物や製造装置といった設備投資の一部に及ぶ。これを皮切りに、国内での生産基盤を強める政策が相次いで打ち出されている。背景には、世界的な半導体不足のなかで、海外の工場に頼りすぎたために供給の停滞が経済全体を揺るがした経験がある。もっとも、補助金が長期的に産業を育てるかどうかは、まだ評価が定まっていない。
cards.en: The state has decided to issue large subsidies to a semiconductor factory being built in Kumamoto. The support covers part of the capital investment in things like buildings and manufacturing equipment. Beginning with this, policies to strengthen domestic production foundations are being rolled out one after another. Behind this lies the experience, during the global chip shortage, of supply stagnation shaking the whole economy because of overreliance on overseas plants. Whether subsidies will foster the industry over the long term, however, has not yet been settled.

cards.enTarget: The state has decided to issue large subsidies to a semiconductor factory being built in Kumamoto.

words.defJa: 預かって大切にしまっておくこと

cards.ja: 似た三つの語の使い分けは、日本語学習者が最も間違えやすいところの一つで、試験でも狙われやすい。たとえば、貸金庫に預けた書類は保管、冷凍した肉は保存、世界記録は保持と言う。違いは、守る対象が物なのか、状態なのか、記録なのかにある。三語とも新聞やニュースで頻繁に出会う語だけに、感覚だけで選ぶと、文章がぎこちなくなる。試験では、守る対象に基づいて語を選べば、きっちり区別できる。
cards.en: The distinction among three similar words is one of the places where learners of Japanese slip most easily, and it is a favorite target on exams. For example, documents deposited in a safe-deposit box are hokan, frozen meat is hozon, and a world record is hoji. The difference lies in whether the thing being kept is an object, a condition, or a record. Because all three words are met constantly in newspapers and news, choosing by feel alone makes writing awkward. On the exam, if you choose the word based on the object being kept, you can tell them apart exactly.

cards.tipJa: 「保管場所」「厳重に保管する」。物を預かって守る。
cards.enTarget: For example, documents deposited in a safe-deposit box are hokan, frozen meat is hozon, and a world record is hoji.

words.meaning: to be equipped with; to be innate
words.defJa: もともと身についている

cards.ja: 優れた聞き手に備わるのは、才能ではなく技術である。相づちの種類を変える、相手の言葉を一度繰り返す、答えを急がない。そうした小さな技術が積み重なって、聞き上手という印象がつくられる。AIの対話システムがこうした振る舞いを身につければ、利用者は「聞いてもらえた」と感じやすい。もっとも、聞くふりと本当に聞くことは違い、技術だけで人の心がすんなり開くわけではなく、最後は相手への関心があるかどうかだ。
cards.en: What a fine listener is endowed with is not talent but technique. They vary their backchannel responses, repeat the other person's words once, and don't rush to answer. Such small techniques pile up, and the impression of being a good listener is created. If an AI dialogue system picks up such behavior, users are likely to feel they have been heard. Still, pretending to listen differs from truly listening, and technique alone does not smoothly open a person's heart; in the end it comes down to whether there is real interest in the other.

cards.tipJa: 「才能が備わる」「機能が備わる」。生まれつきまたは最初から持っている。
cards.enTarget: What a fine listener is endowed with is not talent but technique.

words.defJa: 計画を立てて案をまとめること

cards.ja: 動画で日本語を扱う企画を考えるとき、いちばん大事なのは「それ、誰が知りたいの」という問いだと思う。たとえば「の」の使い方なんて、日本人は誰も説明できないのに毎日使ってるじゃん。そういう当たり前をひっくり返す視点があると、一見地味な題材でも再生数は伸びる。題材は、毎日使っている言葉ほど、見る人の自分ごとになりやすくていい。見てもらうからには、最初の十秒で疑問を相手の頭に置くのが先なんだ。
cards.en: When thinking up a project for covering Japanese in videos, I think the most important thing is the question of who actually wants to know this. For example, no Japanese person can explain how to use no, yet we use it every day, you know. If you have a viewpoint that flips such givens upside down, even a seemingly plain subject can gain views. The best subjects are the words we use every day, since they are easiest for viewers to take personally. Since you want to be watched, putting a question in the viewer's head in the first ten seconds comes first.

ごとになりやすくていい。

cards.enTarget: When thinking up a project for covering Japanese in videos, I think the most important thing is the question of who actually wants to know this.

words.defJa: 物事がはかどるよう進めること

cards.ja: 適度な有酸素運動は、脳の海馬の働きを促進し、記憶の定着を助けると考えられている。動物実験では、運動した個体の海馬で新しい神経細胞が増えることも確かめられている。試験勉強の合間に二十分歩くだけでも、歩いたあとのすがすがしい頭で机に向かうと、集中が違う。もちろん、運動すれば成績が上がると断言することはできない。ただ、座りっぱなしの勉強よりは、理にかなっていると言える。
cards.en: Moderate aerobic exercise is thought to promote the functioning of the brain's hippocampus and to help consolidate memory. In animal experiments, it has also been confirmed that new nerve cells increase in the hippocampus of exercised animals. Even just a twenty-minute walk between bouts of exam study makes a difference in concentration when you return to your desk with a refreshed head. Of course, we cannot assert that exercising will raise grades. Still, it can be said to make more sense than study spent sitting the whole time.

words.defJa: 二つのことを同時に成り立たせること

cards.ja: 試験前に瞑想なんて、時間の無駄だとつい思ってしまうかもしれない。ところが、マインドフルネス瞑想が作業記憶を高めたという研究は、複数ある。仏教の坐禅や呼吸の観察を源流とするこの技法は、短時間だとしても続ければ集中力を保つ助けになる。もちろん、全員に効果があるとは限らず個人差もあるが、一日十分ほど呼吸に注意を向けるだけで気持ちが落ち着くという人もいる。勉強と瞑想の両立は、思うよりずっと現実的な選択肢である。
cards.en: You may well think meditating before an exam is a waste of time. Yet there are several studies in which mindfulness meditation improved working memory. This technique, which has its roots in Buddhist zazen and the observation of breath, helps keep concentration up if continued, even briefly. Of course it does not work for everyone and individuals differ, but some people say that just ten minutes a day of attending to the breath settles their minds. Combining study and meditation is a far more realistic option than you might think.

words.defJa: 都合のよい取り計らい

cards.ja: 最近は、クラウド大手がスタートアップに計算資源の便宜を図るかわりに、出資や長期の利用契約を結ぶ例が目立ちます。表向きは支援でも、実質的には顧客を囲い込む手段にすぎません。計算資源は一括で契約すると割引が受けられるため、小さな会社ほど断りにくいのです。公正な競争のためには、こうした契約の条件を公開させる仕組みが要るという声もあります。結果として、新しい企業の独立性は静かに削られていきます。
cards.en: Recently, cases stand out where big cloud companies, in return for extending computing resources as a favor to start-ups, secure investment or long-term usage contracts. Though ostensibly support, it is in effect no more than a way to lock in customers. Because bulk contracts for computing resources earn discounts, smaller companies find it harder to refuse. Some voices say that for fair competition a mechanism is needed to make the terms of such contracts public. As a result, the independence of new companies is quietly eroded.

cards.enTarget: Recently, cases stand out where big cloud companies, in return for extending computing resources as a favor to start-ups, secure investment or long-term usage contracts.

words.defJa: 毒にあたること。依存すること

cards.ja: ローマ皇帝クラウディウスって、キノコの中毒で死んだっていう説があるじゃないですか。しかも毒を盛ったのは妻のアグリッピナだって、古代の歴史家が、見てきたかのように書いてるんですよ。でも実際のところ、証拠はことごとく失われていて、真相は誰にもわからないらしいんです。それでも、毒殺の物語は宮廷の陰謀を語るのにちょうどよかったんでしょうね。ロマンがありますよね、あの時代の宮廷って。
cards.en: There's a theory that the Roman emperor Claudius died of mushroom poisoning, isn't there? What's more, ancient historians write as though they had seen it that his wife Agrippina was the one who laid the poison. But in actual fact, the evidence has been lost entirely, and apparently nobody knows the truth. Even so, the story of poisoning must have been just right for telling of court intrigue. There's something romantic about the courts of that age, don't you think?

words.defJa: 深い考えもなく自然な

cards.ja: 何気ない一言が、人を救うことも傷つけることもある。「大丈夫」の三文字は、声の高さと間の取り方次第で、心配にも詰問にもなる。話し方を磨くとは、言葉を飾ることにこだわるより、自分の言葉がどう響くかに耳を澄ませることだ。声に出す前に、相手がいまどんな状態にあるのかを一拍だけ想像してみると、同じ言葉でもずいぶん違って届く。ふだんの会話の中にこそ、その練習の機会は絶えず潜んでいる。
cards.en: A casual remark can save a person or hurt them. The three characters of daijobu can become either concern or interrogation depending on pitch and timing. Polishing how you speak means listening for how your words resonate, rather than obsessing over dressing them up. If you imagine for just one beat what state the other person is in before you speak, the same words arrive quite differently. It is in everyday conversation that opportunities for that practice constantly lurk.

words.defJa: その場に漂う雰囲気

cards.ja: 一九一四年の夏、ヨーロッパの首都の多くは、開戦を歓迎するようなムードに包まれていた。若者たちは数か月で終わる戦争だと信じ、駅では花束とともに送り出されたという。ところが、現実の塹壕は泥と寒さと砲弾の世界だった。戦線が停滞するに伴って、その熱気は冬の訪れとともに急速に冷めていった。空気を読むのにたけた為政者ほど、群衆の高揚を利用しようとするものであり、それは歴史が何度も示してきた通りである。
cards.en: In the summer of 1914, many European capitals were wrapped in a mood that welcomed war. Young men believed it would be over in a few months, and are said to have been seen off at stations with bouquets. Yet the reality of the trenches was a world of mud, cold and shells. As the front stagnated, that fervor cooled rapidly with the coming of winter. The more adept a ruler is at reading the air, the more he tends to try to exploit the crowd's exaltation, as history has shown time and again.

words.defJa: 他人の領分に入り込んで損なう

cards.ja: 人は誰でも、他人に踏み込まれたくない心の領域を持っています。親切のつもりの助言が相手を傷つけるのは、その境界線を無自覚にまたいでしまうからです。たとえば、相手が話したがらない過去を、善意のつもりで掘り返してしまう場面がそうです。心理学者は、信頼関係とは相手の領域を侵すことなく、少しずつ距離を縮めていく過程だと説明します。急いで近づこうとするほど、相手はおどおどと身を引いてしまうものです。
cards.en: Everyone has a region of the heart they do not want others to step into. Advice meant kindly hurts the other person because it unwittingly steps across that boundary. Digging up a past the other person does not want to talk about, supposedly out of good intentions, is one such case. Psychologists explain that a trusting relationship is a process of narrowing the distance bit by bit without encroaching on the other's territory. The more hurriedly you try to approach, the more the other person timidly pulls back.

cards.enTarget: Psychologists explain that a trusting relationship is a process of narrowing the distance bit by bit without encroaching on the other's territory.

words.defJa: 事情を理解して認めること

cards.ja: 日米修好通商条約は一八五八年、朝廷の勅許を得ないまま調印された。大老の井伊直弼は、天皇の了承を待っていては事態が悪化しかねないと判断したのである。背景には、アロー戦争で清が英仏に敗れた事実を持ち出して締結を迫った、ハリスの強い圧力があった。この判断が尊王攘夷派の反発を呼び、安政の大獄へとつながる。入試では、この一連の出来事を一本の線で説明できるかが問われる。
cards.en: The Treaty of Amity and Commerce between Japan and the United States was signed in 1858 without the imperial court's sanction. The chief minister Ii Naosuke judged that waiting for the emperor's consent might worsen matters. Behind this lay strong pressure from Harris, who cited the Qing defeat by Britain and France in the Arrow War to press for a conclusion. That judgment provoked a backlash from the loyalist, anti-foreign faction and led to the Ansei Purge. In entrance exams, you are asked whether you can explain this whole series of events as a single line.

words.defJa: 急に流行すること

cards.ja: 「ヤバい」の用法が広がったとき、世間はそれを一過性のブームだと見ていた。ところが三十年近くたっても消えないのは、この語が褒め言葉にも怖れにも使える便利な器だったからだ。流行語は廃れるのも早い反面、生き残った語は日常にしっかり根を下ろす。話し方を磨きたいなら、流行語を笑うどころか、なぜ人がその語を選ぶのかを観察するとよい。一見乱暴な言葉の中にも、聞き手との距離を測る工夫が隠れている。
cards.en: When the use of yabai spread, society regarded it as a passing boom. That it has not vanished in nearly thirty years is because the word turned out to be a handy vessel for both praise and fear. Buzzwords fade quickly, but the ones that survive put down firm roots in daily life. If you want to refine your way of speaking, rather than laughing at buzzwords, it pays to observe why people choose them. Even in seemingly rough language, there are tricks hidden for gauging distance from the listener.

cards.enTarget: When the use of yabai spread, society regarded it as a passing boom.

words.defJa: その人の性格や人間性

cards.ja: 歴史上の人物の評価は、後世の記録者の好みに左右されやすい。徳川家康は「たぬき親父」と描かれる一方で、家臣の言葉に耳を傾けたという逸話も残る。江戸時代の家康像は、のちの顕彰の中で整えられたものだとする見方もある。もっとも、勝者の側の記録は、敗者の人柄をけなす傾向があるので、そのまま信じるわけにはいかない。史料の成り立ちを確かめない限り、人物像は輪郭すら定まらないのである。
cards.en: Assessments of historical figures are easily swayed by the tastes of later recorders. While Tokugawa Ieyasu is portrayed as a sly old badger, anecdotes also remain of his listening to his retainers' words. Some argue that the Edo-period image of Ieyasu was shaped in the course of later veneration. Still, records from the winner's side tend to disparage the personality of the defeated, so one cannot simply believe them as they are. Unless you check how a source came to be, a person's image will not even settle into an outline.

cards.enTarget: Still, records from the winner's side tend to disparage the personality of the defeated, so one cannot simply believe them as they are.

words.defJa: 代表者が向かい合って話し合うこと

cards.ja: 首脳会談の通訳って、実はめちゃくちゃ難しいんですよ。日本語は主語をぼかすぶん、通訳者は文脈から誰の意志なのかを判断しなければならない。たとえば「善処します」を、きっぱりした拒否と訳すか前向きな返事と訳すかで、相手の受け取り方は真逆になる。訳語が一つずれるだけで、翌日の新聞の見出しが変わりかねないほど、重い仕事なんです。しかも現場は、一分たりとも待ってくれないんです。
cards.en: Interpreting at a summit meeting is actually insanely difficult, you know. Because Japanese blurs the subject, the interpreter has to judge from context whose will is being expressed. For example, whether you render zensho shimasu as a flat refusal or as a positive reply makes the other side's takeaway the exact opposite. It is such weighty work that one slightly off word could change the next day's newspaper headline. And the setting won't wait even a single minute.

words.defJa: そうするよう働きかける

cards.ja: 学習支援AIの設計では、答えをすぐ教えるのではなく、生徒に自分で考えるよう促す工夫が重視される。答えを教える前に、まず問う。「次に何をすればいいと思う」と問い返すだけで、生徒の手は止まらなくなる。理解の度合いに応じてヒントを小出しにする方法は、人間の家庭教師が昔から使ってきたソクラテス式の問答に近い。AIが優れた教師になれるかどうかは、賢さより問いの出し方にかかっている。
cards.en: In designing AI learning assistants, emphasis is placed on devices that prompt students to think for themselves rather than giving the answer right away. Ask first, before telling the answer. Simply asking back what you think should come next keeps a student's hand from stopping. Doling out hints in small portions according to the level of understanding is close to the Socratic questioning human tutors have long used. Whether AI can become an excellent teacher depends on how it poses questions more than on how smart it is.

cards.enTarget: In designing AI learning assistants, emphasis is placed on devices that prompt students to think for themselves rather than giving the answer right away.

words.defJa: 中心になって物事を導くこと

cards.ja: 日本語の「主語」は、実は文法の主導権を握ってはいない。三上章は「象は鼻が長い」という文に基づいて、日本語は主語ではなく主題を中心に組み立てられていると論じた。「は」が話題を立て、あとの部分がそれを説明する構造である。一見ふつうの文でも、英語の型を当てはめて考えるだけでは、この感覚はつかめない。日本語を理解する鍵は、文の主役を探すことよりも、話題の置き方を見ることにある。
cards.en: The Japanese subject does not, in fact, hold the lead in grammar. Basing himself on the sentence 'Elephants have long trunks,' Mikami Akira argued that Japanese is built around the topic rather than the subject. The structure is that wa sets up the topic and the rest explains it. Even in an apparently ordinary sentence, simply applying English patterns will not capture this feeling. The key to understanding Japanese lies in looking at how the topic is placed rather than hunting for the star of the sentence.

cards.tipJa: 「主導権」「主導する」。中心になって引っぱること。
cards.enTarget: The Japanese subject does not, in fact, hold the lead in grammar.

words.defJa: 足りない。少ない

cards.ja: 経験に乏しい新人ほど、失敗を恐れて、同じ確認ばかりを何度も繰り返す。一方、熟練者は失敗の数が多いのではなく、失敗から取り出す教訓の量が多い。心理学ではこれを、経験の量ではなく質の差として説明する。ただ年数を積み重ねるだけでは、いつまでたっても実力は育たないというのが、研究者たちの見方である。失敗を教訓に変える作業は、手間も痛みも伴うだけに、決してたやすいことではないのである。
cards.en: The newer a person is, the less experience they have, and they repeat the same checks over and over out of fear of failure. Veterans, by contrast, do not fail more often; they extract more lessons from each failure. Psychology explains this as a difference in the quality, not the quantity, of experience. Researchers hold that merely piling up years will never grow ability. Turning failure into a lesson takes effort and brings pain, so it is by no means an easy thing.

してたやすいことではないのである。

cards.enTarget: The newer a person is, the less experience they have, and they repeat the same checks over and over out of fear of failure.

words.defJa: それだけの価値がある

cards.ja: 「自分は評価に値する人間ではない」と感じてしまう現象は、心理学でインポスター症候群と呼ばれます。この現象は、一九七〇年代に二人の心理学者が報告して以来、広く知られるようになりました。実際の成果に反して、成功を運のせいにし、失敗だけを実力の証拠とみなす傾向があります。対処の第一歩は、周りからの評価を、きっぱり事実として受け取る練習です。感情はそのままにして、記録として積み上げていくのが、こつなんです。
cards.en: The phenomenon of feeling 'I am not someone who deserves recognition' is called impostor syndrome in psychology. It became widely known after two psychologists reported it in the 1970s. Contrary to actual achievement, there's a tendency to attribute success to luck and to treat only failure as evidence of ability. The first step in coping is practicing receiving others' evaluations flatly as fact. Leaving the feelings as they are and stacking them up as a record is the knack.

cards.enTarget: The phenomenon of feeling 'I am not someone who deserves recognition' is called impostor syndrome in psychology.

words.defJa: 他より先に重んじること

cards.ja: 説明の達人は、情報を足す前に、まず何を優先するかを決める。AIに文章を要約させるときも同じで、「三行で」「初心者向けに」といった条件を最初に渡すと、出力の質が目に見えて変わる。条件がないまま頼めば、答えはことごとく平均的で当たり障りのないものになる。目的がぼやけたまま質問を重ねても、時間ばかりが過ぎていく。条件は具体的であるに越したことはなく、自分が何を大切にしたいかを言葉にする力こそが問われるのだ。
cards.en: A master of explanation decides what to prioritize before adding information. It is the same when having AI summarize text: handing over conditions like in three lines or for beginners at the start visibly changes the quality of the output. If you ask without conditions, the answers turn out uniformly average and inoffensive. Piling up questions while the purpose stays vague only lets time slip by. It is best for conditions to be concrete, and what is really tested is the ability to put into words what you want to value.

cards.enTarget: A master of explanation decides what to prioritize before adding information.

words.defJa: 果たすべき重い務め

cards.ja: AI開発の現場では、いま「速く賢くすること」だけが目標なのか、という問いが静かに広がっています。性能の競争に勝てば、市場でも勝てる。そう信じて走ってきた企業ほど、安全性の検証が後回しになりがちです。しかし広く使われる技術であれば、その影響に責任を負えるのは作り手以外にありません。安全を優先するというのは、勝ち負けの外側に置く約束であり、そこにこそ本当の使命があるのではないでしょうか。
cards.en: In AI development, a question is quietly spreading: is making things fast and smart the only goal? If you win the performance race, you win the market too. The more a company has run on that belief, the more safety verification tends to be put off. But for a technology that is widely used, no one but its makers can take responsibility for its effects. Putting safety first is a promise placed outside win and loss, and isn't it there that the true mission lies?

があるのではないでしょうか。

cards.enTarget: Putting safety first is a promise placed outside win and loss, and isn't it there that the true mission lies?

words.defJa: 意味のないこと。ばかげたこと

cards.ja: 「私とは何者か」という問いを、ナンセンスだと切り捨てる人がいる。たしかに、五感で確かめられないことは、実験室ではいくら論じても測りようがない。しかし古代インドの思索者たちは、答えが出ないとしても、その問いに一生を懸けて向き合った。この問いを抱えたまま静かに座ることこそが、修行の出発点とされてきた。答えが出るかどうかにこだわる前に、問いそのものが人を変えるという事実に目を向けるべきである。
cards.en: Some people dismiss the question 'Who am I?' as nonsense. True, what cannot be confirmed by the five senses cannot be measured in a laboratory, however much one argues about it. Yet the thinkers of ancient India devoted their whole lives to that question, even knowing that no answer might come. Sitting quietly while holding this question has been regarded as the very starting point of practice. Before fixating on whether an answer will emerge, we should look at the fact that the question itself changes a person.

words.defJa: 互いに張り合って対立すること

cards.ja: 『マハーバーラタ』は、インドの二大叙事詩の一つであり、一族の土地をめぐる争いを描いている。だがその核心は、戦場に立つ王子アルジュナが、親族と殺し合うことに意味はあるのかと立ちすくむ場面にある。ここで御者のクリシュナが説くのは、結果への執着を捨て、自らの使命を果たせという教えだ。『バガヴァッド・ギーター』と呼ばれるこの対話は、戦争の物語の真ん中に置かれた哲学書なのである。
cards.en: The Mahabharata, one of India's two great epics, depicts a dispute over a clan's land. But its heart lies in the scene where the prince Arjuna, standing on the battlefield, freezes, wondering whether there is any meaning in killing his own kin. What the charioteer Krishna preaches here is the teaching to cast off attachment to results and fulfill one's own mission. This dialogue, called the Bhagavad Gita, is a philosophical text placed in the middle of a war story.

words.defJa: 線や道が互いに出合うこと

cards.ja: 神経科学と仏教学が交わる地点で、瞑想の研究が活発になっている。何気ない呼吸の観察から、「自己」とは何かという哲学的な議論に至るまで、話題は多岐にわたる。僧侶と科学者が同じ机を囲んで語り合う会議も、いくつも開かれてきた。もっとも、両者の用語は完全には重ならず、「注意」や「気づき」の定義をめぐる食い違いも少なくない。それでも対話が続くのは、互いの方法に学ぶ価値があると認め合っているからだ。
cards.en: At the point where neuroscience and Buddhist studies intersect, research on meditation is flourishing. From the observation of casual breathing all the way to philosophical debate over what the self is, the topics are wide-ranging. Several conferences have also been held where monks and scientists sit around the same table and talk. That said, the two sides' terms do not fully overlap, and discrepancies over the definitions of attention and awareness are not few. The dialogue continues because each acknowledges that there is value in learning from the other's methods.

cards.enTarget: At the point where neuroscience and Buddhist studies intersect, research on meditation is flourishing.

words.meaning: to accompany; to bring with it
words.defJa: 一緒に起こる。連れて行く

cards.ja: 産業革命は、生活を豊かにしたと同時に、深刻な痛みを伴うものでした。農村から工場街に流れ込んだおびただしい数の人々は、一日十数時間の労働と劣悪な住環境、それに汚れた空気に耐えることを余儀なくされました。そこで、児童の就労を制限する工場法が、一八三三年のイギリスで整えられます。変化の速度が速いほど、社会の対応が追いつかず犠牲が生まれる。この構図は、現代のAI革命にも重なります。
cards.en: The Industrial Revolution made life richer, but at the same time it was something that brought serious pain with it. The vast numbers of people who poured from the countryside into factory towns were forced to endure labor of a dozen-plus hours a day, wretched housing, and foul air. So in 1833 Britain put in place a Factory Act restricting child employment. The faster the pace of change, the more society's response lags behind and sacrifices arise. This pattern overlaps with the AI revolution of today.

cards.enTarget: The Industrial Revolution made life richer, but at the same time it was something that brought serious pain with it.

words.defJa: 成績や業績が思わしくないこと

cards.ja: プロ野球の選手が不振に陥ると、フォームを細かくいじりすぎて、かえって打てなくなることがある。ゴルフや野球のように細かな型がものをいう競技では、同じ悩みがよく見られる。脳科学ではこれを、意識が自動化された動きに割り込む現象として説明する。熟練した動作は、考えないからこそ速く正確に動くのだ。だから調子が悪いときほど、あえて何も考えず、素振りの本数を減らさずに続けるのが有効だと言われる。
cards.en: When a professional baseball player falls into a slump, he sometimes fiddles with his form so much that he ends up unable to hit at all. The same trouble is common in sports like golf and baseball, where fine technical form counts for a great deal. Brain science explains this as consciousness cutting in on automated movement. Skilled motions run fast and accurately precisely because one does not think about them. That is why, when things are going badly, it is said to be effective to deliberately think about nothing and keep up the number of practice swings.

words.defJa: 本や雑誌に添えられる追加の物

cards.ja: 昔の雑誌の付録には、今では考えられないほど凝ったものがありました。戦前の少年雑誌には、紙の人形から組み立て式の軍艦模型に至るまで、書店の棚にずらっと並ぶほどのおまけが付いたと言われています。出版社がおまけの豪華さを競い合った背景には、雑誌が娯楽の王様だった時代の、激しい販売競争があります。おまけの出来が売れ行きを左右することさえあったのです。あの小さな紙の束にも、その時代の夢と欲望が詰まっているのです。
cards.en: Old magazines had supplements more elaborate than we can imagine today. Prewar boys' magazines are said to have come with extras ranging from paper dolls to assemble-it-yourself warship models, enough to line bookstore shelves in rows. Behind publishers competing over the splendor of their freebies lay fierce sales competition in an era when magazines were the king of entertainment. The quality of the freebie could even decide how well an issue sold. Even in that small bundle of paper, the dreams and desires of the age are packed.

words.defJa: 不買や参加拒否で抗議すること

cards.ja: ガンディーの塩の行進より前に、ベンガル分割をきっかけにイギリス製品をボイコットする運動が広がってたじゃないですか。それが一九〇五年に始まったスワデーシー運動です。糸車を回して自分で布を織るっていう発想が、もう政治なんですよ。買わないという選択が、そのまま抗議になるんです。おかげで英国製の綿布は売れ行きが不振に陥ったし、日常の小さな行動が帝国を揺さぶったんですね。
cards.en: Before Gandhi's Salt March, a movement to boycott British goods had already spread in the wake of the Partition of Bengal, hadn't it? That was the Swadeshi movement, which began in 1905. The very idea of turning a spinning wheel and weaving your own cloth is already politics. The choice not to buy becomes a protest in itself. As a result, sales of British cotton cloth fell into a slump, and small everyday actions shook an empire.

words.defJa: 儀式。式典

cards.ja: 半導体工場の起工式といえば、来賓がずらりと並んでスコップを入れるセレモニーを思い浮かべるだろう。ところが近年は、式を一時間ほどで切り上げ、翌朝には重機を動かす現場も珍しくない。巨額の設備投資を抱えるだけに、着工が一日遅れるだけでも痛手になるからだ。稼働が数か月ずれれば競合に市場を奪われかねず、式典の華やかさよりも工期の速さを優先する。それが最先端の工場の流儀である。
cards.en: When people think of the groundbreaking for a chip factory, they probably picture guests lined up to turn the first spade of earth in a ceremony. In recent years, however, it is not unusual for a site to wrap up the event within about an hour and have heavy machinery moving the next morning. Because they carry enormous capital investment, even a one-day delay in starting construction hurts. If operations slip by several months, a competitor may seize the market, so they put construction speed ahead of ceremonial splendor. That is the way of the most advanced factories.

cards.enTarget: When people think of the groundbreaking for a chip factory, they probably picture guests lined up to turn the first spade of earth in a ceremony.

words.defJa: 土地や建物など、動かせない財産

cards.ja: 歴史の授業で、地租改正を「土地に値段をつけた改革」と一言で説明した先生がいた。それまで年貢は米で納めていたが、明治六年からは、不動産の価格に当たる地価をもとに、現金で税を納める仕組みになった。この説明が生徒の記憶に残ったのは、変化の前と後がきっちり対になっていたからだ。伝わる話し方とは、比べる軸を一本に絞って見せる話し方であり、聞き手の頭に整理棚をつくる作業にほかならない。
cards.en: In a history class there was a teacher who explained the land-tax reform in one phrase: the reform that put a price on land. Until then land tax had been paid in rice, but from 1873 a system took hold in which tax was paid in cash, based on land value, that is, the price of real estate. The explanation stuck in students' memories because the before and after formed an exact pair. Speaking that gets through is speaking that narrows the axis of comparison to one, and it is nothing other than the work of building a sorting shelf in the listener's head.

words.defJa: 先導。主導すること

cards.ja: ヨガのクラスって、先生が呼吸を導いてくれるから楽なんですよね。ひとりで座ってはみたものの、自分の息がどこにあるのか、すんなりとはつかめない。だから先生の声が消えた途端に、急に不安になる人は少なくない。インドの修行者が何年も師のそばで過ごしたのは、誰かのリードがなくても立てるようになるまでの時間だったんじゃないかな。そう考えると、あの遠回りは遠回りじゃなかったのかもしれないですよ。
cards.en: In a yoga class, it's easy because the teacher guides your breathing, isn't it? Sitting alone, I tried it, but I can't smoothly grasp where my own breath is. So it's not uncommon for people to suddenly feel anxious the moment the teacher's voice is gone. The years Indian practitioners spent at their teacher's side were probably the time it took to be able to stand without anyone's lead. Thinking about it that way, maybe that detour wasn't a detour at all.

words.defJa: つながって続く一まとまり

cards.ja: 対話型AIの登場以降、学習塾や予備校の現場では、授業のやり方に至るまで一連の変化が起きている。生徒が答えを丸ごと生成させてしまう、という悩みが教室の内外でまず表面に出た。その次に、教える側の役割が、解説から質問の設計へと移りつつある。生徒が主導して考える時間をどう確保するかが、いま最も問われている。道具が賢くなるほど、人間の側に残る役目は、何を問うかを決めることへと絞られていく。
cards.en: Since the arrival of conversational AI, a series of changes has been taking place in cram schools and prep schools, right down to the way lessons are run. First to surface, inside and outside the classroom, was the worry that students have the whole answer generated for them. Next, the teacher's role is shifting from explanation toward the design of questions. How to secure time for students to take the lead in thinking is now being asked more than anything. The smarter the tools become, the more what remains for humans narrows down to deciding what to ask.

cards.enTarget: Since the arrival of conversational AI, a series of changes has been taking place in cram schools and prep schools, right down to the way lessons are run.

words.defJa: 物事の一つの側面

cards.ja: 半導体の微細化は、性能を上げ消費電力を下げる一面で、製造コストを雪だるま式に押し上げてきた。最先端の露光装置は一台数百億円とも言われ、資金力に乏しい新興企業には手が出ない。今や最先端の工場を持てるのは、世界でもごく数社に限られる。技術の進歩は同時に、参加者の数を絞り、競争そのものを狭めてしまう力でもある。勉強でも事情は似ていて、難度が上がるほど、続ける人は減っていく。
cards.en: Chip miniaturization has raised performance and cut power consumption on the one hand, while pushing manufacturing costs up like a snowball. Cutting-edge lithography machines are said to cost tens of billions of yen each, which is out of reach for start-ups short of capital. Today only a handful of companies in the world can own a leading-edge factory. Technological progress is at the same time a force that narrows the number of participants and even the competition itself. Studying is similar: the higher the difficulty rises, the fewer people keep going.

cards.sense: 一つの側面の意味
cards.enTarget: Chip miniaturization has raised performance and cut power consumption on the one hand, while pushing manufacturing costs up like a snowball.

words.defJa: ちょっと見たところ

cards.ja: 一見すると意志の弱さに見える先延ばしが、実は感情の調整の問題だと指摘する研究が増えている。課題そのものが嫌なのではなく、課題がもたらす不安から逃れたい一心で、人は別の作業に逃げ込むという。したがって時間管理の技術を教えるだけでは、根本の解決に至らない恐れがある。本当に必要なのは、不安を抱えたまま最初の五分を動く練習であり、そこにこつがあるとされる。意志の強さを責めても、状況はほとんど変わらないのだ。
cards.en: A growing body of research points out that procrastination, which at first glance looks like weak willpower, is actually a problem of emotional regulation. People are said to flee into other tasks not because they dislike the task itself but out of a single-minded wish to escape the anxiety it brings. Therefore, merely teaching time-management techniques risks failing to reach the root of the problem. What is really needed is practice in moving for the first five minutes while carrying the anxiety, and that is said to be the knack. Blaming someone's willpower changes almost nothing.

cards.enTarget: A growing body of research points out that procrastination, which at first glance looks like weak willpower, is actually a problem of emotional regulation.

words.defJa: 取り上げる個々の事柄

cards.ja: チェックリストの効用は、重要事項を人間の記憶から外へ追い出す点にある。航空業界で普及した手順書は、熟練の機長でも忘れる場面があるという前提でつくられた。医療でも、手術前の確認項目をきっちり読み上げる方式を導入した病院で、合併症が減ったとの報告が出ている。人の注意力に頼らず仕組みで守るという発想は、さまざまな分野に広がり、いまでは調理の現場から宇宙開発にまで及んでいる。
cards.en: The benefit of a checklist lies in pushing important items out of human memory. The procedure manuals that spread through the aviation industry were made on the premise that even veteran captains have moments when they forget. In medicine, too, there are reports that complications decreased at hospitals that introduced the method of reading out pre-surgery checks exactly. The idea of protecting through systems rather than relying on human attention has spread across many fields, and now reaches from kitchens to space development.

cards.enTarget: The benefit of a checklist lies in pushing important items out of human memory.

words.defJa: 続いていたことを途中でやめること

cards.ja: ブッダの最期の旅は、病に苦しみながらも歩みを止めない道のりだった。鍛冶工チュンダの供した食事で体調を崩したあとも、一行は旅の中断を選ばず、クシナガラへ向かったと経典は伝える。道の途中で何度も休息を取りながら、それでも歩みは続いた。沙羅双樹の下で弟子たちに語りかける場面には、ブッダの人柄が静かに表れている。死の間際まで教えることをやめなかった、という点が語り継がれてきた。
cards.en: The Buddha's last journey was a road on which he did not stop walking even while suffering from illness. Even after falling ill from a meal offered by the smith Cunda, the party did not choose to interrupt the journey and headed for Kushinagar, the scriptures tell us. They rested many times along the way, yet the walking went on. In the scene where he addresses his disciples beneath the sal trees, the Buddha's character shows quietly. That he did not stop teaching until the very brink of death has been handed down through the ages.

words.defJa: 同じ状態を続ける

cards.ja: ヨーガと聞くとポーズを思い浮かべる人が多いが、古典の中心は心の制御にある。ヨーガの古典『ヨーガ・スートラ』は、心の働きを静めることをヨーガと定義した。そのために示されるのが、修行を長く続けることと、執着から離れることの二つである。心を静かに保つといっても、無理に思考を押さえ込もうとしてもすんなりとは静まらない。波立つ水面が自然に澄んでいくのを待つかのように、ただ観察を続けるのだ。
cards.en: Many people picture poses when they hear the word yoga, but the heart of the classical texts lies in the control of the mind. The classic Yoga Sutras defined yoga as stilling the workings of the mind. Two means are offered for that: continuing practice over a long time and letting go of attachment. Even to keep the mind quiet, trying to force down thoughts will not make it settle smoothly. As if waiting for a rippled surface of water to clear of itself, one simply continues to observe.

cards.enTarget: Even to keep the mind quiet, trying to force down thoughts will not make it settle smoothly.

words.defJa: 最後まで整えて完成させる

cards.ja: 生成AIにレポートを書かせると、八割は一瞬でできるんだよね。でも最後の二割、つまり事実の確認とか、自分の言葉への書き直しとかが、実はいちばん時間かかる。そこをぞんざいに扱ったばかりに、すぐバレちゃう人も多いんだ。締め切り前の夜ほど、最後の一割を自分の目で確かめたかどうかの差がはっきり出る。AIは下書きのうまい助手であって、最後まで自分で仕上げる覚悟は、人間のほうに残るんだよ。
cards.en: When you have generative AI write a report, eighty percent is done in an instant. But the last twenty percent, meaning checking the facts and rewriting in your own words, actually takes the most time. Plenty of people get caught right away just because they treated that part carelessly. The night before a deadline is when the difference of whether you checked the last ten percent with your own eyes shows most clearly. AI is a skilled assistant for first drafts, and the resolve to finish it yourself to the end stays with the human.

words.defJa: 書式。体の動かし方の型

cards.ja: 国語辞典の編集部には、読者が投稿フォームから寄せる質問が昼夜を問わず届く。「全然」は否定とだけ結びつくのか、という問いは長年の定番だ。実際には、明治の文学作品にも肯定の文脈で使われた例がある。そうした声を一つずつ読んでいくと、人々が言葉のどこに敏感なのかが見えてくる。言葉の変化は、いつの時代も賛否を伴うものであり、編集者は両方の声に耳を傾けながら記述を練り直していく。
cards.en: The editorial office of a Japanese dictionary receives questions from readers through its submission form at all hours of the day and night. Whether zenzen can only be paired with a negative is a long-standing staple. In fact, there are examples from Meiji-era literature where it is used in an affirmative context. Reading such voices one by one reveals what people are sensitive about in language. Linguistic change has always been accompanied by both praise and criticism, and editors rework their entries while listening to both sides.

cards.sense: 入力用の書式の意味
cards.enTarget: The editorial office of a Japanese dictionary receives questions from readers through its submission form at all hours of the day and night.

words.defJa: まとめて一度に扱うこと

cards.ja: 歴史を語るとき、年号が大事だからといって一括して並べても、聞き手の頭には何も残らない。舞台は一〇九五年、フランス中部の町クレルモンである。十字軍なら、まず一人の教皇の演説という場面を置き、そこからいくつもの遠征へと順に広げたほうが、聞き手の頭の中に道筋ができる。話は点ではなく線で覚えられるのであり、年号は線の上に置く目印にすぎない。順番に積み上げる手間を、おろそかにしてはならない。
cards.en: When telling history, even if dates matter, lining them up in one lump leaves nothing in the listener's head. The setting is Clermont, a town in central France, in 1095. For the Crusades, it works better to first set the scene of one pope's speech and then widen out to the many expeditions in order, so that a path forms in the listener's mind. Stories are remembered as lines, not points, and dates are merely markers placed along the line. You must not neglect the effort of building things up in order.

ruby: き、そこからいくつもの
を、おろそかにしてはならない。
cards.tipJa: 「一括して」「一括払い」「一括りにする」。まとめて処理する意味。
cards.enTarget: When telling history, even if dates matter, lining them up in one lump leaves nothing in the listener's head.

words.defJa: だらしない。きちんとしていない

cards.ja: AIモデルの性能比較では、評価の条件がルーズなまま、数字だけが一人歩きすることがある。同じ問題集が学習データに混じっていれば、高得点は実力の証明にならない。そこで研究者たちは、公開の日まで問題を伏せて保管する方式を取り入れてきた。評価のやり方が公開されていない場合は、なおさら注意が要る。利用者の側も、点数の高さだけで選ばず、数字の裏にある手順を確かめない限り、ランキングをうのみにしてはいけないのである。
cards.en: In comparisons of AI model performance, numbers sometimes take on a life of their own while the evaluation conditions remain sloppy. If the same question set has found its way into the training data, a high score is no proof of ability. So researchers have adopted a method of keeping the questions hidden and in storage until the day of release. When the evaluation method is not made public, extra caution is all the more necessary. Users, too, should not choose by high scores alone, and unless you check the procedure behind the numbers, you must not swallow a ranking whole.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: り、ランキングをうのみにしてはいけないのである。
cards.tipJa: 「時間にルーズ」「管理がルーズ」。規律のゆるさを批判する語。
cards.enTarget: In comparisons of AI model performance, numbers sometimes take on a life of their own while the evaluation conditions remain sloppy.

words.meaning: to be clear; to be sharp
words.defJa: 頭や感覚が澄んで鋭く働く

cards.ja: 同じ人でも、頭が冴える時間帯には波があることが、睡眠研究でわかっています。朝型か夜型かという体質も、遺伝の影響を受けるそうです。だからといって、誰もが朝五時に起きれば天才になれるわけではありません。大切なのは、自分の頭のピークの時間帯を知り、一番重い仕事をそこに置くことです。そうすれば、同じ八時間の仕事でも、効率は段違いに変わり、夕方の疲れ方まで違ってきます。
cards.en: Sleep research shows that even in the same person, the hours when the mind is sharp rise and fall. Whether you are a morning or an evening type is also said to be influenced by genes. That does not mean anyone who gets up at five in the morning becomes a genius. What matters is to know the hours of your own peak and to place your heaviest work there. Do that, and even in the same eight hours of work, efficiency changes dramatically, and even how tired you feel by evening is different.

くことです。そうすれば、
cards.tipJa: 「頭が冴える」「目が冴える」のように、感覚や頭脳が澄んで鋭いさまを表す。
cards.enTarget: Sleep research shows that even in the same person, the hours when the mind is sharp rise and fall.

words.defJa: 相手のために意見や知恵を貸すこと

cards.ja: 起業家の失敗を調べたある研究者は、成功者の助言ほど当てにならないものはないと指摘する。生き残った人の話しか聞こえてこないため、運の要素が語られないからだ。実際に役立つのは、世に乏しい失敗の記録、つまり何を見落としたかの地味な記述のほうだという。他人の言葉を聞くにしても、勝ち筋ではなく、落とし穴の位置に耳を傾けるべきだろう。成功談は娯楽、失敗談は教材だと割り切れば、聞き方も変わってくる。
cards.en: A researcher who has studied the failures of entrepreneurs points out that nothing is less reliable than the advice of successful people. Since we only hear from those who survived, the element of luck goes unmentioned. What is actually useful, she says, are the scarce records of failure, the plain accounts of what people overlooked. Even when listening to what others say, we should attend not to the winning moves but to where the pitfalls lie. If we accept that success stories are entertainment and failure stories are teaching material, the way we listen changes too.

cards.enTarget: A researcher who has studied the failures of entrepreneurs points out that nothing is less reliable than the advice of successful people.

words.defJa: 同じ集団の人が着る決まった服

cards.ja: 学校の制服は、個性を奪うものだとよく言われる。だが言葉の世界にも、敬語という名のお仕着せがある。それを着れば、初対面の相手とも距離を保って話せるという一面がある一方で、着たままでは本音がなかなか伝わらない。着るべきか脱ぐべきかを瞬時に見極める力こそが、日本語を使いこなす力にほかならない。そのどちらを選ぶかによって、同じ一言であっても、相手に届く温度がまるで変わってくるのだ。
cards.en: School uniforms are often said to rob students of individuality. But the world of language, too, has a uniform called honorific speech. Wearing it lets you keep your distance and talk even with someone you have just met, but if you stay in it, your true feelings are hard to convey. The ability to judge in an instant whether to put it on or take it off is nothing other than the skill of using Japanese well. Depending on which you choose, even the same single phrase reaches the other person at a completely different temperature.

cards.tipJa: 「制服を着る」「制服姿」のように使う。比喩では、決まった型や枠のたとえになる。
cards.enTarget: School uniforms are often said to rob students of individuality.

words.defJa: 中身が豊かで足りているさま

cards.ja: 古代ローマがあれほど長く続いた理由は、軍事力のみならず、インフラの充実にあります。街道や水道といった一連の整備が進めば、兵も商人も情報も一気に動くようになるからです。ローマ人は征服した土地を、ただ奪うのではなく「つなぐ」ことで治めました。これを抜きにして、あの帝国の寿命は語れません。その証拠に、当時の石畳の道は、二千年近くたった今もヨーロッパ各地に残り、旅人の足を支えています。
cards.en: The reason ancient Rome lasted so long lies not only in its military power but in the richness of its infrastructure. Once a series of improvements such as roads and aqueducts was in place, soldiers, merchants and information could all move at once. The Romans governed the lands they conquered not by simply seizing them but by connecting them. Without this, the empire's long life cannot be explained. As proof, the paved roads of that time remain in many parts of Europe nearly two thousand years later and still support travelers' feet.

cards.enTarget: The reason ancient Rome lasted so long lies not only in its military power but in the richness of its infrastructure.

words.defJa: 国や自治体が設置し運営すること

cards.ja: うちの子が通う公立小学校で、今年からタブレットのドリルが入ったんですよ。解いた問題の間違い方に応じて、人工知能が次の問題を選んでくれるらしいんです。採点も一括で終わるので、先生が一人ひとりと話す時間が増えたそうです。とはいえ、機械に任せっぱなしにするのも、ちょっと怖い気はしますけどね。来年は中学校でも同じ仕組みが入るそうで、親としては、使い方のルールが気になっています。
cards.en: At the public elementary school my kid goes to, tablet drills were introduced this year. Apparently the artificial intelligence picks the next problem depending on how you got the last one wrong. Grading is finished in one batch, so I hear teachers now have more time to talk with each child. Still, leaving everything to the machine does feel a little scary to me. I hear the same system will be introduced in middle school next year, and as a parent I am concerned about the rules for using it.

cards.enTarget: At the public elementary school my kid goes to, tablet drills were introduced this year.

words.defJa: 元気が出るよう言葉をかけ力づける

cards.ja: 日本語には、落ち込んだ相手に寄り添う動詞がいくつもあります。「慰める」は悲しみを和らげること、「励ます」は前を向く力を与えることだと整理すると、使い分けのヒントが見えてきます。たとえば試験に落ちた友人に、いきなり前向きな言葉を並べるのは、傷口を気にすることなく前へ押し出すようなものです。まず慰め、気持ちが落ち着いてから背中を押す。この順番を守るだけで、同じ言葉が驚くほど届き方を変えます。
cards.en: Japanese has several verbs for staying close to someone who is down. If you sort them out as comforting meaning easing sorrow and encouraging meaning giving the strength to look ahead, hints for using them correctly come into view. For example, lining up positive words for a friend who has just failed an exam is like pushing them forward without a thought for the wound. First comfort them, and once they have calmed down, give them a push. Just by keeping to this order, the same words land in a surprisingly different way.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「慰める」と対にして覚える。「友を励ます」「励まされる」と、前向きにさせる意味で使う。
cards.enTarget: If you sort them out as comforting meaning easing sorrow and encouraging meaning giving the strength to look ahead, hints for using them correctly come into view.

words.defJa: 犯罪に対して国が科す罰

cards.ja: 刑罰の目的は応報なのか更生なのかという古い問いに、脳科学が新たな材料を持ち込みつつある。衝動を抑える脳の機能に偏りがあれば、責任の重さも変わるのではないかという議論である。一方で、「脳のせい」を認めれば、あらゆる犯罪が免責されかねないという懸念も根強い。科学の知見をどこまで司法に反映させるのか、社会の合意はまだ形成されていない。答えを急ぐ前に、問いの形を整える必要があるのだろう。
cards.en: Neuroscience is bringing new material to the old question of whether the purpose of criminal penalty is retribution or rehabilitation. The argument is that if there is a bias in the brain's capacity to restrain impulses, the weight of responsibility might change too. On the other hand, there is a persistent worry that accepting "it was the brain" could excuse every crime. How far scientific findings should be reflected in the judiciary is a point on which society has yet to reach agreement. Before rushing to an answer, we probably need to straighten out the shape of the question.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: わるのではないかという
cards.tipJa: 「刑罰を科す」「重い刑罰」のように、国家が犯罪者に与える罰を指す法律の語。
cards.enTarget: Neuroscience is bringing new material to the old question of whether the purpose of criminal penalty is retribution or rehabilitation.

words.defJa: 他人の考えや感情に深く同感すること

cards.ja: 近年の脳科学では、会話中の二人の脳活動がしだいにそろっていく現象が注目されている。話し手の言葉に聞き手が深く共鳴するほど、その同調は強まるという報告もある。ただし、これが共感の原因なのか結果なのかは、いまだ決着がついていない。厳密な因果を確かめる実験の設計をめぐって、研究者の間でも議論が続いている。少なくとも、人が人に惹かれる理由を、数字で語る時代が来ていることは確かである。
cards.en: In recent neuroscience, the phenomenon in which the brain activity of two people in conversation gradually falls into step has drawn attention. There are reports that the more deeply the listener resonates with the speaker's words, the stronger this synchrony becomes. However, whether it is the cause or the result of empathy remains unsettled. Researchers continue to debate how to design an experiment that can establish strict causation. At the very least, it is certain that an age has arrived in which the reasons people are drawn to one another can be discussed in numbers.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: がしだいにそろっていく
cards.tipJa: 「考えに共鳴する」「共鳴を呼ぶ」など、音の響き合いを心の同感に広げた用法。
cards.enTarget: There are reports that the more deeply the listener resonates with the speaker's words, the stronger this synchrony becomes.

words.defJa: お金の入りと出

cards.ja: 人工知能の会社って、売上が伸びているのに、収支はずっと赤字、なんてことがよくあるじゃないですか。理由は単純で、計算に使う半導体と電気のお金が、とにかく桁違いなんですよ。黒字どころか、使う人が増えるほど赤字が膨らむという、変な構図になりやすいんです。ブームに乗って投資する前に、そこは冷静に見たほうがいいと思いますけどね。結局は、お金の流れを見ない人気ほど、あとで怖いものはないですからね。
cards.en: Artificial intelligence companies often have sales that keep growing while their income and expenditure stays in the red, don't they? The reason is simple: the money for the semiconductors and electricity used in computation is just on a different scale. Far from turning a profit, it tends to become a strange structure where the more users there are, the more the deficit swells. Before you ride the boom and invest, I think you should look at that calmly. In the end, nothing is scarier later than popularity that ignores the flow of money.

になりやすいんです。ブームに
いものはないですからね。

words.meaning: to recruit; to solicit; to grow stronger
words.defJa: 広く呼びかけて人や物を集める

cards.ja: 一九五一年、ヴィノバ・バーヴェは、地主たちに土地の寄付を募る旅に出ました。村での出会いをきっかけに、土地を持たない人々の窮状を知ったのです。彼は、土地は空気や水のように万人のものだと訴え、各地を歩き続けたと伝えられます。国家が強制するのではなく善意に訴えるという方法は、ガンディーの非暴力の思想を受け継いだものでした。集まった土地の面積は大きかったものの、実際に配分できた分は限られていたとも言われます。
cards.en: In 1951, Vinoba Bhave set out on a journey to solicit land donations from landowners. An encounter in a village had made him aware of the plight of people who owned no land. He is said to have kept walking from place to place, appealing that land belongs to everyone, like air and water. The method of appealing to goodwill rather than having the state compel was an inheritance of Gandhi's thought of nonviolence. The area of land gathered was large, but it is also said that the portion actually distributed was limited.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「寄付を募る」「参加者を募る」のように、広く呼びかけて集める意味で使う。
cards.enTarget: In 1951, Vinoba Bhave set out on a journey to solicit land donations from landowners.

words.defJa: 危険を恐れず立ち向かうさま

cards.ja: ジャンヌ・ダルクって、勇敢な聖女のイメージが強いじゃないですか。でも長い戦歴どころか、彼女が表舞台に立ったのは、実はたった二年ほどなんですよ。一四二九年にオルレアンを解放したあと、一四三一年には火刑にされてしまうんですから、あまりに短い。十代の少女が戦いを主導して国の流れを変えたと思うと、ちょっと現実感がなくなりますよね。火刑台の上の怖さまで想像すると、彼女の姿は急に身近になりますよね。
cards.en: Joan of Arc has a strong image as a brave saint, doesn't she? But far from a long military career, she was actually on the public stage for only about two years. After liberating Orleans in 1429, she was burned at the stake in 1431, so it is awfully short. When you think that a teenage girl led the fighting and changed the course of a country, it starts to feel a bit unreal. And if you imagine even the fear she felt on the pyre, her figure suddenly becomes much closer, doesn't it?

words.meaning: to extend; to reach; to amount to
words.defJa: ある範囲や程度にまで達する

cards.ja: 紀元前三世紀、マウリヤ朝のアショーカ王は、インド亜大陸のほぼ全域に及ぶ大帝国を築きました。しかし、カリンガ地方との戦争で多くの死者が出たことを深く悔い、武力による支配を改めたと伝えられます。以後は仏教の教えに基づく統治を掲げ、各地の岩や石柱に、一連の法勅を刻ませました。遠く離れた地域まで一つの理念を届ける、これほど大がかりな広報は、当時としては前代未聞です。
cards.en: In the third century BCE, King Ashoka of the Mauryan dynasty built a great empire extending over almost the whole Indian subcontinent. However, he is said to have deeply regretted the many deaths in the war with Kalinga and to have given up rule by force. From then on he upheld governance based on Buddhist teaching and had a series of edicts carved on rocks and stone pillars in many places. Delivering a single ideal to distant regions, a publicity effort on this scale was unprecedented for its time.

ruby: きました。しかし、カリンガ
cards.tipJa: 「範囲が及ぶ」「被害が及ぶ」のように、ある限度や領域まで届く意味で使う。
cards.enTarget: In the third century BCE, King Ashoka of the Mauryan dynasty built a great empire extending over almost the whole Indian subcontinent.

words.defJa: 全体を構成する項目とその金額・数

cards.ja: 自分の一日の時間の内訳を、一週間だけ記録してみた人の多くが驚くという。最も多くを占めるのは、仕事でも睡眠でもなく、目的のない細切れの確認作業だったりする。家計の収支と同じように、数字として目の前に出されると、人は「時間がない」という思い込みを改めざるを得ない。見えないものは、改善のしようがないのである。まずは一日分だけでも、手帳に十五分刻みで書き出してみる価値はあるだろう。
cards.en: Many people who record the breakdown of their day for just one week are said to be surprised. What takes up the most time is sometimes neither work nor sleep but aimless, fragmented checking. Just as with a household's income and expenditure, once it is laid out as numbers, people have no choice but to revise the belief that they have no time. What cannot be seen cannot be improved. Even for a single day to start with, it is probably worth trying to write it out in a notebook in fifteen-minute units.

cards.tipJa: 「費用の内訳」「年齢別の内訳」のように、全体の中身を項目別に示すときに使う。
cards.enTarget: Many people who record the breakdown of their day for just one week are said to be surprised.

words.meaning: to accept; to receive; to take in
words.defJa: 相手や事柄を認めて引き受ける

cards.ja: インドの哲学を日本語で語るとき、輪廻や業のような言葉は、最初はナンセンスにすら聞こえ、聞き手が受け入れるまで時間がかかります。そこで私は、まず自分の体験から話し始めます。「信じてください」と迫るかわりに、「こういう見方もある」と、扉を半分だけ開けておくのです。納得は説得からではなく、相手が自分で選んだ瞬間に生まれます。半分開けた扉の向こうへ進むかどうかは、いつでも聞き手の自由である。
cards.en: When speaking about Indian philosophy in Japanese, words like reincarnation and karma may at first sound like nonsense, and it takes time before the listener accepts them. So I begin with my own experience. Instead of pressing "Please believe me," I leave the door half open with "There is this way of seeing it too." Conviction is born not from persuasion but at the moment the other person chooses for themselves. Whether to step through the half-open door is always the listener's own choice.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: むかどうかは、いつでも
cards.tipJa: 「提案を受け入れる」「現実を受け入れる」のように、認めて引き受ける意味。
cards.enTarget: When speaking about Indian philosophy in Japanese, words like reincarnation and karma may at first sound like nonsense, and it takes time before the listener accepts them.

words.meaning: to crack down on; to control
words.defJa: 法や規則に反する行為をおさえる

cards.ja: 一八四一年に始まった天保の改革で、老中の水野忠邦は、庶民の贅沢や華美な風俗を厳しく取り締まった。役者絵をはじめ人情本までが規制の対象となり、芝居小屋も江戸の中心から外れた場所へ移された。しかし、あまりにも細かい禁令は、かえって庶民の反発を招き、改革はわずか二年余りで中断に追い込まれた。娯楽を力で抑えようとして失敗した例として、今もなお繰り返し語られる出来事である。
cards.en: In the Tenpo Reforms that began in 1841, the senior councillor Mizuno Tadakuni strictly cracked down on the luxury and showy customs of commoners. Even actor prints and sentimental novels were subject to regulation, and theaters were moved away from the center of Edo. But prohibitions that were too detailed only provoked the commoners' resistance, and the reforms were forced to a halt in only a little over two years. It is an episode still told again and again as an example of failing to suppress entertainment by force.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: された。しかし、あまりにも
cards.tipJa: 「違反を取り締まる」「風紀を取り締まる」のように、権力が規則違反をおさえる。
cards.enTarget: In the Tenpo Reforms that began in 1841, the senior councillor Mizuno Tadakuni strictly cracked down on the luxury and showy customs of commoners.

words.defJa: これから先の道のり、将来

cards.ja: サンスクリット語の学習は、最初の三か月で挫折する人が多いと言われます。文字も格変化もまったく新しいので、前途は多難に思えて当然です。しかし、バガヴァッド・ギーターの有名な一節を、意味ごと一括で覚えてしまうと、文法が急に「使える知識」へ変わります。難しさを避けるというより、小さな成功体験を早めに作ることが、続ける力を支えるのです。挫折の多くは、才能ではなく、手応えの不足から生まれるからです。
cards.en: Many people are said to give up on learning Sanskrit within the first three months. Both the script and the case endings are completely new, so it is natural that the road ahead looks full of difficulty. But if you memorize a famous passage of the Bhagavad Gita whole, meaning and all, the grammar suddenly turns into usable knowledge. Rather than avoiding difficulty, creating small successes early is what sustains the power to continue. Most giving up comes not from lack of talent but from a lack of felt progress.

cards.enTarget: Both the script and the case endings are completely new, so it is natural that the road ahead looks full of difficulty.

words.defJa: かけた労力に対する成果の割合

cards.ja: 人工知能の訓練には、巨大なデータセンターが必要です。そのため、今の半導体の競争は、計算の速さに限らず、一ワットあたりの効率も問われるようになっています。同じ電力で二倍の仕事ができれば、電気代も冷却の設備も大幅に減らせるからです。性能だけを追う時代は終わり、省エネと両立させる設計力こそが問われているのです。電気を食う計算機のコストは、これからますます経営の重荷になるでしょう。
cards.en: Training artificial intelligence requires enormous data centers. For that reason, today's semiconductor competition is judged not only on computing speed but also on efficiency per watt. If the same power can do twice the work, the electricity bill and the cooling equipment can both be cut substantially. The age of chasing performance alone is over; what is being tested is the design skill to reconcile it with energy saving. The cost of power-hungry computers will become an ever heavier burden on management.

cards.enTarget: For that reason, today's semiconductor competition is judged not only on computing speed but also on efficiency per watt.

words.defJa: 身にしみて強く感じられるさま

cards.ja: 集中力が続かないって悩み、私にとってはけっこう切実な問題なんですよ。スマホを机の外に置くだけで違うって聞いて、半信半疑で試したら、本当に作業が進んだんです。意志の力というより、環境の問題なんでしょうね。もちろん、誘惑を取り除くと、手持ち無沙汰でそわそわする時間も増えましたけど。結局、気合いで頑張るより、先に仕組みで守っておくほうが長続きするんだなと、身をもって実感しています。
cards.en: Not being able to keep my focus is, for me, a pretty pressing problem. I heard that just putting your phone away from your desk makes a difference, tried it half doubting, and the work really did move forward. It is probably a matter of environment rather than willpower. Of course, once I removed the temptation, I also had more idle, fidgety moments. In the end, I feel firsthand that protecting yourself with a system first lasts longer than pushing through on grit.

cards.enTarget: Not being able to keep my focus is, for me, a pretty pressing problem.

words.defJa: どうやっても、とても

cards.ja: 国語辞典の改訂作業は、新しい言葉を拾う作業であると同時に、消えゆく言葉を見送る作業でもある。インターネット上で毎日生まれる造語のすべてを追うことは、編集者の人数では到底不可能だ。そのため各社は、新聞や書籍の用例を収集した上で、収録の可否を判断している。とはいえ、基準を厳密にすればするほど、辞書は現実から遅れていくというジレンマも避けられない。辞書の編集は、地道な線引きの連続である。
cards.en: Revising a dictionary is the work of picking up new words and, at the same time, the work of seeing off words that are disappearing. Keeping up with every neologism born on the internet each day is utterly impossible with the number of editors available. For that reason, each publisher decides whether to include a word after collecting usage examples from newspapers and books. Even so, the stricter the criteria, the further the dictionary falls behind reality, a dilemma that cannot be avoided. Dictionary editing is a succession of patient line-drawing.

cards.enTarget: Keeping up with every neologism born on the internet each day is utterly impossible with the number of editors available.

words.defJa: 相手の過ちを許すこと

cards.ja: 忠臣蔵の発端は、一七〇一年、江戸城の松の廊下で起きた刃傷事件です。赤穂藩主の浅野内匠頭が、儀礼を指導する吉良上野介に斬りつけたと伝えられます。理由は今に至るまで定かではありませんが、「もう勘弁ならない」と思うほどの屈辱があったのだろうと、後世の人は想像してきました。この一瞬の怒りが、一連の物語の出発点になったのです。こうして事件の背景を知ると、芝居や映画の見え方も、ずいぶん変わってきます。
cards.en: The origin of the Chushingura story is the 1701 attack in the Pine Corridor of Edo Castle. Asano Naganori, lord of the Ako domain, is said to have slashed at Kira Yoshinaka, who instructed on court protocol. The reason remains unclear to this day, but later generations have imagined that there must have been a humiliation so great that he thought, "I can no longer let this pass." That moment of anger became the starting point of a whole series of events. Once you know the background of the incident in this way, how plays and films look to you changes considerably.

cards.enTarget: The reason remains unclear to this day, but later generations have imagined that there must have been a humiliation so great that he thought, "I can no longer let this pass."

words.defJa: 化学的に作る繊維の略称

cards.ja: 産業史を覚えるコツは、製品名で覚えるというより、技術のつながりで整理することです。たとえば化繊の企業が、高分子の技術を活かして半導体の材料を手がけるようになった例があります。繊維と半導体は無関係に見えて、実は同じ「薄く均一につくる技術」の延長にあるのです。つながりで覚えれば、一見ばらばらな知識が、試験本番でもすぐ取り出せる形になります。年表にも、技術の系統図を一枚添えておくといいでしょう。
cards.en: The trick to remembering industrial history is to organize it by links between technologies rather than memorizing product names. For example, there are cases of synthetic fiber companies using their polymer technology to move into semiconductor materials. Fibers and semiconductors seem unrelated, but they are in fact extensions of the same technique of making things thin and uniform. If you remember by connections, knowledge that looks scattered at first glance takes a form you can pull out at once on exam day. It is a good idea to attach a family tree of technologies to your timeline as well.

cards.enTarget: For example, there are cases of synthetic fiber companies using their polymer technology to move into semiconductor materials.

words.defJa: 書類に押す、個人や会社の印

cards.ja: とくに不動産の契約書から印鑑が消えるのは、まだ先の話かもしれません。電子署名の技術は整っているものの、「押してこそ本物」という感覚が根強く残っているからです。人工知能が書類を瞬時に読み取り、改ざんを見抜く時代になれば、この感覚も変わりつつあります。ただし、変わるかどうかを決めるのは技術ではなく、人の安心感なのです。朱肉の香りが消えたとき、私たちは何を失い、何を得るのでしょうか。
cards.en: Especially in real estate contracts, the day the personal seal disappears from documents may still be some way off. The technology for electronic signatures is in place, but the feeling that it is genuine only if stamped remains deeply rooted. As we enter an age in which artificial intelligence reads documents instantly and detects tampering, this feeling too is beginning to change. However, what decides whether it changes is not technology but people's sense of security. When the scent of red ink paste disappears, what will we lose, and what will we gain?

cards.tipJa: 「印鑑を押す」「印鑑登録」「実印」の形で、契約や届け出の場面に出てくる。
cards.enTarget: Especially in real estate contracts, the day the personal seal disappears from documents may still be some way off.

words.defJa: 物事がとどこおりなく進むさま

cards.ja: 最先端の半導体は、完成までに数百もの工程を経ると言われます。どれか一つでも中断すれば、後ろに並んだウェハーがすべて足止めを食らいます。そこで工場では、装置同士を結ぶ人工知能が搬送の順番を決め、流れを円滑に保っているのです。米粒より小さな部品の裏側で、とてつもなく地味な段取りの技術が働いています。その地味な努力のおかげで、私たちは新しい機器を、毎年のように手にできるのです。
cards.en: Cutting-edge semiconductors are said to go through several hundred process steps before they are finished. If even one of them stops, every wafer lined up behind it is held up. So in factories, artificial intelligence linking the machines decides the order of transport and keeps the flow smooth. Behind a part smaller than a grain of rice, an enormously unglamorous craft of scheduling is at work. Thanks to this unglamorous effort, we are able to get our hands on new devices year after year.

cards.tipJa: 「円滑に進む」「円滑な運営」「円滑化」の形で、手続きや流れの滞りなさを表す。
cards.enTarget: So in factories, artificial intelligence linking the machines decides the order of transport and keeps the flow smooth.

words.defJa: 細かい点までいいかげんにしないさま

cards.ja: 心理学では、過去の有名な実験が再現できないという一連の問題が、十年ほど前から注目されてきた。原因の一つは、サンプル数が少ないまま、都合のよい結果だけが論文になりやすい点にある。そこで近年は、実験の手順をあらかじめ公開し、他の研究者が参照できる形にする仕組みが広がりつつある。もっとも、「再現できた」と言える基準をどこまで厳密に定めるかについては、研究者の間でも意見が割れている。
cards.en: In psychology, a series of problems in which famous past experiments cannot be reproduced has drawn attention for about ten years. One cause is that results that happen to be convenient tend to become papers while the sample size remains small. So in recent years a system of making the procedure public in advance, in a form other researchers can consult, has been spreading. Still, researchers are divided over how strictly the standard for saying a result was reproduced should be set.

cards.enTarget: Still, researchers are divided over how strictly the standard for saying a result was reproduced should be set.

words.defJa: ひとつだったものが分かれ離れること

cards.ja: アドヴァイタ・ヴェーダーンタを人に話すとき、いちばん難しいのは「分離」という言葉の扱いです。私たちは日常、見る者と見られるものを分けて話さざるを得ません。ところが、この学派は、その分け方こそが無知の産物だと説きます。言葉で分けながら、分けられないものを指すという、一見矛盾する作業ですが、そこが語りの腕の見せどころです。聞き手が首をかしげた瞬間こそ、いちばん丁寧に言葉を選ぶべきところです。
cards.en: When I speak about Advaita Vedanta, the hardest thing is how to handle the word separation. In daily life we have no choice but to speak as if the seer and the seen were divided. Yet this school teaches that this very way of dividing is the product of ignorance. It is a task that looks contradictory at first glance, dividing with words while pointing at what cannot be divided, but that is exactly where a speaker shows skill. The moment the listener tilts their head is exactly where you should choose your words most carefully.

words.defJa: 争いがなく穏やかにまとまるさま

cards.ja: 取引先への断りの言葉は、言い方ひとつで関係が円満に続くか、気まずく終わるかが決まります。「できません」と突き放すかわりに、「今回は見送らせてください」と、次の機会を残す言い方があります。理由は長々と並べず、感謝を先に、お詫びを後に置けば、場のムードも壊れません。断る側に誠意があればこそ、相手も気持ちよく引き下がれるのです。断る勇気が、結果的に長い付き合いを守ることもあるのです。
cards.en: With a refusal to a client, a single choice of words decides whether the relationship continues amicably or ends awkwardly. Instead of pushing them away with "We cannot," there is a way of phrasing that leaves room for next time: "Please let us pass on this one." Do not list reasons at length; put thanks first and apology after, and the mood of the occasion will not be spoiled. It is precisely because the one refusing is sincere that the other can step back gracefully. The courage to refuse can, in the end, protect a long relationship.

cards.enTarget: With a refusal to a client, a single choice of words decides whether the relationship continues amicably or ends awkwardly.

words.defJa: 人や物を一定の場所に入れること

cards.ja: ナーランダ僧院は、数千人の僧と学生を収容できる、巨大な学びのスペースでした。七世紀に訪れた中国の僧、玄奘は、その規模と学問の水準に驚いたと記録しています。寝食を共にしながら論理学や哲学を議論する生活は、現代の大学というより、知の共同体と呼ぶほうが近いでしょう。こう語ると、聞き手の頭の中に、石造りの講堂のざわめきが浮かんでくるはずです。数字だけでなく、人の息づかいを添えるのが、話を生きたものにするコツです。
cards.en: Nalanda monastery was a vast space of learning that could house several thousand monks and students. The Chinese monk Xuanzang, who visited in the seventh century, recorded that he was astonished at its scale and the level of its scholarship. A life of sharing meals and lodging while debating logic and philosophy is closer to a community of knowledge than to a modern university. If you tell it this way, the murmur of a stone lecture hall should rise in the listener's mind. The trick to making a story come alive is to add the breathing of people, not only the numbers.

cards.enTarget: Nalanda monastery was a vast space of learning that could house several thousand monks and students.

words.defJa: 文字ではなく声に出して言うこと

cards.ja: 外国語の口頭試験では、文法の正確さよりも、沈黙をつくらないことのほうが評価に響くことがあります。完璧な文を組み立てようとするあまり、黙り込んでしまう人が多いからです。そこで練習のときは、「えっと」「つまり」といった繋ぎの言葉を意図的に使い、止まらずに話す訓練をしてください。文法が多少ルーズでも、止まらない習慣さえ身につけば、語彙や正確さは後から確実についてきます。
cards.en: In an oral exam in a foreign language, not creating silence can affect the evaluation more than grammatical accuracy. This is because many people fall silent in their effort to construct a perfect sentence. So in practice, deliberately use filler words such as "um" and "that is," and train yourself to speak without stopping. Even if your grammar is somewhat loose, once you acquire the habit of not stopping, vocabulary and accuracy will reliably follow later.

のときは、「えっと」「つまり」といった

cards.enTarget: In an oral exam in a foreign language, not creating silence can affect the evaluation more than grammatical accuracy.

words.meaning: to escape; to be spared; to avoid
words.defJa: 好ましくない事態から逃れる

cards.ja: 人は誰でも、失敗の責任を免れるために、無意識のうちに言い訳を探してしまいます。心理学ではこれを自己防衛と呼びます。ところが、言い訳が上手になるほど、人は同じ過ちを繰り返しかねません。成長したければ、まず一言だけ「自分の判断が悪かった」と口頭で認めてみてください。言い訳が浮かんだらいったん手を止め、起きた事実だけを紙に書き出すという方法も、最初の一歩として有効です。
cards.en: Everyone, without realizing it, looks for excuses in order to escape responsibility for a failure. Psychology calls this self-defense. But the more skilled a person becomes at excuses, the more likely they are to repeat the same mistake. If you want to grow, start by saying aloud just one line: "My judgment was wrong." One effective first step is to pause when an excuse comes to mind and write down on paper only what actually happened.

cards.tipJa: 「責任を免れる」「災難を免れる」など、悪い事態から逃れる意味で使う。
cards.enTarget: Everyone, without realizing it, looks for excuses in order to escape responsibility for a failure.

words.defJa: 傷や事態に手当てや対応をすること

cards.ja: 救急の現場では、診断が確定するのを待たず、即座に処置を始めなければならない場面がある。人工知能が画像から病変を見つけ出す時代になっても、この構図は変わらないだろう。なぜなら、確率が九割と示されたところで、残りの一割を引き受けるのは、結局人間の医師だからである。判断を機械に委ねるにしても、責任までは委ねられないのだ。その責任の重さは、機械の精度が上がるほど、かえって際立ってくる。
cards.en: In emergency care there are situations in which treatment must begin immediately, without waiting for a diagnosis to be confirmed. Even in an age when artificial intelligence finds lesions in images, this structure is unlikely to change. After all, even if a probability of ninety percent is shown, the one who takes on the remaining ten percent is, in the end, the human doctor. Even if we entrust judgment to machines, we cannot entrust responsibility. The weight of that responsibility only stands out more as the machine's accuracy improves.

cards.tipJa: 「応急処置」「適切な処置」など、傷や事態へ手当てをする文脈で使う。
cards.enTarget: In emergency care there are situations in which treatment must begin immediately, without waiting for a diagnosis to be confirmed.

words.defJa: 勢いが最も盛んな状態

cards.ja: かつて電報の全盛期には、文字数が料金に直結したため、人々は一語でも削ろうとした。「ハハキトク」のような片仮名の電文は、その知恵の結晶である。携帯電話の普及に伴って電報はほぼ姿を消したが、削る文化だけは短縮語やスタンプの形で生き延びている。言葉は、道具が変わっても、効率を求める人間の癖までは手放さないらしい。もし当時の人が今の長文のメッセージを見たら、あまりの贅沢さに目を丸くするに違いない。
cards.en: In the heyday of the telegram, the fee was tied directly to the number of characters, so people tried to cut even a single word. Katakana messages such as "Mother critically ill" are the distilled wisdom of that era. As mobile phones spread, the telegram almost vanished, yet the culture of cutting survives in abbreviations and stickers. Even when its tools change, language apparently never gives up the human habit of seeking efficiency. If people of that time saw today's long messages, they would surely open their eyes wide at such extravagance.

ruby: ろうとした。「ハハキトク」のような
cards.tipJa: 「全盛期」「全盛を極める」の形が多い。勢いの頂点を表し、過去を振り返るときによく使う。
cards.enTarget: In the heyday of the telegram, the fee was tied directly to the number of characters, so people tried to cut even a single word.

words.defJa: 人の身体や生命を傷つける害

cards.ja: 人工知能に守らせるべき最低限の約束は、人に危害を加えないことだと、多くの人は考えます。しかし、何をもって害とするのかを言葉で厳密に定義しようとすると、驚くほど難しくなります。包丁の使い方を教えるのは、料理の助けにもなれば、事件の手引きにもなり得るからです。だから開発者は、禁止語を並べるのではなく、文脈を読む力を育てようとしているのです。善意の質問と悪意の質問は、文面だけでは見分けられないことも多いのです。
cards.en: Many people think the minimum promise an artificial intelligence should keep is not to bring harm to humans. But trying to define in words exactly what counts as damage turns out to be surprisingly hard. Teaching how to use a kitchen knife can be a help to cooking, yet it can also be a guide to a crime. That is why developers are trying to cultivate the ability to read context rather than lining up forbidden words. A well-meant question and a malicious one often cannot be told apart from the wording alone.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: てようとしているのです。
cards.tipJa: 「危害を加える」「危害を及ぼす」の形で使い、身体や命への害を表す。
cards.enTarget: Many people think the minimum promise an artificial intelligence should keep is not to bring harm to humans.

words.defJa: すべてが滅びてなくなること

cards.ja: 本番の三分前、準備した原稿が頭の中で全滅したように感じることがあります。そんなとき、アナウンサーはまず息を長く吐き、最初の一文だけを思い出すそうです。一文目さえ出てしまえば、二文目は舌が勝手に運んでくれます。緊張を取り除くというより、緊張したまま話し始めるほうがずっと楽なのです。最初の一文が無事に出れば、客席の視線も、さっきまでより意外なほど温かく感じられてくるものです。
cards.en: Three minutes before going on air, you may feel that the script you prepared has been wiped out of your head. At such moments, announcers reportedly first exhale slowly and recall only the opening sentence. Once the first sentence is out, the tongue carries you through the second on its own. Rather than getting rid of the tension, it is far easier to begin speaking while still tense. Once the first sentence comes out safely, the gaze of the audience starts to feel surprisingly warmer than it did a moment ago.

cards.enTarget: Three minutes before going on air, you may feel that the script you prepared has been wiped out of your head.

words.defJa: 思いやりがなく、そっけないさま

cards.ja: 一七九三年、イギリスの使節マカートニーは、貿易の拡大を求めて清の乾隆帝に謁見しました。しかし返ってきたのは、冷淡きわまる拒絶の返書でした。清にとって、自国は何でも持つ大国であり、外国の要求を受け入れる必要などなかったのです。この態度は、のちのアヘン戦争へとつながる遠因の一つになったと言われます。貿易で相手に頼る必要がないという自信が、この返書の冷たい調子を生んだのでしょう。
cards.en: In 1793, the British envoy Macartney had an audience with the Qianlong Emperor of the Qing to seek an expansion of trade. What came back, however, was a bitterly cold letter of refusal. To the Qing, their country was a great power that lacked nothing, and there was no need to accept foreign demands. This attitude is said to have been one distant cause of the later Opium War. Confidence that China had no need to rely on trade with others probably produced the chilly tone of that letter.
