words.defJa: 遠慮して心を使うこと

cards.ja: インドの寺院に併設された施設では、訪れた人に無料で食事が出されることがある。シク教の寺院グルドワーラーの「ランガル」はその代表で、誰もが同じ床に座り、同じ食事を受け取る。貧しい人が気兼ねなく腹を満たせるように、身分や宗教を問わず開かれていることが理念とされる。運営は信徒の寄付と奉仕に支えられ、旅人にとっても心強い存在だ。ランガルの食卓に並ぶのは、豆のカレーとパンといった素朴な料理である。
cards.en: At facilities attached to temples in India, meals are sometimes served to visitors free of charge. The 'langar' of the Sikh temple gurdwara is the best-known example, where everyone sits on the same floor and receives the same food. It is held as a principle that the langar is open regardless of status or religion so that poor people can fill their stomachs without hesitation. Its operation is supported by believers' donations and service, and it is a reassuring presence for travelers too. What lines the langar table is simple fare such as lentil curry and bread.

words.meaning: to soak in, to sting, to touch deeply
words.defJa: 中まで入り込んで感じられる

cards.ja: 凍える朝だけに、湯気の立つ味噌汁が体にじんわり染みる。この感覚は、舌だけでなく体全体で味わっているから生まれます。心理学では、体の状態が感じ方を変えることを身体化認知と呼びます。寒さや疲れが強いほど、同じ一杯が特別な味になり、どこか懐かしい気持ちさえ呼び起こすのです。ですから、毎日の食事を急いで済ませるのは、人生の小さな楽しみを自分から手放していることになります。
cards.en: Precisely because it is a freezing morning, miso soup soaks into the body. This sensation arises because we taste with the whole body, not just the tongue. In psychology, the way bodily states change how we feel is called embodied cognition. The stronger the cold or fatigue, the more the same bowl becomes a special taste and even stirs a somehow nostalgic feeling. So rushing through daily meals means giving up one of life's small pleasures.

words.defJa: 全体をおおまかに説明すること

cards.ja: AIの入門書は、数式を避けた概説に徹するものと、実装まで踏み込むものに大別される。前者は全体像をつかむのに向くが、読後に何を試せばよいかが見えにくい。後者は手を動かせる反面、途中で挫折する読者も少なくない。自分の志向が地図なのか道具なのかを、先に決めておくに越したことはない。書店の棚の前で数分だけ立ち止まり、目次と第一章を読み比べてみるのも、失敗を減らす有効な方法の一つだろう。
cards.en: Introductory books on AI can be divided broadly into those that stick to an outline avoiding formulas and those that go as far as implementation. The former suit grasping the whole picture, but it is hard to see what to try after reading. The latter let you work with your hands but, on the other hand, not a few readers give up midway. It is best to decide in advance whether your inclination is for a map or a tool. Pausing for a few minutes at a bookstore shelf and comparing the table of contents and first chapter is probably one effective way to reduce failures.

On the other hand, small models have limits in accuracy, so using different ones according to purpose becomes an issue. Investors' interest is shifting from the size of the model to where it runs.

In a field where research and development is so active, one equipment maker markets its ability to control this angle at the nanometer scale. As miniaturization advances, errors in shape that never appear on the drawings are becoming the focus of competition. A small difference in angle can greatly change the value of the final product.

cards.en: India's national motto is 'Satyameva Jayate', meaning 'truth alone triumphs'. This phrase was chosen on the basis of a passage from an ancient scripture and is inscribed beneath the lion capital of Ashoka in the national emblem. It is often explained that, as the independent state was being established, the phrase was chosen under the influence of Gandhi's thought, which valued nonviolence and truth. It is written in Devanagari script and can be seen on coins and official documents.

Starting with a small story of your own failure, like the opening of a rakugo performance, is safe and highly effective. If you accept that laughter is less a goal than a tool for loosening up the room, your mind becomes much lighter and speaking becomes easier.

So I think it's closer to say the shogunate controlled the points of contact than to say they closed the country. A single line in a textbook can be surprisingly rough. Knowing such details changes how history looks quite a lot.

What helps is not memorizing dates but cultivating an eye that sees through to structure. The value of studying history can be said to lie less in knowing the past than in gaining the power to question the present.

cards.en: In medieval Europe, the pope's authority was such that it could even make kings submit. In 1077, the 'Humiliation of Canossa', in which Emperor Henry IV stood in the snow for three days begging forgiveness, is seen as its symbol. Later the balance reversed, and as the kings of each country gained strength, the pope's influence was forced to retreat from the political arena. The Reformation would be the event that settled that wavering. The tug of war between power and faith continued to be one of the great axes running through European history.

Precisely because there is an image, the technical terms that come later stick to it and are more easily fixed in memory. The craft of speaking is the courage to reduce information and the judgment to choose the one point to keep. What listeners can take home is, in the end, not the amount of information but the vividness of the image.

Speaking is also, besides content, a matter of designing the speed according to the other person's understanding. This sense can also be applied to adjusting your speed when you speak Japanese in videos.

A calendar to predict floods and the geometry of re-measuring land arose because the blessing and the menace of water were two sides of one coin. Just gazing at a river's flow, your imagination extends to the beginnings of civilization.

cards.en: Merely writing 'has grace' conjures nothing in the reader's mind, and the praise just passes by. This is because an adjective is a conclusion, not evidence. Before handing readers the conclusion, I want to keep to the order of showing the evidence. When you write down your grandmother's gestures with fond nostalgic feeling, the same principle should be at work.

words.defJa: 道理にかなっていて正しいこと

cards.ja: AIが著作物を学習に使うことは、正当な利用と言えるのか。二〇二三年末、米国の新聞社が生成AIの開発企業を提訴し、利用の是非をめぐって各地で同様の訴訟が相次いだ。企業側は「変形的な利用で、公正な使用にあたる」と主張し、権利者側は「無断の複製で、市場を奪う」と反論している。欧州ではAI規制法が段階的に施行されつつあるが、判断が出るまでには、まだ数年を要する見通しだ。
cards.en: Can an AI's use of copyrighted works for training be called legitimate use? The companies argue that it is 'transformative use and counts as fair use', while rights holders counter that it is 'unauthorized copying that takes away the market'. In Europe an AI regulation law is being put into effect in stages, but it is expected to take several more years before a ruling emerges.

words.defJa: 物事を成り立たせる最も深い所

cards.ja: アドヴァイタ・ヴェーダーンタの根底にあるのは、「あなたはすでにブラフマンである」という一点の主張だ。修行によって何かを獲得するのではなく、本来の姿を覆っている無知を取り除くことが、解脱の中身とされる。この考え方は、成長を志向する近代の常識とは、かなり相性が悪い。それでもなお、誰もが気づかぬうちに自分を何者かに限定している、という指摘には、読むたびに胸を突かれるものがある。
cards.en: At the root of Advaita Vedanta lies a single claim: 'you are already Brahman'. Liberation is said to consist not in acquiring something through practice but in removing the ignorance that covers one's original nature. This way of thinking is a rather poor match for the modern common sense oriented toward growth. Even so, the observation that everyone, without noticing, confines themselves to being something strikes me every time I read it.

cards.enTarget: At the root of Advaita Vedanta lies a single claim: 'you are already Brahman'.

words.defJa: 疑う余地がなくはっきりしている

cards.ja: 「言わなくても分かるはず」という期待ほど、話し手を裏切るものはない。自分にとって明白なことでも、聞き手は別の前提で聞いており、意図は半分も伝わらないことがある。講演の冒頭で結論を一文にして置いておくと、聞き手は迷子にならずに済む。話し方の上手さとは、話術より先に、相手の頭の中を想像する力のことだ。だから大事なことほど、まず結論を先に述べ、理由はそのあとに置くのが基本である。
cards.en: No expectation betrays a speaker like 'surely they'll understand without being told'. Even what is obvious to you is heard by the listener on different assumptions, and sometimes not even half of your intent comes across. If you state your conclusion in one sentence at the start of a talk, listeners don't get lost. Skill in speaking is, before technique, the power to imagine what is in the other person's head. So the more important a matter is, the basic rule is to state the conclusion first and put the reasons after it.

words.meaning: to add, to attach, to accompany
words.defJa: 主なものに付け加える

cards.ja: 贈り物に和歌を添える習慣は、平安の貴族社会で、季節や相手を問わず広く行われた。慕う相手に恋文を届ければ、返歌の巧拙によって教養の深さまで測られ、恋愛は一種の知的な試験でもあった。返歌を誤ろうものなら、たちまち教養を疑われたのだ。歌は単なる飾りではなく、物と心をつなぐ最も短い手紙であった。いまの私たちがメッセージの終わりに絵文字を置く気持ちも、その遠い子孫なのだろう。
cards.en: The custom of adding a waka poem to a gift was widespread in Heian aristocratic society, regardless of season or recipient. If you delivered a love letter to someone you adored, even the depth of your education was measured by the skill of the reply poem, and romance was a kind of intellectual exam. If you so much as botched a reply, your learning was immediately doubted. The poem was no mere decoration but the shortest letter linking object and heart. The feeling with which we now put an emoji at the end of a message is probably its distant descendant.

words.defJa: 会場にいる全員

cards.ja: スピーチの終わりで満場の拍手を受ける人は、最後の一文を決して即興にしない。多くは結びの言葉だけを先に決め、そこから逆算して本文を組み立てている。着地点が決まっていれば、途中で話が脱線しても、戻る場所を見失わないからだ。大勢の前ともなると、緊張で頭より口が先に動くので、結びを暗記しておくことは心強い保険になる。練習するときは、本文よりも先に、最後の三十秒から声に出して始めるといい。
cards.en: People who receive applause from the whole hall at the end of a speech never improvise the last sentence. Many decide only the closing words first and build the body by working backward from there. If the landing point is fixed, then even if the talk strays midway, you never lose the place to return to. In front of a large crowd, the mouth moves ahead of the head from nerves, so memorizing the close is a reassuring insurance. When you practice, it is good to start aloud with the final thirty seconds before the body.

words.defJa: 考え方や程度が大きく偏っているさま

cards.ja: 歴史の教科書は、ときに極端な単純化をしてしまう。たとえば「ルターが宗教改革を始めた」と書けば、一人の僧が一夜で世界を変えたように読める。しかし実際には、印刷術の普及や諸侯の思惑など、複数の条件が重なって運動が広がったのである。偉人の物語は覚えやすい反面、社会の仕組みを見えなくしてしまう。単純な図式の裏にある複雑さを意識するだけでも、歴史を読む目はずいぶん変わってくるはずだ。
cards.en: History textbooks sometimes fall into extreme oversimplification. For example, if it is written that 'Luther began the Reformation', it reads as if a single monk changed the world overnight. In reality, though, the movement spread because several conditions overlapped, such as the spread of printing and the calculations of the princes. Stories of great figures are easy to remember but, on the other hand, hide how society works. Merely being aware of the complexity behind a simple scheme should change the eye with which you read history quite a lot.

words.defJa: その物事が本来盛んな土地

cards.ja: 半導体産業の本場といえば、いまも米国のシリコンバレーだと思われがちです。しかし製造に目を向けると、最先端の回路をつくる工場は台湾に集中してきました。アメリカが設計で強く、台湾が製造で強いという分業が、世界のAIブームを支えているのです。この分業の危うさが表に出たとき、世界経済は新しい様相を見せました。半導体の地図は、国名ではなく工程名で描き直さなければならない時代に入っています。
cards.en: When it comes to the home of the semiconductor industry, people still tend to think of Silicon Valley in the United States. But looking at manufacturing, the factories that make the most advanced circuits have been concentrated in Taiwan. A division of labor, with America strong in design and Taiwan strong in manufacturing, supports the world's AI boom. When the fragility of this division came to the surface, the world economy took on a new aspect. The map of semiconductors has entered an age in which it must be redrawn by process names rather than country names.

words.meaning: to apply, to give, to carry out
words.defJa: 手を加えたり行ったりする

cards.ja: 介護の現場では、専門の職員が昔の写真を使った回想法を施す施設が増えている。写真を前にすると、本人が語り出す場面が増え、表情にも明朗さが戻るという報告がある。もっとも、思い出が苦痛を呼び起こしかねないため、事前の聞き取りは欠かせない。効果を裏づけるには、より大規模な調査が必要とされている。高齢化が進むなか、こうした取り組みの重みは今後いっそう増し、自治体の予算配分にも影響を及ぼすとみられる。
cards.en: More facilities are staffed by specialists who carry out reminiscence therapy using old photographs in nursing care. There are reports that when people face the photos, they begin to speak more and their expressions regain brightness. However, memories can stir up pain, so a prior interview is indispensable. Larger studies are needed to back up the effect. As the population ages, the weight of such efforts is expected to grow further and to affect how local governments allocate budgets.

words.defJa: 勝ち残った者が優勝を争う試合

cards.ja: 決勝を翌日に控えた選手に「早く寝なさい」と言うのは、実は逆効果になりやすいんです。眠らなければと思うほど、脳は覚醒してしまうからです。眠れないからといって、翌日の力が必ず落ちるわけではありません。眠れなくても目を閉じて横になっているだけで、体はある程度回復すると言われています。それを知っているだけでも心強いはずなので、受験の前夜も、静かに休むことを優先してください。
cards.en: Telling a player the day before the final to 'go to bed early' tends in fact to backfire. The more they think they must sleep, the more their brain becomes alert. Just because you can't sleep doesn't mean your strength the next day will necessarily drop. It is said that merely lying down with your eyes closed lets the body recover to some extent even if you can't sleep. Simply knowing that should be reassuring, so on the night before an entrance exam too, put quiet rest first.

words.defJa: 乱れや痛みなどがしずまる

cards.ja: ペストの流行の波が治まる間もなく、数年おきに次の波が戻ってきた。十四世紀半ばのヨーロッパでは、人口の三分の一以上が失われた地域もあったとされ、悲惨な時代が長く続いた。働き手が減ったのをきっかけに農民の賃金が上がり、領主の力が弱まったことも見逃せない。災厄が、結果として中世の身分秩序をゆるめたのです。人々は死を身近に感じるようになり、墓碑の彫刻や祈りの言葉の形までもが変わっていきました。
cards.en: Before a wave of plague had even subsided, the next wave returned, every few years. In mid-fourteenth-century Europe, some regions are said to have lost more than a third of their population, and a wretched age continued for a long time. It cannot be overlooked that, with the fall in workers as a trigger, peasants' wages rose and the lords' power weakened. The catastrophe, as a result, loosened the medieval order of status. People came to feel death close at hand, and even the carving of tombstones and the shape of prayers changed.

words.defJa: ある目的のために設けた建物や設備

cards.ja: インドのナーランダ大学は、五世紀ごろに建てられた仏教の学問施設として知られています。最盛期には玄奘をはじめ、憧れる学僧が世界各地から集まり、論理学や医学まで幅広く学んだと伝えられます。寄宿舎や図書館をそなえていた点が、いまの大学のはしりだと言う研究者もいます。のちに破壊されましたが、遺跡は世界遺産に登録されています。千年以上前の学びの場が、いまも人々の想像力をかき立てるのは不思議なことです。
cards.en: India's Nalanda University is known as a Buddhist center of learning built around the fifth century. At its height, scholar-monks who admired it, including Xuanzang, gathered from around the world and are said to have studied a wide range from logic to medicine. Some researchers say that its dormitories and libraries make it the forerunner of today's university. It was later destroyed, but the ruins are registered as a World Heritage site. It is remarkable that a place of learning from over a thousand years ago still stirs people's imaginations.

words.defJa: 明るくて、隠し事がないこと

cards.ja: 金融機関の説明資料では、手数料の表記を明朗にするよう求める声が強まっている。強制ではないものの、指針に沿って書き直す会社が増えた。この発想は、もとは飲食店や理髪店が料金を壁に貼り出す習慣から広まったものだ。投資信託から保険まで、契約書の分かりやすさを測る物差しになりつつある。利用者にとっては、あとから「聞いていない」と困る場面が減り、企業にとっても信頼を築く近道になると期待されている。
cards.en: In explanatory materials from financial institutions, calls are growing for fees to be stated in a clear, aboveboard way. Though not compulsory, more companies are rewriting their documents in line with guidelines. The idea spread from the custom of restaurants and barbershops posting their prices on the wall. It is becoming a yardstick for the clarity of contracts, from investment trusts to insurance. It is expected that for users there will be fewer occasions of being troubled later by 'nobody told me', and that it will be a shortcut to building trust for companies as well.

cards.enTarget: In explanatory materials from financial institutions, calls are growing for fees to be stated in a clear, aboveboard way.

words.defJa: 目的を果たすための手立て

cards.ja: 外国語の勉強で挫折する人は、意志が弱いどころか、むしろ真面目すぎるあまり方策を変えられない人が多いと私は見ています。たとえば、毎日単語帳を三十分めくるより、好きな動画を字幕つきで十分見るほうが有益な人もいます。大切なのは、自分が楽しんで反復できる入口を見つけることです。続いてしまえば、語彙はあとから勝手についてきます。まずは一週間だけ試して、合わなければ遠慮なく捨てて次を探せばいいのです。
cards.en: I think many people who give up on studying a foreign language are far from weak-willed; rather, they are so earnest that they cannot change their approach. For some, for example, watching a favorite video with subtitles for ten minutes is more beneficial than flipping through a vocabulary book for thirty minutes every day. What matters is finding an entrance you can enjoy and repeat. Once it keeps going, vocabulary follows on its own. Just try one for a week, and if it doesn't suit you, throw it away without hesitation and look for the next.

words.defJa: 植物を育て収穫すること

cards.ja: 農業をAIで変える話を書くとき、栽培という言葉だけ見せても、読者は畑の土しか思い浮かべません。植物工場なら「光と水と空気を数値で管理して野菜を育てる」と一文添えるだけで、画像が一気に具体的になります。専門用語は、定義を置くか、身近な例を添えるかの二択だと考えましょう。読み手に辞書を引かせることなく読み切らせるのが、いい文章の最低条件です。具体例の一行が、長い説明を三行も省いてくれることがある。
cards.en: When you write about changing agriculture with AI, showing only the word cultivation makes readers picture nothing but field soil. For a plant factory, adding a single sentence such as 'vegetables are grown by controlling light, water, and air numerically' makes the image concrete at once. Think of technical terms as a choice of two: place a definition or add a familiar example. Getting readers to finish without having to reach for a dictionary is the minimum condition of good writing. One line of a concrete example can sometimes save three lines of long explanation.

words.defJa: 六本脚の小さな節足動物

cards.ja: 「虫」という漢字は、昆虫に限らず、ヘビやカエル、貝までを指していた。古代中国では、人間や獣、鳥、魚以外の小さな生き物を、おおまかに虫と呼んだのである。森林や水辺に暮らす身近な生き物をひとまとめにする発想は、現代の分類学とはまるで違う世界の見方だった。「腹の虫」や「虫の知らせ」といった表現には、その広い守備範囲の名残がうかがえる。言葉の使い方をたどると、昔の人の自然観まで見えてくる。
cards.en: The kanji for 'mushi' referred not only to insects but also to snakes, frogs, and even shellfish. In ancient China, small creatures other than humans, beasts, birds, and fish were loosely called mushi. The idea of lumping together familiar creatures living in forests and by the water was a view of the world quite unlike modern taxonomy. Expressions such as 'the bug in the belly' and 'a premonition' still show traces of that broad range. Tracing how a word was used reveals even how people of old saw nature.

cards.enTarget: The kanji for 'mushi' referred not only to insects but also to snakes, frogs, and even shellfish.

words.defJa: 予想したとおりに

cards.ja: 試験前日に徹夜で詰め込んだ生徒は、案の定、本番の一問目でいきなり問題文を読み間違えた。睡眠不足は記憶の定着だけでなく、注意力そのものも削る。とはいえ、頭では分かっていても、心細くなると人は手を動かしたくなるものだ。だからこそ、直前の夜は復習を減らし、六時間以上眠る計画を先に立てておきたい。結局のところ、前夜にもっとも望ましい勉強法は、思い切って早く布団に入ることである。
cards.en: The student who crammed through the night before the exam suddenly misread the very first question on the day, just as expected. Lack of sleep eats away not only memory consolidation but attention itself. Even so, though one knows it in the head, when feeling uneasy people want to keep their hands moving. That is exactly why, on the last night, you should reduce review and plan in advance to sleep at least six hours. In the end, the most desirable way to study on the night before is to go to bed early without hesitation.

words.defJa: 法令の効力を実際に生じさせること

cards.ja: 法律の条文には「公布」と「施行」という二つの言葉が並びます。前者は国民に知らせる日、後者は強制力が実際に生じる日で、両者のあいだには数か月の猶予が置かれることが多いです。この違いを知らないと、ニュースの日付を読み違える恐れがあります。試験でも似た漢字語の区別は定番の出題だから、場面とセットで覚えておきましょう。最後に、日付だけは必ず自分の目で原文を確認する習慣をつけましょう。
cards.en: Two words, promulgation and enforcement, appear side by side in the text of a law. The former is the day the public is informed, and the latter is the day the binding force actually takes effect, and a grace period of a few months is often set between the two. If you don't know this difference, you risk misreading the dates in the news. Distinguishing similar kanji words is a staple exam question, so memorize them together with their situations. Finally, get into the habit of checking the dates against the original text with your own eyes.

cards.enTarget: Two words, promulgation and enforcement, appear side by side in the text of a law.

words.defJa: よく晴れた空模様

cards.ja: 晴天の朝は人前でも気持ちよく話せるのに、雨の日は声がこもってしまう。そんな経験をしたことはないだろうか。気圧や湿度の影響もあるが、実際には、気分が呼吸の深さを変えることのほうが大きいと言われる。大事な場面の前には、天気や気分に任せることなく、鼻からゆっくり息を吸う腹式呼吸を三回しておくのが望ましい。それだけで声の通りも、聞き手に与える印象も、ずいぶん違ってくるものだ。
cards.en: On a fine morning you can speak comfortably even in public, yet on a rainy day your voice gets muffled. Haven't you ever had that experience? Air pressure and humidity have an effect, but in practice it is said that mood changing the depth of your breathing matters more. Before an important occasion, rather than leaving it to the weather or your mood, it is desirable to take three abdominal breaths, drawing air in slowly through the nose. That alone makes a considerable difference both to how your voice carries and to the impression you give listeners.

ruby: がこもってしまう。そんな
をしたことはないだろうか。

cards.enTarget: On a fine morning you can speak comfortably even in public, yet on a rainy day your voice gets muffled.

words.defJa: 物事のありさま

cards.ja: ことばの様相って、世代ごとにけっこう変わるじゃないですか。たとえば「全然おいしい」って、昔は先生に直されたのが懐かしいくらい、いまは普通に聞きますよね。実は「全然」の後ろに肯定が来る言い方は、明治の小説にも出てくるらしいんです。変わったというより、もとからあった用法がまた表に出てきただけなんじゃないですかね。ことばって、生き物みたいに、使う人たちしだいで少しずつ姿を変えていくものなんですよね。
cards.en: The aspect of language changes quite a bit with each generation, doesn't it? For example, 'zenzen oishii' used to be corrected by teachers, so much so that I feel nostalgic about it, but now you hear it all the time. Apparently the way of putting an affirmative after 'zenzen' even appears in Meiji novels. I wonder if it's less that it changed than that a usage that was there all along has just come back to the surface. Language, like a living thing, changes its shape little by little depending on the people who use it.

words.defJa: わずかな変化にもすぐ反応する

cards.ja: 江戸の養蚕農家は、気温や湿度の変化にとても敏感だったと言われます。蚕は桑の葉の食べ方で体調を伝えるので、観察を怠ると一晩で全滅しかねません。こうした現場の経験知が、のちの日本の生糸輸出を支えました。学習も同じで、小さな変化に気づく練習を重ねるほど、桑の栽培のように手応えのある判断が育ちます。江戸時代に書かれた農書には、季節や天候ごとの注意点が、驚くほど細かく書き残されています。
cards.en: Silkworm farmers in the Edo period are said to have been very sensitive to changes in temperature and humidity. Silkworms signal their condition by how they eat mulberry leaves, so neglecting observation could wipe them out in a single night. This kind of experience on the ground later supported Japan's raw-silk exports. Learning is the same: the more you practice noticing small changes, the more your judgment grows solid, like the cultivation of mulberry. Agricultural books written in the Edo period record seasonal and weather-specific cautions in surprising detail.

words.defJa: 成し遂げた仕事や成果

cards.ja: 心理学者ダニエル・カーネマンは、二〇〇二年にノーベル経済学賞を受けた。人間の判断が合理的でないことを実験で示した業績が、評価されたのである。共同研究者のエイモス・トベルスキーは、すでに亡くなっていたため、受賞者には含まれなかった。二人が築いた行動経済学は、いまや政策づくりから商品設計に至るまで、幅広い分野で使われている。ただし、実験の再現性をめぐっては、近年議論も起きている。
cards.en: The psychologist Daniel Kahneman received the Nobel Prize in Economics in 2002. His achievement, showing through experiments that human judgment is not rational, was recognized. His collaborator Amos Tversky had already died, so he was not among the recipients. The behavioral economics the two built is now used in a wide range of fields, from policymaking to product design. In recent years, however, debate has also arisen over the reproducibility of such experiments.

words.defJa: 体や心が疲れて力が出ないこと

cards.ja: ナポレオンのロシア遠征って、数字だけ追うと退屈なんですけど、兵士の疲労に目を向けると急に生々しくなるんですよ。一八一二年、補給が尽きた大軍は、真冬の撤退で寒さと飢えに苦しみ、ほとんどが失われました。足を引きずって雪道を歩く兵士の姿を想像できたら、もう年号なんて忘れようがないですよね。歴史の丸暗記は禁物だと言われる理由が、ここにあると思います。数字の裏にある人の体と心の限界まで想像できてこそ、歴史は自分のものになるのです。
cards.en: Napoleon's Russian campaign is boring if you only chase the numbers, but when you look at the soldiers' fatigue it suddenly becomes vivid. In 1812, the army, its supplies exhausted, suffered cold and hunger in the midwinter retreat, and most of it was lost. If you can picture soldiers dragging their feet along snowy roads, you can hardly forget the dates anymore. I think this is the reason people say rote memorization of history is to be avoided. Only when you can imagine the limits of the body and mind behind the numbers does history become your own.

words.defJa: 礼儀にはずれた失礼なこと

cards.ja: 江戸時代の武士には「無礼討ち」と呼ばれる慣習があり、身分の高い者に対する失礼な振る舞いが、その理由とされた。もっとも、実際に斬り捨てるには厳しい取り調べが伴い、むやみに行われたわけではないとされる。それでも、この言葉は、身分秩序を守ることがいかに重く見られていたかを物語っている。町人も武士の前では、一言一句に敏感にならざるを得なかったのである。礼を欠くことへの恐れが、当時の社会の安定を支えていたともいえる。
cards.en: Samurai of the Edo period had a custom called 'cutting down for rudeness', and impolite conduct toward a person of higher rank was given as its reason. Even so, actually striking someone down was accompanied by strict investigation, and it is said not to have been done recklessly. Still, the word tells how heavily the preservation of the status order was regarded. Townspeople, too, had no choice but to be sensitive to every word before a samurai. It may even be said that fear of lacking in courtesy supported the stability of society at the time.

words.defJa: 煙で息苦しい。気づまりで避けたい

cards.ja: インドの本場の修行道場では、師匠の存在を煙たく感じる弟子が必ずいるそうなんですよ。何も言われなくても、自分のごまかしを全部見抜かれている気がして、つい身構えずにはいられないからです。でも、居心地の悪さを避けて離れてしまう人ほど、結局は一番大事なことを学び損ねるんじゃないですか。耳に痛い一言をくれる人こそ、ありがたい存在だと気づくのは、たいてい何年もあとのことですよね。
cards.en: In the home-ground training halls of India, they say there is always a disciple who finds the master's presence awkward to be near. Even when nothing is said, he feels all his pretenses are seen through, and cannot help bracing himself. But isn't it the people who avoid the discomfort and leave who end up missing the most important thing? That the person who gives you the painful word is the one to be grateful for is something you usually notice only years later.

cards.enTarget: In the home-ground training halls of India, they say there is always a disciple who finds the master's presence awkward to be near.

words.defJa: むやみに、度を越して使うこと

cards.ja: 刑法には、公務員が職権をむやみに使って人の権利の行使を妨げる行為を罰する規定があり、「職権濫用罪」と呼ばれている。新聞やテレビでは、常用漢字にない「濫」を避けて「乱用」と書き換えることが多いが、条文では今も「濫」の字が使われる。「濫」には水があふれるという意味があり、限度を超えるニュアンスが強い。公務への信頼という秩序を守るために、この字はあえて残されてきたといえる。法律の言葉を学ぶ人は、字の成り立ちまで意識しておくとよい。
cards.en: The Penal Code has a provision punishing public officials who use their authority recklessly to obstruct others from exercising their rights, and it is called the crime of abuse of official authority. Newspapers and television often avoid the character 濫, which is not a jōyō kanji, and rewrite it as 乱用 with a simpler character, yet statutes still use the original one. The character carries the meaning of water overflowing, and it strongly suggests exceeding limits. It can be said that the character has been deliberately kept in order to protect the order of trust in public service. Those who study legal language would do well to be aware even of how a character is built.

cards.tipJa: 「職権濫用」のように、法律語として使う。「乱用」は新聞用の書き換えで、条文は「濫用」。

words.defJa: ひと言も口をきかないこと

cards.ja: 言語学では、声を出さずに意思を伝える手段も、コミュニケーションの研究対象になる。うなずきや視線、ため息といった声にならないしぐさは、言葉以上に本音を映すことがある。日本の職場では、会議で上司が無言でうなずいただけで、部下がそれを承認と受け取る場面も少なくない。ただし、解釈が食い違えば、後で大きなトラブルに発展しかねない。しぐさに敏感であればあるほど、確認の一言が欠かせないのである。
cards.en: In linguistics, ways of conveying intent without voice also become objects of communication research. Wordless gestures such as nods, glances and sighs can reflect true feelings more than words do. In Japanese workplaces, there are not a few occasions when subordinates take a boss's mere silent nod in a meeting as approval. However, if the interpretations diverge, it could develop into serious trouble later. The more sensitive one is to gestures, the more indispensable a confirming word becomes.

cards.enTarget: In Japanese workplaces, there are not a few occasions when subordinates take a boss's mere silent nod in a meeting as approval.

words.defJa: 手先を使って細かく作ること

cards.ja: 正倉院に伝わる螺鈿の琵琶には、貝の薄片を一枚ずつ切り出して貼る細工が施されている。この琵琶が千三百年近く守り伝えられてきたことは、シルクロードを通じて伝わった文化の証拠として、歴史の授業でもよく取り上げられる。ただし、現物を見ずに写真だけで暗記しても、その繊細さは伝わらない。博物館に足を運び、実物の輝きに触れることが、最も有益な学習法である。写真では伝わらない奥行きがあるからこそ、実物を前にした驚きは長く記憶に残る。
cards.en: The mother-of-pearl lute preserved in the Shosoin bears fine work in which thin shell slivers are cut out and pasted one by one. That this lute has been protected and handed down for nearly thirteen hundred years is often taken up in history classes as evidence of a culture that came through the Silk Road. However, memorizing from photographs alone without seeing the real thing does not convey its delicacy. Going to a museum and touching the brilliance of the real object is the most useful way to learn. Precisely because there is a depth that photographs cannot convey, the astonishment before the real thing stays in memory a long time.

words.defJa: ねばねばして糸を引く性質

cards.ja: 納豆の糸を引く粘りは、日本語の表現にも深く根を下ろしている。「しつこい」「くっついて離れない」といった比喩は、人の執着を語るときにもよく使われる。外国人にとっては、食感のみならず、においも最初の壁になるという。それでも、本場の食べ方を知る人ほど、においより味の奥行きを語りたがる。同じ食べ物でも、土地ごとに好まれる食べ方があり、そこから食文化の違いが見えてくる。
cards.en: The stringy stickiness of natto is deeply rooted in Japanese expressions too. Metaphors such as 'clinging' and 'stuck fast' are often used when speaking of a person's obsession. For foreigners, not only the texture but also the smell is said to be the first wall. Even so, the more people know how to eat it in its home style, the more they like to talk about the depth of flavor rather than the smell. Even for the same food, each region has a preferred way of eating it, and from this the differences in food culture come into view.

words.defJa: 貝の中にできる丸く光る宝石

cards.ja: 「豚に真珠」という慣用句は、価値のわからない者に貴重なものを与えても無駄だという意味である。元は新約聖書の言葉で、日本語に入って以来、少し皮肉を含んで使われてきた。しかし言葉を学ぶ身としては、この句を他人に向けるより、自分の耳の鈍さを省みる鏡にしたいところだ。あの輝きは、貝が異物を包み込み、長い年月をかけて育てたものなのだから。言葉を磨くというのは、そういう地味な営みなのだと思う。
cards.en: The idiom 'pearls before swine' means that giving precious things to those who cannot see their value is a waste. It originates in the New Testament, and since entering Japanese it has been used with a touch of irony. But as someone studying words, I would rather use this phrase as a mirror to reflect on the dullness of my own ear than aim it at others. After all, that luster is something the oyster raised over long years by wrapping around a foreign body. Polishing words, I think, is just such a plain undertaking.

cards.enTarget: The idiom 'pearls before swine' means that giving precious things to those who cannot see their value is a waste.

words.defJa: 商品などの時価。世間の見方

cards.ja: 株や魚に値動きがあるように、言葉の使い方にも世間が決めた相場があります。ビジネスメールでは「お世話になっております」を毎回付けるのが、当たり前になっています。この決まり文句は、意味というより、礼儀の符号のようなものです。外せば失礼になりますし、守りすぎれば文章が単調になってしまいます。世間の基準を知ったうえで、あえて一箇所だけ外してみるとき、文章に初めて書き手の個性が宿るのです。
cards.en: Just as stocks and fish have price movements, the way words are used has a going rate set by society. In business emails it has become standard to attach 'thank you for your continued support' every time. This set phrase is less a matter of meaning than a kind of code for courtesy. Drop it and you are rude, but keep to it too strictly and the writing turns monotonous. Only when, knowing the going rate, you dare to depart from it in one spot does the writer's individuality first dwell in the text.

ruby: があります。ビジネスメールでは「お
cards.tipJa: 「世間の相場」「相場が決まっている」。ここでは価格でなく、世間一般の基準の意味。
cards.sense: 世間一般の基準や見込み
cards.enTarget: Just as stocks and fish have price movements, the way words are used has a going rate set by society.

words.defJa: 人々の幸せな暮らしを守る仕組み

cards.ja: 福祉という考え方が国家の仕事として定着したのは、十九世紀末のドイツが始まりとされる。宰相ビスマルクは、労働者の不満を抑える狙いもあって、社会政策として疾病保険や災害保険、年金の制度を相次いで整えた。つまり、社会保障は優しさだけでなく、政治の計算からも生まれたのである。この歴史を知っておくと、現代の制度改革をめぐる議論も、立体的に見えてくる。制度の名前だけでなく、その背後にある動機まで押さえるのが、学習の要である。
cards.en: The idea of welfare as a task of the state is said to have taken hold beginning in Germany at the end of the nineteenth century. Chancellor Bismarck, partly aiming to dampen workers' discontent, put in place health insurance, accident insurance and pension systems one after another as social policy. In other words, social security was born not only of kindness but also of political calculation. Knowing this history makes today's debates over institutional reform look three-dimensional. The key to learning is to grasp not just the name of a system but the motive behind it.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「社会福祉」「福祉国家」。個人の善意ではなく、制度として暮らしを支える文脈で使う。
cards.enTarget: The idea of welfare as a task of the state is said to have taken hold beginning in Germany at the end of the nineteenth century.

words.defJa: 別の状態や方式に移ること

cards.ja: 日本語の書き言葉は、明治から昭和にかけて、文語から口語へと移行しました。きっかけの一つが、「言文一致運動」です。二葉亭四迷や山田美妙らが、話し言葉に近い文体で小説を書き、読者に新鮮な驚きを与えました。この変化に伴って、教科書や新聞の文章も書き換えられ、口語体が広く普及していったのです。文体が変われば、書き手が読者に向ける姿勢も変わるという点で、この運動は単なる表記の改革ではなかった。
cards.en: Written Japanese shifted from the classical to the colloquial style from the Meiji era into the Showa era. One trigger was the 'genbun itchi movement'. Futabatei Shimei, Yamada Bimyo and others wrote novels in a style close to spoken language and gave readers a fresh surprise. Along with this change, the prose of textbooks and newspapers was rewritten, and the colloquial style spread widely. In that a change of style changes the writer's stance toward the reader, this movement was not mere orthographic reform.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「口語へ移行する」「新制度に移行」。状態や方式が別のものへ切り替わる。
cards.enTarget: Written Japanese shifted from the classical to the colloquial style from the Meiji era into the Showa era.

words.defJa: 物が燃えて熱や光を出すこと

cards.ja: 産業革命は、石炭の燃焼から得た熱を動力に変える技術の進歩に伴って、一気に加速した。蒸気機関の改良によって、工場は水辺を離れ、都市の中に立ち並ぶようになった。その代償として、工場周辺の住民は、煤煙の中での生活を余儀なくされた。長時間労働による労働者の疲労も深刻で、のちの労働法制の出発点となっていく。火を使いこなすことが文明を進めた一方で、その火が新しい苦しみも生んだのである。
cards.en: The Industrial Revolution accelerated all at once as technology advanced to turn heat obtained from the combustion of coal into power. Thanks to improvements in the steam engine, factories left the waterside and came to stand in rows within cities. As the price of this, residents around the factories were forced to live in soot and smoke. The exhaustion of workers from long hours was also serious, and became a starting point of later labor law. Mastering fire advanced civilization, but that same fire also gave birth to new suffering.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「石炭の燃焼」「完全燃焼」。物が酸素と結びついて燃える現象。科学・産業の文脈が多い。
cards.enTarget: The Industrial Revolution accelerated all at once as technology advanced to turn heat obtained from the combustion of coal into power.

words.defJa: 細かいところまで正確なさま

cards.ja: 大航海時代、船乗りたちを悩ませたのは経度の測定だった。緯度は星の高さからわかるが、経度を知るには正確な時刻が必要で、揺れる船上で狂わない時計など、当時は作りようがないと思われていた。この難題を解いたのが、十八世紀の時計職人ジョン・ハリソンである。彼が作った精密な航海用時計は、画期的な発明として、のちに多くの船乗りの命を救うことになった。彼の名は、いまも航海術の歴史の中で大きく語られている。
cards.en: In the Age of Discovery, what troubled sailors was measuring longitude. Latitude can be known from the height of the stars, but knowing longitude requires accurate time, and a clock that would not go wrong on a rocking ship was thought impossible to make at the time. The one who solved this difficulty was the eighteenth-century clockmaker John Harrison. The precise marine clock he made went on, as an epoch-making invention, to save the lives of many sailors. His name is still spoken of at length in the history of navigation.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: ジョン・ハリソンである。
cards.tipJa: 「精密機械」「精密な測定」。細部まで誤差が少ない正確さを表す。
cards.enTarget: The precise marine clock he made went on, as an epoch-making invention, to save the lives of many sailors.

words.defJa: 刃物などを砥石でこすって鋭くする

cards.ja: 包丁を研ぐ職人は、一度に力を入れすぎず、毎日欠かすことなく刃の具合を確かめるという。言葉の感覚も同じで、気に入った一文を書き写して声に出す習慣は、短くても有益である。大切なのは、長時間やることではなく、少しずつでもやめずに続けることだ。切れ味が落ちてからでは、手入れをしても、感覚はすぐには戻らない。日本語の語感も、包丁と同じように、使わずにしまっておくと錆びてしまう。
cards.en: A craftsman who sharpens kitchen knives is said not to apply too much force at once, but to check the state of the blade every day without fail. The sense for language is the same: the habit of copying out a sentence you like and reading it aloud is useful even if short. What matters is not doing it for long hours but continuing without stopping, even little by little. Once the edge has dulled, even if you tend it, the feel does not return quickly. Like a kitchen knife, one's feel for Japanese words rusts if it is put away unused.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: わずにしまっておくと
cards.tipJa: 「包丁を研ぐ」「刀を研ぐ」。刃物を石でこすって鋭くする意味。比喩で感覚や技を磨く意にも広がる。
cards.enTarget: A craftsman who sharpens kitchen knives is said not to apply too much force at once, but to check the state of the blade every day without fail.

words.defJa: 悪意がなく、素直で飾り気がないさま

cards.ja: 幼い子どもの無邪気さを、聖者の境地になぞらえる見方は、インドの思想にも古くから見られる。子どもは自分を飾らず、何にも束縛されずに世界をそのまま受け取るからだ。だが、それは何も知らないという意味ではないだろう。むしろ、知り尽くしたのちに戻ってくる素朴さこそ、アドヴァイタが語る自由に近いと言える。大人が失いやすいのは知識ではなく、この素直に驚く力のほうなのかもしれない。
cards.en: The view that likens a small child's innocence to the state of a sage is seen in Indian thought from long ago. A child does not put on airs, and receives the world as it is, bound by nothing. But that does not mean the child knows nothing. Rather, the simplicity that returns after one has known everything is, one might say, close to the freedom Advaita speaks of. What adults tend to lose may be not knowledge but this ability to be openly astonished.

cards.enTarget: The view that likens a small child's innocence to the state of a sage is seen in Indian thought from long ago.

words.defJa: 生物の体をつくる最小の単位

cards.ja: 人前で話すとき、緊張で細胞のひとつひとつが縮こまるような感覚を覚える人は多い。実際には、緊張すると心拍が上がり、体は戦う準備をしているだけである。この反応を「悪いもの」と受け取らず、「力が出る合図」と言い換えるだけで、話し方は驚くほど変わる。体は意外なほど言葉に敏感で、言葉の選び方が体の状態すら変え得るという事実は、話す仕事にとって大きな救いだ。声の震えさえも、実は準備が整ったことを示す体の合図なのである。
cards.en: When speaking in front of others, many people feel as if each and every cell were shrinking from nervousness. In reality, when you are nervous your heart rate rises and your body is simply preparing to fight. Just by not taking this reaction as 'bad' and rephrasing it as 'a signal that strength is coming', the way you speak changes astonishingly. The fact that the body is surprisingly sensitive to words, and that the choice of words can change even its state, is a great relief for those whose work is speaking. Even a trembling voice is in fact a signal from the body that preparations are complete.

words.defJa: 集団の先に立って引っ張る

cards.ja: 独立運動を率いたガンディーは、一九三〇年、塩に課された税への抗議として、海岸まで二百数十マイルを歩く行進を始めた。参加者は道中で増え続け、非暴力の訴えは世界の注目を集めた。この「塩の行進」を皮切りに、各地で不服従運動が広がっていった。植民地政府の権威を根底から揺さぶる出来事となったのである。歩くという日常の行為そのものを抗議の言葉に変えたところに、この運動の独創性があった。
cards.en: Gandhi, who led the independence movement, began in 1930 a march of more than two hundred miles to the coast in protest against the tax imposed on salt. Participants kept growing along the way, and the nonviolent appeal drew the world's attention. Starting with this 'Salt March', civil disobedience spread across the land. It became an event that shook the authority of the colonial government to its foundations. The originality of this movement lay in turning the everyday act of walking itself into words of protest.

words.defJa: 物事の本当のところ

cards.ja: 一九四五年の終戦直後、旧日本軍の資料の多くが焼却され、戦争の真相を示す記録は失われたとされる。のちに半世紀を経て、国内外の公文書が公開されるにつれ、当時の意思決定の過程が少しずつ明白になってきた。ただし、一枚の資料だけを根拠に断定することは、研究者の間でも慎まれている。事実を積み上げた先にしか、納得できる歴史像は見えてこない。資料の断片を前にして、焦らずに裏付けを待つ態度が研究には欠かせない。
cards.en: Right after the war's end in 1945, many documents of the former Japanese military were burned, and records showing the truth of the war are said to have been lost. After half a century, as official documents at home and abroad were opened, the process of decision-making at the time gradually became clear. However, even among researchers, drawing conclusions from a single document alone is avoided. Only beyond a pile of established facts does a convincing picture of history come into view. Facing fragments of documents, the attitude of waiting for corroboration without rushing is indispensable to research.

words.defJa: 大きな欠点がなく、安全なこと

cards.ja: 歴史の年号を覚えるとき、無難なやり方は語呂合わせに頼ることだ。たとえば「いい国つくろう鎌倉幕府」は、一一九二年という数字を一瞬で思い出させてくれる。とはいえ、近年は幕府の成立を一一八五年とみる説が、教科書にも広く普及しつつある。語呂に頼りすぎず、背景の流れまで理解しておくに越したことはない。試験の直前に、年表を一本の物語として声に出して語り直してみると、記憶は驚くほど定着する。
cards.en: When memorizing historical dates, the safe approach is to rely on mnemonics. For example, 'Ii kuni tsukuro Kamakura bakufu' brings the number 1192 to mind in an instant. That said, in recent years the view that dates the founding of the shogunate to 1185 has been spreading widely, even in textbooks. It is best not to lean on the wordplay too much, and to understand the flow of events behind it as well. Just before an exam, if you retell the chronology aloud as a single story, the memory sticks surprisingly well.

cards.en: The other day I was reading a magazine feature in a hospital waiting room, and the theme was 'the ambiguity of Japanese'. Confusing expressions like 'I will think about it a little' are actually refusals sometimes, aren't they. It also had a piece saying that 'kekkou desu' can sound like either acceptance or refusal. When I told a foreign friend, he took it at face value and apparently waited three days for a reply. Reading between the lines is hard even for those of us who grew up in Japan.

words.defJa: 物事の正しい順序や決まり

cards.ja: 言語学者の間では、敬語の体系を、社会の秩序を映す鏡とみる見方がある。上下関係が明確だった時代には、敬語は身分に応じて厳密に使い分けられた。現代では、その使い分けが崩れつつあるが、新しい形の丁寧さも広く普及している。たとえば、若い世代は、相手との親しさに合わせて語尾を細かく調整している。言葉の乱れを嘆く声は絶えないが、変化の底には、新しい人間関係の形が静かに育っている。
cards.en: Among linguists there is a view that regards the system of honorifics as a mirror reflecting social order. In eras when hierarchy was clear, honorifics were strictly distinguished according to rank. Today that distinction is breaking down, yet new forms of politeness have also spread widely. For example, younger generations finely adjust their sentence endings to their closeness with the other person. Voices lamenting the disorder of language never cease, but beneath the change, new forms of human relationship are quietly growing.

cards.enTarget: Among linguists there is a view that regards the system of honorifics as a mirror reflecting social order.

words.defJa: 身にしみて強く感じること

cards.ja: 最近、生成AIにメールの下書きを頼むようになって、自分の日本語の甘さを痛感してるんですよ。AIの出す文は、確かに整ってはいるものの、どこか温度がないんです。結局、直すべき箇所を見抜くのは人間の仕事で、言葉に敏感でないと、そこすら見えません。便利になったからといって、自分で考える手間は省けないですよね。だからこそ、道具が賢くなるほど、人間の側の読み書きの力が問われるのだと思います。
cards.en: Lately, since I started asking a generative AI to draft my emails, I keenly feel how weak my own Japanese is. The sentences it produces are certainly tidy, but somehow they lack warmth. In the end, spotting what needs fixing is a human job, and unless you are sensitive to words you cannot even see where. Just because things have become convenient does not mean you can skip the trouble of thinking for yourself. That is why I think the smarter the tools get, the more the human side's ability to read and write is put to the test.

cards.ja: インドのスパイスって、ひとつの素材だけだとそんなに派手じゃないんですよ。ところが、ターメリックとクミンとコリアンダーを合わせると、急に「カレーの匂い」になるんです。面白いのは、スパイスの本場だけあって、家ごとに配合の比率が違い、母から娘へ口伝えで受け継がれていることです。味わうたびに、その家の歴史まで舌に染みてくる気がしませんか。スパイスの比率を決めるのは、レシピではなく、舌の記憶なのだとも聞きます。
cards.en: Indian spices, taken alone as a single ingredient, are not all that flashy. But when you combine turmeric, cumin and coriander, suddenly it becomes 'the smell of curry'. What is interesting is that, as befits the home of spices, the proportions differ from house to house and are passed from mother to daughter by word of mouth. Doesn't it feel like the history of the family seeps into your tongue every time you taste? I also hear that what decides the spice proportions is not a recipe but the memory of the tongue.

words.defJa: してはならない物事

cards.ja: スピーチで歴史上の人物を引き合いに出すときは、うろ覚えの年号や逸話は禁物だ。聞き手の中には必ず詳しい人がいて、小さな誤りが話全体の信頼を損ないかねない。それでも、数字を並べすぎては耳が疲れてしまう。具体的な場面を一つだけ選び、短く語るのが、結局は一番届く方策である。原稿を読み上げる代わりに、友人に語りかけるつもりで話せば、記憶違いの危険も、自然と少しずつ減っていく。
cards.en: When citing a historical figure in a speech, half-remembered dates and anecdotes are taboo. There is always someone among the listeners who knows the subject well, and a small error may damage trust in the whole talk. Even so, lining up too many numbers tires the ear. Choosing just one concrete scene and telling it briefly is, in the end, the approach that gets through best. If you speak as though addressing a friend instead of reading out a manuscript, the risk of misremembering naturally decreases bit by bit too.

words.defJa: 筋が通らず、むやみに乱暴なこと

cards.ja: 一四九二年、コロンブスが「西に進めばアジアに着く」と主張したとき、周囲は無茶だと笑ったといいます。地球の大きさを実際より小さく見積もっていたからです。彼の計算の誤りは今では明白ですが、たまたま途中に大陸があったおかげで、結果的に歴史が動きました。危うい賭けが成功した例ばかり語られるのは、失敗した無数の航海が記録に残らなかったからにすぎません。運と呼ぶほかない部分も、確かに混じっているのです。
cards.en: In 1492, when Columbus claimed that 'if you sail west you will reach Asia', those around him reportedly laughed that it was absurd. That was because he had estimated the size of the Earth to be smaller than it really is. The error in his calculation is clear today, but thanks to a continent that happened to lie on the way, history moved as a result. That only the successes of risky gambles get told is merely because the countless failed voyages left no records. Parts of it can only be called luck, and they were surely mixed in.

cards.enTarget: In 1492, when Columbus claimed that 'if you sail west you will reach Asia', those around him reportedly laughed that it was absurd.

words.meaning: to be in a hurry, to be impatient
words.defJa: 思うようにならず気持ちが急ぐ

cards.ja: AIの議事録ツールが普及してから、話し手が焦る場面が減ったという声を聞く。記録は機械が取ってくれるので、言い間違えても後で直せるという安心があるのだ。とはいえ、気持ちが落ち着いたからといって、話が上手くなるわけではない。声の高さと間を意識し、聞き手の顔を見て話すことが、結局は最も望ましい練習である。焦りが消えた分の余裕を、内容を磨くことに回せるかどうかが、上達の分かれ目になる。
cards.en: Since AI minutes-taking tools spread, I hear that moments when speakers panic have decreased. Because a machine takes the record, there is the reassurance that a slip of the tongue can be fixed later. That said, being calmer does not mean one's speaking improves. Paying attention to pitch and pauses and looking at the listener's face remains, in the end, the most desirable practice. Whether you can spend the margin freed from panic on polishing the content is what divides those who improve from those who do not.

words.defJa: 他と違う意見。反対の意見

cards.ja: 心理学の実験では、周囲の全員が同じ誤った答えを選ぶと、本人も異議を唱えにくくなることが知られている。これは、周囲の評価に敏感な人間の性質の表れである。実験室に限らず、会議の場でも、役職の高い人が先に意見を述べると、部下は反対意見を飲み込みがちになる。組織が健全かどうかは、反対意見を口にできる空気があるかで決まる。沈黙が同意を意味するとは限らないという事実を、管理者は忘れてはならない。
cards.en: In psychology experiments, it is known that when everyone around picks the same wrong answer, the subject too finds it hard to voice an objection. This is a manifestation of the human trait of being sensitive to others' evaluation. Not only in the laboratory but in meetings too, when a high-ranking person speaks first, subordinates tend to swallow their opposing views. Whether an organization is healthy is decided by whether there is an atmosphere in which dissent can be voiced. Managers must not forget that silence does not necessarily mean consent.

cards.tipJa: 「異議を唱える」「異議なし」。決定や意見に対する反対の表明。
cards.enTarget: In psychology experiments, it is known that when everyone around picks the same wrong answer, the subject too finds it hard to voice an objection.

words.defJa: つり合っていてふさわしいこと

cards.ja: AIに仕事を任せるときは、それぞれの力量に相応の役割を与えることが肝心です。新人にいきなり大規模なシステム改修を頼まないのと同じで、モデルにも段階を踏ませるべきでしょう。まず小さな作業を任せて、精度を確かめてからでないと、範囲を広げてはいけません。焦って全部を預けてしまえば、トラブルが起きたときに誰も原因を追えなくなります。安全に任せるための方策は、結局、小さく始めて確かめることに尽きます。
cards.en: When entrusting work to AI, the key is to give each a role suited to its capability. Just as you would not suddenly ask a new hire to overhaul a large system, a model too should be made to go step by step. You must not widen the scope until you have first handed over a small task and checked its accuracy. If you rush and hand everything over, no one will be able to trace the cause when trouble occurs. In the end, the way to delegate safely comes down to starting small and checking.

words.defJa: 清らかで、おかしがたいこと

cards.ja: 日本では、神社の境内に入る際、鳥居の前で一礼する作法が広く知られている。この動作は、そこから先が神聖な領域であることを、言葉を使わずに示すものだ。「神域」「聖域」といった語も、同じ感覚から生まれた。年齢や立場を問わず、多くの人が、特に意味を説明されないままこの作法を守ってきた。言葉と作法が互いに支え合い、目には見えない場の秩序を、長い時間をかけて形づくってきたといえる。
cards.en: In Japan, the custom of bowing once before the torii when entering a shrine precinct is widely known. This gesture shows, without words, that what lies beyond is a sacred realm. Words like 'divine precinct' and 'sanctuary' were also born from the same feeling. Regardless of age or standing, many people have kept to this custom without being explained its meaning. It can be said that words and customs have supported each other and, over a long time, shaped the unseen order of the place.

words.defJa: 人より優れた得意な技術や芸

cards.ja: 人間の特技は、機械に任せてよい仕事のかげに隠れているのかもしれない。たとえば、翻訳の精密さなら、AIはすでに人間に迫っている。しかし、その文章を誰にどう届けるかという判断は、AIといえども、なお人の領分である。得意なことを生かす努力は大切だが、何を手放すかを見極める力もまた、一つの才能と呼べるだろう。機械が得意な仕事をどこまで任せるかという線引きは、これからの働き方を左右する。
cards.en: A human's special talent may be hiding in the shadow of the work we can safely leave to machines. For instance, in the precision of translation, AI has already come close to humans. But the judgment of whom to deliver a text to and how remains, even for AI, the realm of people. The effort to make use of what one is good at matters, but the ability to discern what to let go of may also be called a kind of talent. Where to draw the line on how much of what machines do well to hand over will shape how we work from now on.

words.defJa: 自分の行いをふり返って考える

cards.ja: 歴史を学ぶ意味は、過去を省みて、同じ過ちを避けることにあると言われます。ところが現実には、成功体験ばかりが語り継がれ、失敗は都合よく忘れられがちです。第一次世界大戦のあと、各国は悲惨さを痛感して国際連盟をつくりました。それにもかかわらず、わずか二十年ほどで、再び世界は戦争へと向かったのです。失敗の記録こそが、後の世代にとって最も確かな教科書になるのだと、私は思います。
cards.en: The point of studying history is said to be reflecting on the past and avoiding the same mistakes. In reality, however, only success stories get handed down, and failures tend to be conveniently forgotten. After the First World War, the nations keenly felt its misery and created the League of Nations. Nevertheless, in only some twenty years, the world headed toward war again. I believe it is precisely the records of failure that become the most reliable textbook for later generations.

words.defJa: 細かいところまで行き届くさま

cards.ja: 介護の現場でAIを使う試みが広がっているが、細やかな心配りまで機械に任せるのは難しい。たとえば、利用者の表情のわずかな変化を見抜く力は、経験を積んだ職員のほうが勝る。とはいえ、記録の作成や見守りの一部を機械が担えば、職員が人と向き合う時間は増える。技術の導入は、福祉の質を落とさないために、現場の声に基づいて進めるべきだ。機械が苦手とする部分を人が補う設計こそ、現実的な落としどころだろう。
cards.en: Attempts to use AI in nursing care are spreading, but it is difficult to leave even attentive consideration to machines. For example, the ability to catch slight changes in a user's expression is better in experienced staff. That said, if machines take on part of record-keeping and watching over, the time staff can spend facing people increases. Introducing technology should proceed on the basis of voices from the field, so as not to lower the quality of welfare. A design in which people cover what machines are poor at is probably the realistic landing point.

words.defJa: 悪いことではと疑う気持ち

cards.ja: 一七八五年に起きた「首飾り事件」は、フランス王妃マリー・アントワネットをめぐる疑惑として広まった。実際には、詐欺師の一味が王妃の名を騙っていたにすぎなかった。しかし民衆は、贅沢な宮廷への不満を背景に、この噂を真実と受け取った。真相が明らかになったのちも、王妃への不信は消えることがなかった。こうして、事実とは別のところで、一つの噂が王朝の信用を静かに、しかし確実に削っていった。
cards.en: The 'Affair of the Necklace' of 1785 spread as suspicion surrounding Queen Marie Antoinette of France. In reality, a gang of swindlers had merely been using the queen's name. But the people, against a background of discontent with the extravagant court, took this rumor as truth. Even after the truth came to light, distrust of the queen never disappeared. In this way, apart from the facts, a single rumor quietly but surely eroded the dynasty's credibility.

words.defJa: 組織や会が活動を始めること

cards.ja: 新年に立てた目標が三日で崩れる理由は、意志の弱さではなく、仕組みの欠如にほかならない。習慣という小さな組織は、発足の時点で規則と報酬を整えておかなければ、すぐに空中分解してしまう。たとえば「毎朝五分だけ机に向かう」という決まりは、続けるうちに自分を根底から支える土台となる。始めることの重みを軽んじてはならない。三日坊主を嘆く前に、まず仕組みを疑ってみるべきである。
cards.en: The reason a goal set at New Year collapses in three days is not weakness of will but, precisely, the lack of a mechanism. A small organization called a habit will fall apart at once unless its rules and rewards are set up at its inauguration. For example, the rule of 'sitting at the desk for just five minutes every morning' becomes, as you continue, a foundation that supports you from the ground up. The weight of beginning must not be made light of. Before lamenting being a three-day quitter, one should first doubt the mechanism.

words.defJa: 美しく着飾ること

cards.ja: 式典ともなると、盛装した人々の間で、普段とは違う人格が顔を出す気がする。装いが振る舞いを変えるのだとすれば、AIにも「衣装」を着せることは可能だろうか。実際、言語モデルは指示の口調に意外なほど敏感で、丁寧に頼むか命令するかで、出力の傾向が変わることがある。外見が心をつくり、心が言葉をつくる。その連鎖は、人間にもAIにも、そして言葉を使うあらゆる存在にも当てはまるのかもしれない。
cards.en: At a ceremony, among people in formal dress, a personality different from the usual seems to come out. If clothing changes behavior, could we put a 'costume' on an AI as well? In fact, language models are surprisingly sensitive to the tone of instructions, and the tendency of their output can change depending on whether one asks politely or commands. Appearance shapes the mind, and the mind shapes words. That chain may hold true for humans, for AI, and for every being that uses words.

words.defJa: すき間などから外へ出てしまう

cards.ja: 外国語を学ぶとき、頭に入れた知識は意外なほどするりと漏れるものです。昨日覚えた単語が今朝には出てこない、という経験は誰にでもあるでしょう。ところが、本場の人と実際に話して使った単語は、なかなか記憶から抜け落ちません。覚えるそばから忘れると嘆くより、使う場面を先につくるほうが近道なのです。いわば、記憶という器に穴を空けないための工夫であり、勉強というより、日々の暮らしに言葉を溶かし込むことに近いのです。
cards.en: When you study a foreign language, the knowledge you take in surprisingly often slips right out. Everyone has had the experience of being unable to recall this morning a word learned yesterday. Yet words you have actually used in conversation with native speakers rarely fall out of memory. Rather than lamenting that you forget the moment you learn, it is quicker to create occasions for using words first. It is, so to speak, a way of not punching holes in the vessel of memory, and it is closer to dissolving words into daily life than to studying.

words.defJa: 時間や長さを短くすること

cards.ja: 勉強の時間を短縮したいと考える人は多いですが、本当に縮められるのは、迷いの時間のほうです。何を、どの順番で、どこまでやるかを先に決めておくのが望ましく、そうすれば机に向かってから悩むことなく、すぐ手が動きます。反対に、計画のないまま始めると、一日じゅう机に座っていても、成果は思うほど積み上がりません。時間の長さより、集中の質が問われるのです。新しい知識を既存の理解に結びつけて、無理なく記憶に移行させる工夫も欠かせません。
cards.en: Many people want to shorten their study time, but what you can truly cut is the time spent hesitating. It is desirable to decide first what to do, in what order, and how far, and then you can start moving your hand at once without agonizing after sitting down. Conversely, if you begin without a plan, even sitting at the desk all day does not pile up results as much as you expect. What is tested is the quality of concentration, not the length of time. It is also essential to tie new knowledge to existing understanding and move it into memory without strain.

words.defJa: 新しい時代を開くほど目新しいさま

cards.ja: 消費電力を大幅に減らす新しい半導体の設計が、画期的だと評価されている。鍵になったのは、回路を積み重ねて、信号が移動する距離を縮める手法である。精密な加工技術を持つ大手のみならず、設計に特化した新興企業も開発に加わった。実用化に至るまでには、なお多くの課題が残されている。ただ、実際の性能が確かめられるのは量産が始まってからで、現時点では期待と慎重な見方が交錯している。
cards.en: A new semiconductor design that sharply cuts power consumption is being praised as epoch-making. The key was a technique of stacking circuits to shorten the distance signals travel. Not only large firms with precise fabrication know-how but also startups specializing in design have joined the development. Before it reaches practical use, many challenges still remain. Still, real performance can be confirmed only once mass production begins, and for now expectation and caution are intermingled.

cards.enTarget: A new semiconductor design that sharply cuts power consumption is being praised as epoch-making.

words.defJa: はっきりせず、とらえどころがないさま

cards.ja: 言葉にできない思いは、たいてい漠然とした不安の形でまず現れる。それを「不安」の一語で片づけてしまえば、輪郭はかえって見えなくなるだろう。母語であれ外国語であれ、適切な語を探す作業は、自分の内側を精密に測る行為にほかならない。名づけるとは、どこまでも広がって見える霧の中に、たった一本でも線を引くことである。線が引かれて初めて、人は不安の正体と向き合い、そこからようやく次の一歩を考えられるようになる。
cards.en: Thoughts we cannot put into words usually first appear in the form of a vague unease. If we dispose of it with the single word 'anxiety', its outline will only become harder to see. Be it in a native or a foreign language, the work of searching for the right word is nothing other than measuring one's own inner self with precision. To name something is to draw even a single line in a fog that seems to spread without end. Only once the line is drawn can a person face the true nature of the unease and, from there, finally think about the next step.

words.meaning: to make use of; to keep alive
words.defJa: 持ち味や能力を十分に役立てる

cards.ja: ことわざを使いこなせると、日本語はぐっと豊かになります。ただし、覚えた表現を生かすには、場面に応じて少し形を変える柔軟さも必要です。たとえば「猿も木から落ちる」は、失敗した本人にではなく、慰める側が使うのが自然でしょう。言葉は素材のようなもので、料理と同じく、使い手の腕しだいで味が変わるのです。辞書の例文を暗記するだけでなく、自分の言葉で言い換えて初めて、表現は身についたといえます。
cards.en: If you can use proverbs fluently, your Japanese becomes much richer. However, to make use of the expressions you have memorized, you also need the flexibility to change their form a little to suit the occasion. For example, 'even monkeys fall from trees' is natural for the consoling side to say, not to the person who failed. Words are like ingredients, and as in cooking, the flavor changes with the skill of the user. Only when you not merely memorize the dictionary's example sentences but paraphrase them in your own words can an expression be said to be yours.

cards.enTarget: However, to make use of the expressions you have memorized, you also need the flexibility to change their form a little to suit the occasion.

words.defJa: 魚をとるために海へ出る船

cards.ja: 半導体とAIの話をするとき、私は決まって一艘の漁船を思い浮かべます。海に出た船は、獲物の群れを探す一方で、燃料と時間を天秤にかけ続けています。AIの学習も同じで、データという広い海のどこに網を入れるかによって、成果が大きく変わるんです。しかも計算資源には限りがありますから、闇雲に網を広げても、燃料を無駄にするだけでしょう。だからこそ、最初の見立てが何より大事になります。
cards.en: When I talk about semiconductors and AI, I always picture a single fishing boat. A ship out at sea searches for a school of prey while constantly weighing fuel against time. AI training is the same: where you cast your net in the vast sea of data changes the results enormously. And since computing resources are limited, spreading the net blindly would only waste fuel. That is exactly why the first judgment matters most.

words.defJa: 間違いないと固く信じること

cards.ja: ブッダは苦行の末に、断食では悟りに至れないと確信したと伝えられています。その後、スジャータという娘から乳粥を受け取り、体力を取り戻して菩提樹の下に座りました。極端な苦しみも、極端な快楽も、真理には届かない。この「中道」の考えは、のちに仏教の根底を支える教えとなります。この体験談は、頭で考えた結論より、身体で試して得た確かな実感のほうが、はるかに人を動かすことを教えてくれます。
cards.en: The Buddha is said to have become convinced, after ascetic practices, that one cannot reach enlightenment through fasting. After that he received milk-rice from a girl named Sujata, regained his strength, and sat beneath the bodhi tree. Neither extreme suffering nor extreme pleasure reaches the truth. This idea of the 'Middle Way' later became the teaching that supports the foundation of Buddhism. This account teaches that a firm sensation gained by trying with the body moves a person far more than a conclusion reached by thought.

cards.enTarget: The Buddha is said to have become convinced, after ascetic practices, that one cannot reach enlightenment through fasting.

words.defJa: よく似ていて見分けにくい

cards.ja: 機械学習の入門者を悩ませるのは、「学習」という語が紛らわしい点だ。人間が勉強する「学習」と、モデルが数値を調整する「学習」は、似ているようで中身がまったく違う。前者は理解や納得を伴うが、後者は誤差を減らす計算にすぎない。両者の違いを明白にしておくだけで、AIの限界と可能性がずっと見えやすくなる。用語の一つひとつに丁寧に線を引きながら学べば、入門書の難しさも半分に減るはずだ。
cards.en: What troubles beginners in machine learning is that the word 'learning' is confusing. The 'learning' in which humans study and the 'learning' in which a model adjusts numbers look alike but are entirely different in substance. The former involves understanding and conviction, while the latter is merely a calculation that reduces error. Just making the difference between the two clear makes the limits and possibilities of AI much easier to see. If you learn while carefully drawing a line around each term, the difficulty of an introductory book should be cut in half.

cards.enTarget: What troubles beginners in machine learning is that the word 'learning' is confusing.

words.defJa: 狩りや漁でとらえた動物や魚

cards.ja: ジャータカと呼ばれる仏教説話には、飢えた虎の親子に自分の身を差し出す王子の話があります。虎は獲物を狩る力すら残っておらず、子を前に倒れかけていました。王子は迷わず崖から身を投じ、その体で虎たちを生かします。仏教では、これを究極の布施として語り、与えることの本質を教えているのです。自分の命への執着という束縛から自由になったとき、人は初めて他者のために動けるのだと、この話は語りかけます。
cards.en: In Buddhist tales called the Jataka, there is the story of a prince who offers his own body to a starving tigress and her cubs. The tiger no longer had even the strength to hunt prey and was on the verge of collapsing before her young. Without hesitation the prince threw himself off a cliff, and kept the tigers alive with his body. Buddhism tells this as the ultimate act of giving, and teaches the essence of giving through it. This tale speaks to us: only when freed from the bondage of clinging to one's own life can a person truly act for others.

cards.enTarget: The tiger no longer had even the strength to hunt prey and was on the verge of collapsing before her young.

words.defJa: ゆとりがなく、息がつまるさま

cards.ja: 在宅勤務が定着して数年、かえって窮屈さを感じるという会社員が増えている。通勤がなくなった反面、仕事と生活の境目があいまいになり、常に見張られているかのような感覚が生まれるためだ。画面越しの会議が続くと、対面より疲れやすいという声も多い。専門家は、休憩の時間をあらかじめ予定に組み込むなどの方策を勧めている。働き方の自由が広がるほど、自分で自分に境界線を引く力が必要になるという皮肉な現実がある。
cards.en: Several years after working from home became established, a growing number of office workers say they feel cramped instead. While commuting has gone, the boundary between work and life has blurred, producing a sense as if one were always being watched. Many also say that continuous video meetings tire them more than meeting face to face. Experts recommend measures such as building rest breaks into the schedule in advance. There is the ironic reality that the more freedom in how we work expands, the more we need the power to draw our own boundaries.

cards.enTarget: Several years after working from home became established, a growing number of office workers say they feel cramped instead.

words.defJa: 念入りに考えて内容を整えること

cards.ja: 世界史の論述では、カンナエの戦いがよく題材になる。紀元前二一六年、ハンニバルは数で勝るローマ軍を、陣形の中央をわざと後退させて引き込み、最後は騎兵が背後に回って包囲し、壊滅させた。この勝利は、地形を見極め、敵の動きを読んで作戦を練った成果にほかならない。受験生も、年号を暗記するだけでなく、なぜその陣形が機能したのかを自分の言葉で説明できるようにしておくに越したことはない。
cards.en: The Battle of Cannae is often the subject of essay questions in world history. In 216 BC, Hannibal drew in the numerically superior Roman army by deliberately pulling back the center of his formation, and in the end his cavalry circled behind to encircle and destroy it. This victory is nothing other than the result of working out a plan by sizing up the terrain and reading the enemy's moves. Exam candidates, too, are best off not merely memorizing dates but being able to explain in their own words why that formation worked.

words.defJa: 勢いや力が弱まること

cards.ja: 年をとると記憶力の衰えが避けられないという通念は、半分しか正しくない。新しい情報を素早く処理する力は下がるが、経験を結びつけて判断する力は、むしろ長く保たれるとされる。若い脳は処理速度に、成熟した脳は知識の蓄積に強みがある、と言い換えてもよい。だから学習法も、年齢に応じて変えていくのがよい。六十代から楽器や語学を始める人がいるのも、この強みを生かしているからだろう。
cards.en: The common belief that memory inevitably declines with age is only half right. The power to process new information quickly falls, but the power to link experience and judge is said to be kept longer, if anything. One could rephrase this as a young brain having its strength in processing speed and a mature brain in accumulated knowledge. So it is good to change study methods according to age as well. That some people take up an instrument or a language in their sixties is probably because they are making use of this strength.

words.defJa: 先の見通しや可能性

cards.ja: 中国の科挙は、隋の時代に始まり、一九〇五年に廃止されるまで千年以上続いた官吏登用試験である。受験者は幼いころから儒教の規範を記した四書五経を暗記し、何十年も挑み続ける人も珍しくなかった。合格の見込みが薄いと知りながらも受け続けたのは、及第すれば一族の地位まで変わったからだ。今日の受験生の苦労も、こうした長い歴史の延長線上にあるのかと思うと、少し不思議な気持ちになる。
cards.en: China's imperial examination was an official-recruitment exam that began in the Sui period and lasted over a thousand years until its abolition in 1905. Candidates memorized from childhood the Four Books and Five Classics, which set out Confucian norms, and it was not rare for people to keep challenging it for decades. They kept sitting it even knowing the prospect of passing was slim, because passing would change the standing of their entire clan. Thinking that the struggles of today's examinees lie on the extension of such a long history, I feel a slightly strange sensation.

cards.sense: 先の見通しや可能性
cards.enTarget: They kept sitting it even knowing the prospect of passing was slim, because passing would change the standing of their entire clan.

words.meaning: to get entangled; to be involved
words.defJa: 複雑に関わり合う

cards.ja: 歴史の授業って、年号を暗記するだけの科目だと思ってたんですよ。でも大人になって読み返すと、戦争の背後にはお金も宗教も家同士の結婚も、全部絡んでるじゃないですか。三十年戦争なんて、もとは信仰をめぐる争いだったのに、最後はカトリックのフランスが新教側について参戦する始末です。ちょっと待ってよ、と教科書にツッコみたくなりますよね。歴史って、実は人間関係の巨大なドラマなんだと気づいてから、読むのが楽しくなりました。
cards.en: I used to think history class was just a subject of memorizing dates. But when I reread it as an adult, behind a war, money, religion and marriages between families are all tangled up together, aren't they? The Thirty Years' War, for one, began as a dispute over faith, yet in the end Catholic France ended up joining on the Protestant side. You can't help wanting to say, wait a minute, to the textbook. Since realizing that history is actually one enormous drama of human relations, reading it has become fun.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

にツッコみたくなりますよね。
cards.tipJa: 「事情が絡む」「利害が絡み合う」など、物事が複雑に結びつく場面で使う。
cards.sense: 複雑に関わり合う
cards.enTarget: But when I reread it as an adult, behind a war, money, religion and marriages between families are all tangled up together, aren't they?

words.defJa: 現地に出向いて実情を見ること

cards.ja: 現地視察は、本で学んだ知識が現実とどれほど違うかを身をもって教えてくれる。インドの農村を訪れた研究者が、書物の上では単純に見えた灌漑の仕組みが、村ごとの慣習と複雑に絡み合っていることに気づくのは珍しくない。机上の学習だけでは、そうした細部は見えず、限界を痛感する研究者も多い。だからこそ、現場に足を運び、人々の話にじっくり耳を傾けた上で学び直す姿勢が、理解を一段と深める。
cards.en: A field inspection teaches how different the knowledge learned from books is from reality. It is not unusual for researchers visiting Indian villages to notice that an irrigation system that looked simple on paper is intricately entwined with each village's customs. Desk learning alone does not show such details, and many researchers keenly feel its limits. That is exactly why an attitude of relearning after visiting the site and listening carefully to people deepens understanding a step further.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「現地を視察する／視察団」。実情を確かめるために現場へ出向く、公的・業務的な語。
cards.enTarget: A field inspection teaches how different the knowledge learned from books is from reality.

words.defJa: 単細胞で核を持たない微小な生物

cards.ja: 半導体の工場では、人間の髪の毛より小さな埃ですら製品の敵になる。入口には空気のシャワーが設置されており、作業員は全身を覆う服を着たうえで通り抜けなければならない。目的は細菌や微粒子を持ち込まないことで、たった一粒の侵入が高価なウェハーを台無しにしかねないからだ。清潔さへのこの執着が、微細化の時代を足元で支えている。洗って済む話ではなく、空気の流れそのものが設計の対象になる。
cards.en: In a semiconductor fab, even dust smaller than a human hair can become a product's enemy. Air showers are installed at the entrance, and workers must pass through them after putting on full-body suits. The aim is to keep out bacteria and fine particles, since a single intruding grain could ruin an expensive wafer. This obsession with cleanliness quietly supports the age of miniaturization. It is not something washing alone can settle; the very flow of air becomes an object of design.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: しにしかねないからだ。
cards.tipJa: 「細菌や微粒子を持ち込む」のように、衛生管理の文脈で使う科学語。
cards.enTarget: The aim is to keep out bacteria and fine particles, since a single intruding grain could ruin an expensive wafer.

words.defJa: 複数のものを一つにまとめること

cards.ja: 琉球諸語は、ユネスコが消滅の危機にある言語として記載している。島ごとに音も語彙も異なるため、一つの標準形に統合することは現実的ではないとされる。むしろ各地の話者を記録に残し、次の世代へ伝える取り組みが急がれている。とはいえ、日常で使う人が減り続ける限り、記録だけでは言葉は生き延びられない。実際、島の古老の語りを録音して辞書にまとめる作業は、すでに各地で始まっている。
cards.en: UNESCO lists the Ryukyuan languages as languages in danger of disappearing. Because sounds and vocabulary differ from island to island, unifying them into a single standard form is said to be unrealistic. Rather, efforts to record speakers in each region and pass the languages to the next generation are urgent. That said, as long as the number of people who use them every day keeps falling, records alone cannot keep a language alive. In fact, work to record the tales of island elders and compile them into dictionaries has already begun in various places.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: ではないとされる。むしろ
cards.tipJa: 「統合する／システム統合／企業統合」など、別々のものを一つにする意味で幅広く使う。
cards.enTarget: Because sounds and vocabulary differ from island to island, unifying them into a single standard form is said to be unrealistic.

words.defJa: 色の組み合わせや色合い

cards.ja: 画像生成AIの普及に伴って、作品の色彩が似通ってきたと指摘する声がある。大量の画像で学習した結果、平均的で無難な配色に収束しやすいからだ。個人の画家が長年かけて築いた独特の配色は、数値の海の中で薄まりやすい。技術が進歩するほど、あえて外れた色を選ぶ人間の判断が、かえって価値を持つようになるだろう。とはいえ、AIの出した配色を出発点に、人間が磨き上げる使い方も広がりつつある。
cards.en: Some point out that works have come to look alike in color as image-generating AI has spread. Having learned from huge numbers of images, models tend to converge on average, safe color schemes. The distinctive palette an individual painter built over many years is easily diluted in a sea of numbers. The more technology advances, the more a human judgment to choose a deliberately off-center color will paradoxically come to hold value. That said, ways of using it in which humans refine a color scheme the AI produced as a starting point are also spreading.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: つようになるだろう。とはいえ、AIの
cards.tipJa: 「色彩豊かな／色彩感覚」。色の使い方・調子を全体として見る、やや硬い語。
cards.enTarget: Some point out that works have come to look alike in color as image-generating AI has spread.

words.meaning: to amuse oneself, to indulge in
words.defJa: 夢中になって楽しむ

cards.ja: 平安の貴族たちは、歌合や貝合といった遊びに興じることを、教養の一部と考えていた。勝ち負けを競いながらも、その場の風雅を損なわないことが何より大切だったという。遊びが政治や恋愛と地続きだった社会では、座興の出来が人物の評価にまで響いた。娯楽と教養の境が薄かったからこそ、彼らの遊びには今も人を引きつける華やかさがある。勝敗に執着しすぎる者は、むしろ野暮として敬遠されたという。
cards.en: The Heian nobles regarded indulging in pastimes such as poem contests and shell-matching games as part of their cultivation. Even while competing for victory, they are said to have valued above all not spoiling the elegance of the occasion. In a society where play was continuous with politics and romance, how well one performed at an entertainment even affected one's reputation. Precisely because the line between amusement and cultivation was thin, their games still have a splendor that draws people in. Those who clung too much to winning or losing are said to have been shunned as boorish.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「遊びに興じる／談笑に興じる」。楽しみに熱中する書き言葉的な動詞。
cards.enTarget: The Heian nobles regarded indulging in pastimes such as poem contests and shell-matching games as part of their cultivation.

words.defJa: 色や雰囲気が明るくあでやかなさま

cards.ja: SNSの世界って、みんなすごく華やかに見えるじゃないですか。でもあれは、一番いい瞬間だけを丁寧に切り取って加工した映像にすぎないんですよね。裏では地味で退屈な作業が積み重なっているのに、見る側はつい自分の何気ない日常と比べて落ち込んでしまう。他人の最高の瞬間と自分の日常を比べるのは、そもそも無茶な話です。比べるなら、昨日の自分とにしたほうが、よっぽど心が軽くなりますよ。
cards.en: In the world of social media, everyone looks incredibly glamorous, doesn't it? But that is nothing more than footage that cut out only the best moments. Behind the scenes, plain work piles up, yet viewers can't help comparing it with their own daily lives and feeling down. Comparing someone else's best moment with your own everyday life is, to begin with, an unreasonable thing to do. If you must compare, do it with yourself of yesterday, and your heart will feel far lighter.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: えるじゃないですか。でもあれは、
にすぎないんですよね。
とにしたほうが、よっぽど
cards.tipJa: 「華やかな世界／華やかに見える」。見た目の明るさや表舞台のきらびやかさを言う。
cards.enTarget: In the world of social media, everyone looks incredibly glamorous, doesn't it?

words.defJa: 張りつめたものをゆるくする

cards.ja: 説法の名人は、話の途中でたいてい一度、速度を緩める。インドの古い問答でも、師は弟子の質問に無言のまま間を置いたと伝えられる。聞き手はその間に、自分の内側で言葉を反芻できる。話し手の技術とは、語ることに限らず、語らない時間をどう設計するかにあるのだ。優れた説法者の多くは、聴衆が眠そうになると声を落として語り直すが、それは計算された技術であり、同時に聞き手への思いやりでもある。
cards.en: A master of preaching usually slows down once in the middle of the talk. In old Indian dialogues too, the teacher is said to have left a pause, silent, in answer to a disciple's question. During that pause the listener can turn the words over inside. A speaker's skill lies not only in speaking but in how one designs the time when one does not speak. Many fine preachers lower their voices and retell a point when the audience grows sleepy, which is both a calculated technique and a consideration for the listener.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「速度を緩める／気を緩める」のように、勢いや緊張を弱める意味で使う。
cards.enTarget: A master of preaching usually slows down once in the middle of the talk.

words.defJa: 集団をまとめて率いること

cards.ja: 勉強会を長続きさせるコツは、統率力のあるリーダーを置くことではないと言われる。むしろ全員が少しずつ司会を務める仕組みのほうが、参加者の当事者意識と結束を育てやすい。役割を持った人ほど、課題に粘り強く取り組む傾向があるとも言われる。ただし、誰も舵を取らない会は、最初の熱が冷めたとたんに自然消滅しかねない。リーダーの役目は、答えを与えることより、問いを交わす場を整えることにあるのではないか。
cards.en: It is said that the secret to keeping a study group going is not to install a leader with strong command. A setup in which everyone takes a turn as moderator tends to build participants' sense of ownership and solidarity more easily. It is also said that people given a role tend to tackle tasks more persistently. However, a group in which no one takes the helm may fade away the moment the first heat cools. Perhaps a leader's role lies not in giving answers but in preparing a place where questions can be exchanged.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: しかねない。リーダーの
えることにあるのではないか。
cards.tipJa: 「統率力／統率を取る」の形で、リーダーが集団を動かす力を言う。
cards.enTarget: It is said that the secret to keeping a study group going is not to install a leader with strong command.

words.defJa: 美しく見せるために飾ること

cards.ja: 文章に装飾を加えすぎると、内容を覆い隠してしまうことがある。形容詞を重ねるあまり、読む人は肝心の主張を見失い、結局何が言いたいのか自分でもわからなくなる。文章を練る人は、飾りを足す前に、削れるものをすべて削る。俳句がわずか十七音で季節も感情も伝えられるのは、言葉を極限まで削ぎ落とし、残った一語一語に意味を託しているからだ。読点の位置ひとつで、印象は驚くほど変わる。
cards.en: Adding too much ornament to prose can end up covering its content. In piling up adjectives, readers lose sight of the essential claim and end up unsure what is being said. Those who polish their writing cut everything that can be cut before adding decoration. A haiku can convey both season and feeling in a mere seventeen syllables because it pares words to the extreme and entrusts meaning to each remaining word. The impression changes startlingly with the position of a single comma.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: してしまうことがある。
cards.tipJa: 「装飾を施す／装飾的な文体」。実用でなく見栄えを整える飾りを言う。
cards.enTarget: Adding too much ornament to prose can end up covering its content.

words.defJa: 努力や思いが形になった成果

cards.ja: 十八世紀の初め、ドイツのベトガーは欧州で初めて硬質の磁器を焼くことに成功した。それまで王侯貴族は、東洋から運ばれる白い焼き物に大金を払い続けていたのである。錬金術で金を作れと命じられた男が、試みを重ねた末にたどり着いたのが、皮肉にも磁器だった。挫折と執念の結晶であるその白い器は、のちにマイセン窯の繁栄を生んだ。ヨーロッパの食卓の風景は、この発見を境に少しずつ一変していった。
cards.en: In the early eighteenth century, Böttger in Germany became the first in Europe to succeed in firing hard porcelain. Until then, kings and nobles had kept paying large sums for white wares shipped from the East. The man who was ordered to make gold through alchemy arrived, after repeated attempts, at porcelain, ironically enough. That white ware, the crystallization of failure and obsession, later produced the prosperity of the Meissen kilns. The scenery of European dining tables gradually changed completely after this discovery.
