ししました。しかし、フランス
cards.tipJa: 「理性的な判断・議論」。感情的の対義。「感情的」との対で覚える。
cards.enTarget: As the Enlightenment spread across eighteenth-century Europe, expectations rose that humans could free themselves from superstition and authority if only they thought rationally.

words.meaning: to dry up; to run dry
words.defJa: 水がなくなって乾く

cards.ja: インド西部のラージャスターン州では、雨季の降水量が少なかった年に村の井戸が涸れ、住民が数キロ先まで水を汲みに行く事態が相次いだ。地下水の過剰なくみ上げが背景にあると、研究者は指摘している。州政府筋によると、給水車を手配する一方で、伝統的な貯水池の復元にも乗り出したという。ただ、気候の変動が続けば、これだけでは追いつかない恐れがある。水をめぐる不安は、いまや農村だけの問題ではなくなりつつある。
cards.en: In years of weak monsoon rainfall in Rajasthan, in western India, village wells ran dry and a string of incidents saw residents walking several kilometers to fetch water. Researchers point to excessive groundwater pumping as part of the background. According to sources in the state government, it is arranging water tankers while also setting out to restore traditional reservoirs. Still, if climate variability continues, this alone may not keep up. Anxiety over water is no longer a problem only for farming villages.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: ではなくなりつつある。
cards.tipJa: 井戸・川・泉・涙が「涸れる」。水源が尽きるときに使う。「枯れる」とは別字。
cards.enTarget: In years of weak monsoon rainfall in Rajasthan, in western India, village wells ran dry and a string of incidents saw residents walking several kilometers to fetch water.

words.defJa: 勢いを失って絶える

cards.ja: 『平家物語』の書き出しは、わずか数行で一族の栄華と没落を見通してしまう。「おごれる人も久しからず、ただ春の夜の夢のごとし」という調べは、琵琶法師の語りに乗って広まった。栄えた者もいつかは滅ぶ、という結論を最初に置くことで、聞き手は結末を知りながらも、一人ひとりの最期に耳を傾けることができる。語りが生き生きと伝わるのは、この型がもたらす独特の緊張感のおかげだろう。
cards.en: In just a few lines, the opening of the Tale of the Heike sees through a clan's glory and fall. The cadence of "the proud do not last, they are but a dream on a spring night" spread on the tellings of the biwa-playing minstrels. By placing the conclusion first, that those who flourish will one day perish, the listener can attend to each person's end even while knowing the outcome. The story comes across so vividly thanks to the tension this form creates.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 国・文明・種が「滅ぶ」。「滅びる」の古めかしい形で、語りや文章に合う。
cards.enTarget: By placing the conclusion first, that those who flourish will one day perish, the listener can attend to each person's end even while knowing the outcome.

words.defJa: 抜け出しにくい深いぬかるみ。比喩では悪い状態

cards.ja: 釈迦の時代のインドでは、魂の正体をめぐって終わりのない論争が続いていました。ところが仏陀は、その議論に深入りしようとしません。毒矢のたとえは、そうした態度を読み解く手がかりになります。矢を射た人の名前を突き止めてからでないと抜かないと言い張れば、議論の泥沼にはまったまま命を落とすでしょう。答えの出ない問いに頭を悩ませるより、目の前の苦しみを取り除くことが先なのです。
cards.en: In the Buddha's India, endless debates over the true nature of the soul went on. Yet the Buddha refused to get drawn into them. The parable of the poisoned arrow is a key to understanding that attitude. If a man insists on learning the name of whoever shot him before he lets anyone pull the arrow out, he will die still stuck in the quagmire of argument. Removing the suffering in front of you comes before racking your brain over a question that has no answer.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: いていました。ところが
cards.tipJa: 「泥沼にはまる」は議論や争いが抜け出せなくなる比喩の定番。
cards.sense: 比喩：抜け出せない悪い状況
cards.enTarget: If a man insists on learning the name of whoever shot him before he lets anyone pull the arrow out, he will die still stuck in the quagmire of argument.

words.defJa: 目を見張るほど立派なさま

cards.ja: 子どもの言語習得の速さには、目覚ましいものがあります。三歳の子は、教えられた覚えのない文法を、いつの間にか使いこなしていますよね。ある言語学者は、人間には言葉を身につける仕組みが生まれつき備わっていると考えました。一方で、大人がゼロから外国語を学ぶには、懸命な努力と何度もの反復が欠かせません。この差をどう理解するかが、いま学習研究の大きなテーマの一つなんです。
cards.en: The speed at which children acquire language is remarkable. A three-year-old uses, before you know it, grammar nobody remembers teaching them, right? One linguist thought humans are born equipped with a mechanism for acquiring language. On the other hand, an adult learning a foreign language from zero cannot do without earnest effort and repetition. How to understand this difference is one of the big themes of learning research.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: いこなしていますよね。ある
cards.tipJa: 「目覚ましい成長・発展・活躍」。進歩や成果が目を引くほど大きいときに使う。
cards.enTarget: The speed at which children acquire language is remarkable.

words.defJa: 体や心に苦痛を与える

cards.ja: 人手不足のなか、新入社員が早期に辞めてしまう問題に頭を痛める企業が増えている。人材業界では、採用の場で理想を語りすぎて、入社後の落差が大きくなることが一因だと指摘されている。企業側が仕事の厳しさを率直に伝えれば、ミスマッチは減らせるという見方もある。ただ、その手間を惜しんで放置すれば、せっかく時間と費用をかけて採用した若手が数か月で去る例が、今後も後を絶たない恐れがある。
cards.en: Amid labor shortages, a growing number of companies are racking their brains over new hires quitting early. In the staffing industry, it is pointed out that painting too rosy a picture at hiring widens the gap after joining. Some also take the view that if companies tell candidates frankly how demanding the job is, mismatches can be reduced. But if they skimp on that effort and neglect it, there is a risk that cases of hard-won young hires leaving within months will keep occurring.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「頭を痛める」「心を痛める」は悩むこと。「腰を痛める」は体の故障。
cards.sense: 悩む（頭・心を痛める）
cards.enTarget: Amid labor shortages, a growing number of companies are racking their brains over new hires quitting early.

words.defJa: 地味で深みがあるさま。舌を締めつける味

cards.ja: 「渋い」はもともと、柿の未熟な実を口にしたときの舌を締めつける味を指す言葉だった。そこから転じて、派手さはないが深みのある趣を褒める意味が生まれた。年配の俳優や古い喫茶店に使えば褒め言葉になるが、財布の紐が固い人に向ければ、不満を含んだ表現になる。同じ語でも、向ける相手次第で評価が正反対になるのが興味深い。舌の記憶が、そのまま美意識の言葉になったと考えると、日本語の感覚の鋭さに驚かされる。
cards.en: Shibui originally meant the mouth-puckering taste of an unripe persimmon. From there it came to praise a look that is not flashy but has depth. Used of an elderly actor or an old coffee shop it is a compliment, but aimed at someone tight with money it becomes an expression with some grievance in it. It is interesting that the same word can be judged in opposite ways depending on whom it is aimed at. Realizing that a memory on the tongue became, as it was, a word of aesthetics, one is struck by the sharpness of the Japanese sense.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 味から趣の評価へ。「渋い声・渋い趣味」は褒め、「渋い顔」は不機嫌。
cards.sense: 地味で趣がある（褒め言葉）
cards.enTarget: Shibui originally meant the mouth-puckering taste of an unripe persimmon.

words.defJa: 乱れたものを元の良い状態に戻す

cards.ja: 大きな失敗のあとに気持ちを立て直す力は、心理学でレジリエンスと呼ばれ、企業の研修でも取り上げられるようになった。落ち込まない人が強いのではなく、落ち込んだあとの戻り方を知っている人が強い、というのが基本的な考え方だ。具体的には、起きたことを事実と解釈に分ける一方で、次の一手を小さく決めることが有効とされる。慌てて前向きになろうとするより、まず休むことを自分に許す姿勢が、結果として回復を早めるという。
cards.en: The ability to regroup emotionally after a big failure is called resilience in psychology and has come to be taken up in corporate training. The basic idea is that the strong are not those who never get down but those who know how to come back after being down. Concretely, it is considered effective to separate what happened into fact and interpretation while deciding the next move in small terms. An attitude of first allowing yourself rest, rather than rushing to be positive, is said to speed recovery as a result.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: げられるようになった。
きになろうとするより、まず
cards.tipJa: 「経営・体制・生活を立て直す」。崩れた状態を元の良い状態に整える。
cards.enTarget: The ability to regroup emotionally after a big failure is called resilience in psychology and has come to be taken up in corporate training.

words.defJa: 何の制限もつけないこと

cards.ja: 日本の降伏って、よく「無条件降伏」って言われるじゃないですか。でもポツダム宣言をよく読むと、条件がないのは軍隊の降伏のほうで、国そのものについては、占領や軍国主義の除去といった条件がちゃんとついているんですよ。だから当時の政府は、慌ただしい数日のあいだ、天皇の地位が守られるのかをめぐって揉めたんです。言葉のうえでは単純でも、中身はかなり込み入った交渉だったんです。
cards.en: Japan's surrender is often called an unconditional surrender, isn't it? But if you read the Potsdam Declaration closely, only the surrender of the armed forces is without terms, and for the country itself there are properly attached conditions such as occupation and the removal of militarism. That's why the government of the day, over a few frantic days, wrangled about whether the Emperor's position would be protected. The words are simple, but in substance it was a quite tangled negotiation.

がちゃんとついているんですよ。だから
られるのかをめぐって

cards.enTarget: Japan's surrender is often called an unconditional surrender, isn't it?

words.defJa: 項目を一つずつ並べて書くこと

cards.ja: 会議の資料づくりで箇条書きは便利だが、使い方を誤ると、文章のいちばん大事な部分が失われる。項目を並べるだけでは、なぜその順序なのか、前の項目とどうつながるのかが伝わらないからだ。話し言葉で説明するときは、各項目を「だから」「ところが」でつなぎ直すに越したことはない。つなぎ目にこそ論理があり、話の焦点もまさにそこにある。聞き手が本当に知りたいのも、結局はそこである。
cards.en: Bullet points are handy in making materials, but if used wrongly they lose the most important part of the writing. Just lining up items does not convey why they are in that order or how each connects to the one before. When explaining in spoken language, it never hurts to reconnect each item with words like so and but. The logic lies in the joints, and so does the focus of the talk. That is also what the listener ultimately wants to know.

cards.enTarget: Bullet points are handy in making materials, but if used wrongly they lose the most important part of the writing.

words.defJa: 事実を見届けて語る人。また、見守る意識。

cards.ja: 本番で頭が真っ白になりそうなとき、有効なのは、感情から距離を置いて眺めるもうひとりの自分をつくることだ。インド哲学のアドヴァイタでは、心の動きをただ見ている意識を、証人と呼ぶ伝統がある。心拍が上がり、手が冷たくなっているなと、他人事かのように実況するだけで、緊張に飲まれにくくなる。試験会場でも一度試してみる価値はあるし、練習を重ねるほど、切り替えは速くなっていく。
cards.en: When you are about to go blank in a high-stakes moment, what works is creating another self who watches from a distance from your emotions. In Indian philosophy's Advaita, there is a tradition of calling the awareness that simply watches the movements of the mind the witness. Just by narrating as if it were someone else's matter that your heart rate is rising and your hands are getting cold, you become harder to swallow up in tension. It is worth trying once even at the exam venue, and the more you practice, the faster the switch becomes.

cards.sense: 見守る意識の意
cards.enTarget: In Indian philosophy's Advaita, there is a tradition of calling the awareness that simply watches the movements of the mind the witness.

words.defJa: 順位や成績などが下がる。

cards.ja: 二〇一八年に行われた国際学力調査で、日本の高校生の読解力の順位は、前回の八位から十五位へと大きく落ちた。長い文章を読み解き、根拠を示して自分の意見を述べる力に課題があると分析された。この結果を受けて、国語教育の在り方をめぐる議論が各方面で相次いだ。もっとも、順位の上下だけで学力の良し悪しを断じるべきではなく、何がどう変わったのかを丁寧に解説する報道が望まれる。
cards.en: In the 2018 international assessment, the ranking of Japanese high school students in reading comprehension fell sharply from eighth in the previous round to fifteenth. It was analyzed that there were problems in their ability to read long texts closely and state their own opinions while showing grounds. Following this result, debate over the way Japanese-language education should be conducted came one after another. That said, one should not pass judgment on academic ability by the ranking alone, and reporting that carefully explains what changed and how is desirable.

cards.sense: 水準が下がる意
cards.enTarget: In the 2018 international assessment, the ranking of Japanese high school students in reading comprehension fell sharply from eighth in the previous round to fifteenth.

words.defJa: 二つの場所や物の間のへだたり。

cards.ja: 人工知能の計算拠点をどこに置くかは、いまや地理の問題でもある。通信の遅れは、データが走る距離にほぼ比例して増えるため、自動運転のように瞬時の判断が必要な用途では、拠点が遠いと致命的になりかねない。そこで、利用者に近い場所に小さな計算拠点を分散させる動きが広がっている。もっとも、拠点を増やせば電力や冷却の負担も増えるため、建設の費用を慎重に見積もる必要がある。
cards.en: Where to put AI computing sites is now also a question of geography. Communication delay grows roughly in proportion to the distance data travels, so for uses that need instant decisions, like self-driving, a distant site could prove fatal. So a movement to spread small computing sites in places close to users is spreading. However, more sites mean more burden of electric power and cooling, so the construction cost must be carefully estimated.

cards.enTarget: Communication delay grows roughly in proportion to the distance data travels, so for uses that need instant decisions, like self-driving, a distant site could prove fatal.

words.defJa: 野山や庭に咲く草や花。

cards.ja: スマートフォンで道端の草花を撮ると、その名前を教えてくれるアプリがある。画像認識の人工知能が、人の視力では見分けにくい葉脈の模様まで手がかりに、膨大な写真と照らし合わせて種類を判定する仕組みだ。散歩の楽しみが増える反面、毒のある植物を食べられるものと取り違える恐れもあるため、命に関わる場面では過信は禁物である。ちなみに、こうした技術を支えているのは、半導体の計算能力だ。
cards.en: There is an app that tells you the name when you photograph a roadside wildflower with your smartphone. It works by an image-recognition AI judging the species, using even vein patterns that are hard to tell apart with human eyesight as clues and checking them against a huge number of photographs. While it adds to the pleasure of walks, it may also mistake a poisonous plant for an edible one, so overreliance is taboo where life is at stake. Incidentally, what supports this technology is the computing power of semiconductors.

cards.enTarget: There is an app that tells you the name when you photograph a roadside wildflower with your smartphone.

words.defJa: 問題や関係がなくなること。

cards.ja: ストレスを解消しようと、がんばって無計画に遊んだのに、かえって疲れたって経験、ありませんか。インド哲学でいうと、それは欲を満たして苦しみをなくそうとする試みで、原理的に終わりがないんですよね。仏教でも渇愛が苦のもとだって言うじゃないですか。だから、つぶすんじゃなくて、いったん手放してみるのが近道なんですよ。ぼくも、予定を詰めこむ休日をやめてから、ずいぶん楽になりました。
cards.en: Have you ever tried hard to relieve stress by playing around with no plan, and ended up even more tired? In Indian philosophy terms, that is an attempt to satisfy desire and get rid of suffering, and in principle it never ends. Even in Buddhism they say craving is the root of suffering, don't they? So instead of crushing it, letting go of it for a while is the shortcut. I too have felt much better since I stopped cramming my days off with plans.

cards.enTarget: Have you ever tried hard to relieve stress by playing around with no plan, and ended up even more tired?

words.defJa: 植物がよく育つように土に与えるもの。

cards.ja: 学習を畑にたとえるなら、新しい単語は種で、復習は肥料にあたる。種ばかりまいて何も与えなければ、芽はすぐに枯れてしまう。多くの学習者は、教材を買い足したり解説動画を見たりすることには熱心だが、同じ単語を間隔をあけて見直すことをおろそかにしがちだ。毎日とは言わないまでも、せめて数日おきに見直す予定を先に決めておこう。忘却曲線が示すように、記憶は放っておけば急速に落ちていくのだから。
cards.en: If you compare study to a field, new words are the seeds and review is the fertilizer. If you only sow seeds and give them nothing, the sprouts wither quickly. Many learners are keen on buying more materials and watching explanation videos, but tend to neglect going back over the same words at intervals. If not every day, then at least decide in advance on a schedule to review every few days. As the forgetting curve shows, memory declines rapidly if left alone.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: すことをおろそかにしがちだ。
cards.tipJa: 「肥料をやる」「化学肥料」のように、育てるための養分を指す。比喩にもなる。
cards.enTarget: If you compare study to a field, new words are the seeds and review is the fertilizer.

words.defJa: 英語を話す人が多い国や地域。

cards.ja: インド英語を初めて聞くと、ほかの英語圏の国の発音との違いに驚く人が多い。音節を均等に刻むリズムや、舌を反らせる子音など、特徴がはっきりしているからだ。訛りがあるからといって、通じないわけではない。むしろ発音を直そうと躍起になるより、自分の言葉で最後まで率直に話し切るほうが、聞き手にはずっと伝わる。話し方を磨くとは、完璧な発音を目指すことではなく、相手に届ける力を鍛える営みではないだろうか。
cards.en: When people hear Indian English for the first time, many are surprised by how it differs from the pronunciation of other English-speaking countries. Its features are clear, such as a rhythm that clips syllables evenly and consonants pronounced with the tongue curled back. Having an accent does not mean you cannot be understood. Rather than frantically trying to fix your pronunciation, speaking all the way through, frankly, in your own words reaches listeners far better. Isn't polishing the way you speak not about aiming at perfect pronunciation but about training the power to get through to the other person?

りがあるからといって、

cards.tipJa: 「英語圏の国」のように、「圏」は言語や文化が共通する範囲を表す。
cards.enTarget: When people hear Indian English for the first time, many are surprised by how it differs from the pronunciation of other English-speaking countries.

words.defJa: 国の免許を持つ料理の専門家。

cards.ja: 知り合いの調理師が言ってたんですけど、人工知能が考えたレシピって、理屈では合ってるのに、どこか味に奥行きがないらしいんです。火加減とか塩の当て方とか、その日の素材の状態に合わせて直す手が、機械にはまだ真似できないんでしょうね。逆に、献立を考えるところでは、冷蔵庫の中身から案を出してくれるので助かるそうです。ただ、道具としては大歓迎だけど、味を決めるのはあくまで人間だ、というのが彼の言い分でした。僕も、それはそうだなと思いました。
cards.en: An acquaintance who is a licensed cook told me that recipes an AI comes up with are logically correct but somehow lack depth of flavor. Machines probably still can't imitate the hand that adjusts to the day's ingredients, like the heat or how salt is applied. On the other hand, in planning a menu it apparently helps because it offers ideas from what's in the fridge. But he welcomes it as a tool, and it's the human who decides the taste, was his view. I thought so too.

できないんでしょうね。

cards.enTarget: An acquaintance who is a licensed cook told me that recipes an AI comes up with are logically correct but somehow lack depth of flavor.

words.defJa: 液体を熱して、出てきた蒸気を冷やして集めること。

cards.ja: 大きな人工知能が持つ知識を、小さなモデルに受け渡す手法を、蒸留と呼ぶ。先生役の大きなモデルの出力を手本にして、生徒役の小さなモデルが学ぶ仕組みである。これにより、性能をあまり落とすことなく、スマートフォンでも動く軽さが実現できる。もとは化学で、沸点の違いを利用して液体から成分を取り出す操作のことだが、知識の濃度だけを抜き出すという意味では、よくぞ名づけたものだ。
cards.en: The technique of handing the knowledge of a large AI over to a small model is called distillation. It is a mechanism in which a small student model learns by taking the output of a large teacher model as its example. This makes it possible to achieve a lightness that runs even on a smartphone without lowering performance much. The term originally refers to the chemical operation of extracting components from a liquid by exploiting differences in boiling point, and in the sense of extracting only the concentration of knowledge, it was a fine name.

cards.enTarget: The technique of handing the knowledge of a large AI over to a small model is called distillation.

words.defJa: 災難や損害を受けた人。

cards.ja: 人工知能で本人そっくりの声をつくり、家族を装って金を振り込ませる詐欺が、各国で報告されている。被害者の多くは、電話口の声が本物だと信じ込み、疑う間もなく指示に従ってしまったという。声は、わずか数秒の録音からでも再現できるとされ、聞き分けるのは容易ではない。対策として、合言葉をあらかじめ家族で決めておき、不審な電話は自ら本人にかけ直して確かめる方法が知られている。技術の進歩に伴って、被害の手口も巧妙になる一方だ。
cards.en: Scams in which people use AI to make a voice just like a real person's and, posing as a family member, get money wired to them have been reported in several countries. Many victims believed the voice on the phone was real and followed the instructions before they had time to doubt. A voice is said to be reproducible from a recording of just a few seconds, so telling it apart by ear is not easy. As a countermeasure, a method is known of deciding on a password within the family in advance and calling the person back yourself to check on a suspicious call. As technology advances, the methods of harm are only growing more sophisticated.

cards.tipJa: 「事件の被害者」「被害者になる」のように、加害者の反対側を言う。
cards.enTarget: Many victims believed the voice on the phone was real and followed the instructions before they had time to doubt.

words.meaning: to happen to see, to spot
words.defJa: ふと目にする。

cards.ja: ほんの十年ほど前には、街で自動運転の車を見かけることなど考えられなかった。いまでは試験走行の車両が、ふつうの道路を、ほかの車に混じって静かに走っている地域もある。慣れというものは、どんな特殊な出来事も日常に変えてしまう。しかし、驚かなくなったからといって、その技術の意味が小さくなったわけではない。むしろ、日常に溶け込んだときこそ、社会が真に変わった証拠である。
cards.en: Only a decade or so ago, spotting a self-driving car in town was unthinkable. Now in some areas test vehicles run quietly on ordinary roads, mixed in with other cars. Habit turns any unusual event into the everyday. But the fact that we are no longer surprised does not mean the significance of the technology has shrunk. Rather, it is just when it has blended into daily life that society has truly changed.

cards.enTarget: Only a decade or so ago, spotting a self-driving car in town was unthinkable.

words.defJa: 医者が患者を診る部屋。

cards.ja: 診察室に入ると、緊張して言いたいことの半分も言えずに終わった、という経験はないだろうか。限られた時間で伝えるには、症状がいつから、どこが、どの程度かを、順に整理して率直に話すのがコツである。メモを手に持っていくだけでも、ずいぶん違う。近ごろは、人工知能が事前に問診を取り、要点をまとめて医師に届ける試みも始まっている。とはいえ、不安な気持ちを言葉にする最後の一歩は、やはり本人の生の声でなければ伝わらない。
cards.en: Haven't you ever walked into the examination room and ended up unable to say even half of what you wanted because of nerves? To communicate in limited time, the knack is to organize the symptoms in order, since when, where, and to what degree, and tell them frankly. Just carrying a note in your hand makes quite a difference. Recently, attempts have also begun in which AI takes the medical history beforehand and passes the key points to the doctor. Even so, the last step of putting an anxious feeling into words is not conveyed unless it is in the patient's own live voice.

cards.enTarget: Haven't you ever walked into the examination room and ended up unable to say even half of what you wanted because of nerves?

words.defJa: ものを見る目の力。

cards.ja: 人間の視力は、見つめている中心ではとても鋭く、周辺ではぼやけています。それでも全体が鮮明に見えている気がするのは、目を絶えず動かして、脳が情報をつなぎ合わせているからです。話し手の視線も同じで、一点に固定することなく、会場を見渡しながら人から人へ移していくと、聞き手は「自分に話してくれている」と感じます。機械の画像認識を磨く研究者たちも、人の目の動きから多くを学んでいるそうです。
cards.en: Human eyesight is very sharp at the center you are gazing at and blurry in the periphery. Even so, the reason it feels as if the whole scene is clear is that the brain stitches information together while the eyes move constantly. A speaker's gaze is the same: if you move it from person to person across the venue without fixing it on one spot, listeners feel that you are speaking to them. Researchers who refine machine image recognition are said to be learning a lot from the movements of the human eye as well.

cards.tipJa: 「視力が落ちる」「視力検査」のように、目で見る力の強さを言う。
cards.enTarget: Human eyesight is very sharp at the center you are gazing at and blurry in the periphery.

words.defJa: 機械が間違って動くこと。

cards.ja: 危険がないのに強い恐怖が湧く、いわゆるパニック発作は、脳の警報装置が誤作動を起こした状態にたとえられることがある。扁桃体と呼ばれる部位が、わずかな刺激を命の危機と受け取り、心拍や呼吸を一気に高めるという。もっとも、これはあくまで単純化した説明で、実際の仕組みはまだ解明の途上にある。症状を恐れるあまり外出を避けるようになると、かえって回復が遠のくため、早めに診察室を訪ねて相談することが勧められている。
cards.en: Panic attacks, in which intense fear wells up though there is no danger, are sometimes likened to a state in which the brain's alarm system has malfunctioned. A region called the amygdala is said to take a slight stimulus for a mortal threat and suddenly raise heart rate and breathing. That said, this is only a simplified explanation, and the actual mechanism is still on its way to being worked out. If you start avoiding going out out of fear of the symptoms, recovery recedes all the more, so visiting an examination room early to consult is recommended.

cards.enTarget: Panic attacks, in which intense fear wells up though there is no danger, are sometimes likened to a state in which the brain's alarm system has malfunctioned.

words.defJa: 本当の様子とちがう姿に見せかける。

cards.ja: 「大丈夫です」という一言は、日本語の中でもとりわけ意味の幅が広い。本当に問題がない場合もあれば、平静を装っているだけの場合もある。どちらなのかは、表情や言動、語尾の弱さ、間の取り方といった周辺の情報から判断するしかない。文字面だけを読む機械には荷が重い仕事だが、人間とて、疲れているときには見誤るものである。だからこそ、相手の様子を見ながら、もう一言だけ添える気づかいが欠かせない。
cards.en: The phrase I'm fine has an especially wide range of meaning even within Japanese. Sometimes there really is no problem, and sometimes the person is merely feigning calm. Which it is, you can only judge from surrounding information such as facial expression and behavior, the weakness of the sentence ending, and the way pauses are placed. It is a job too heavy for a machine that reads only the surface of the text, but humans too misjudge when they are tired. That is exactly why the consideration of watching the other person and adding one more word is indispensable.

cards.enTarget: Sometimes there really is no problem, and sometimes the person is merely feigning calm.

words.defJa: 前もって、おおよその数や費用を計算する。

cards.ja: 翻訳の仕事を請け負うとき、いちばん難しいのは費用を見積もることだと聞く。原文の分量は文字数で測定できても、訳しにくさは読んでみるまで分からないからだ。小説にしろ契約書にしろ、同じ千字でも必要な時間はまるで違い、一行に半日かかることさえある。言葉の手応えを前もって読み取る勘こそが、翻訳者の経験の正体なのかもしれない。それは、辞書には載っていない種類の知識である。
cards.en: When taking on translation work, the hardest thing, I hear, is to estimate the cost. Even if the volume of the source text can be measured in characters, how hard it is to translate is not known until you read it. Whether a novel or a contract, the time required for the same thousand characters is completely different, and a single line can even take half a day. That knack for sensing a text's resistance in advance may be what translators' experience really is. It is a kind of knowledge that is not in the dictionary.

cards.tipJa: 「費用を見積もる」「甘く見積もる」のように、数量や程度を前もって見当づける。
cards.enTarget: When taking on translation work, the hardest thing, I hear, is to estimate the cost.

words.defJa: ためしにやってみること。

cards.ja: 新しい習慣をつくるとき、完璧な計画から入る人って、たいてい三日坊主で終わっちゃうじゃないですか。計画があるに越したことはないんですけど、それより、まず小さく試行してみて、うまくいかなかったらやり方を変えるくらいの軽さのほうが続くんですよね。僕も起床時刻を、最初は十分だけ早めて、そこから少しずつ動かしました。失敗は失敗じゃなくて、次の設計に使うデータなんだと思えるようになると、気持ちがだいぶ楽になります。
cards.en: When you build a new habit, people who start from a perfect plan usually end up quitting in three days, don't they? It's best to have a plan, of course, but what lasts is the lightness of first trying something small and changing the approach if it doesn't work. I too moved my wake-up time earlier by just ten minutes at first, then shifted it bit by bit from there. Once you can see failure not as failure but as data to use in the next design, you feel a lot better.

cards.enTarget: It's best to have a plan, of course, but what lasts is the lightness of first trying something small and changing the approach if it doesn't work.

words.defJa: 世間に向けた建前の面。

cards.ja: インドの憲法は、独立から間もない一九五〇年に施行され、不可触民制を禁じた。表向きには、生まれによる差別はもう存在しないことになっている。ところが、結婚相手の選び方や共同の井戸の使い方など、日常のあちこちに見えない線がいまも残っているとされる。法律で禁じたからといって、差別が解消するとは限らない、という教訓は、世界のどの国にも、もちろん日本にも当てはまるだろう。
cards.en: India's constitution came into force in 1950, not long after independence, and prohibited untouchability. Officially, discrimination by birth is supposed to no longer exist. Yet in daily life, invisible lines are said to remain even now, in how marriage partners are chosen and how shared wells are used. The lesson that prohibiting something by law does not necessarily make discrimination go away probably applies to any country in the world, and of course to Japan as well.

cards.enTarget: Officially, discrimination by birth is supposed to no longer exist.

words.defJa: 口に出す言葉と、おこなう行い。

cards.ja: 人工知能の言動が人間らしく見えるほど、私たちはそこに心を読み取りたくなる。丁寧な言葉づかいで悩みに寄り添われれば、相手が機械だと分かっていても、安らぎを覚えずにはいられない。しかし、その応答は、膨大な文章から学んだ言葉の並べ方の反映にすぎず、感情の裏づけがあるとは限らない。だから、無条件に信じるのも、頭ごなしに退けるのも危うい。にもかかわらず、人間の側の感じ方は、本物かどうかとは別に、確かに存在するのである。
cards.en: The more human an AI's words and conduct look, the more we want to read a mind into them. If it stays by your side in your troubles with polite language, you cannot help feeling comforted even when you know the other party is a machine. But that response is no more than a reflection of how it learned to line up words from a vast amount of text, and it is not necessarily backed by emotion. So both believing it unconditionally and dismissing it out of hand are risky. Nevertheless, the human side's feeling exists for certain, apart from whether it is genuine.

words.defJa: ものしずかで落ち着いているようす

cards.ja: 閑静な住宅街にある学校は、子どもの成績も良いはずだと見られがちだ。だが研究者は、静けさそのものより、家庭の経済力や教育への関心の差が結果に影響している可能性を指摘する。静かな環境が集中を助ける面はあるにしても、それだけで成績が決まるわけではない。環境の印象だけで原因を決めつければ、本当の要因を見落としかねない。数字を読むときは、何が何に影響したのかを一つずつ分けて考える必要がある。
cards.en: Schools in quiet residential neighborhoods tend to be assumed to have children with good grades too. But researchers point out the possibility that differences in family economic power and interest in education, rather than the quiet itself, are affecting the results. Even if a quiet environment helps concentration in some ways, that alone does not decide grades. If you decide a cause on the impression of the environment alone, you may overlook the real factor. When reading numbers, you need to separate what influenced what, one thing at a time.

cards.enTarget: Schools in quiet residential neighborhoods tend to be assumed to have children with good grades too.

words.defJa: 気持ちや笑いが体の奥から強くわき上がる

cards.ja: 外国語で言った冗談に、初めて相手が声を上げて笑ってくれた日のことを覚えています。一日中の会話でぐったりしていたはずなのに、教科書では味わえない喜びが胸の奥から込み上げてきました。そのとき初めて、勉強してきた時間が報われたと思えたのです。言葉が通じるというのは、情報が伝わるのみならず、気持ちが届くことなのだと実感しました。語学が試験の点数だけでは測れない理由は、そこにあります。
cards.en: I remember the day someone first laughed out loud at a joke I made in a foreign language. I should have been worn out from a whole day of conversation, yet a joy you cannot taste from textbooks welled up from deep in my chest. Only then did I feel that the time I had spent studying had been rewarded. Being understood means not only that information gets across, but that feelings arrive. That is why language ability cannot be measured by exam scores alone.

cards.enTarget: I should have been worn out from a whole day of conversation, yet a joy you cannot taste from textbooks welled up from deep in my chest.

words.defJa: 人をやとって仕事をさせること

cards.ja: 翻訳や通訳の仕事は、機械翻訳の進歩で雇用が減るのではないかと長く言われてきた。その不安は、いまも根強い。確かに、旅行案内や商品説明のような定型文は、機械がすでに十分こなしている。しかし契約書や詩、あるいは冗談のように、文脈と意図が複雑にからむ文章では、人間の判断が今も欠かせない。言葉の仕事は消えるのではなく、機械の出した案を見極める仕事へと形を変えつつあるのではないか。
cards.en: It has long been said that employment in translation and interpreting will shrink as machine translation advances. That anxiety remains strong even now. Certainly, formulaic texts like travel guides and product descriptions are already handled well enough by machines. But in writing where context and intent are intricately entangled, such as contracts, poems or jokes, human judgment is still indispensable. Might language work not disappear but be changing into the work of judging the proposals machines produce?

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: えつつあるのではないか。
cards.tipJa: 「雇用が増える・減る」「雇用を守る」のように、経済や労働の文脈で使う。
cards.enTarget: It has long been said that employment in translation and interpreting will shrink as machine translation advances.

words.defJa: お金を受け取ったことを書いて渡す書類

cards.ja: 領収書の「上様」という宛名に、職場で首をかしげた経験のある人は少なくない。本来は宛名を書く手間を省くための慣習で、「お上」のような権威を指すわけではないと説明されることが多い。実際、「上様」と書いておけば、客は名前を告げず、店は書き間違いも避けられるとされる。近年は電子化が進み、紙の書類を出さない店も増えつつある。それでも会計の現場では、言葉の古い習慣が静かに生き残っている。
cards.en: Quite a few people have tilted their heads at the addressee “ue-sama” on a receipt at work. It is often explained that it was originally a custom for saving the trouble of writing a name, and does not refer to an authority like “the Crown.” In practice, writing “ue-sama” is said to spare the customer from giving a name and the shop from making a mistake in writing it. In recent years digitization has advanced, and the number of shops that issue no paper documents is growing. Even so, in accounting practice, old linguistic habits quietly survive.

words.defJa: ふつうの人よりはるかにすぐれた才能の持ち主

cards.ja: 将棋界で「十年に一人の逸材」と呼ばれる少年が現れると、周囲の期待は一気に膨らむ。だが才能の持ち主であれ、盤の前では毎日同じ地道な反復から逃れられない。指導者の間では、伸びる子ほど負けた一局を自らの言葉で説明できると言われる。そのため、才能の見極めは、勝った数よりも、負けたあとにどう盤を振り返るかを見るほうが確かだともされる。天賦の才より、振り返る習慣が成長の差を生むという見方は根強い。
cards.en: When a boy called “a once-in-a-decade talent” appears in the shogi world, the expectations around him swell at once. But however gifted one may be, at the board there is no escaping the same humble repetition every day. Among coaches it is said that the more a child improves, the better he can explain a lost game in his own words. For that reason, in judging talent, it is also said to be more reliable to look at how one reviews the board after a loss than at the number of wins. The view that the habit of looking back, more than innate talent, creates the gap in growth is a persistent one.

cards.enTarget: When a boy called “a once-in-a-decade talent” appears in the shogi world, the expectations around him swell at once.

words.defJa: 複数の人や組織が連絡をとり合い協力すること

cards.ja: 言語学者と脳科学者が連携すると、「なぜ子どもは教わらない文法を使いこなせるのか」という素朴な疑問が急に面白くなります。たとえば幼児は、習ってもいない活用の規則を、いつの間にか使い始めているんですね。脳が言葉の規則を自ら見つけ出しているとしか思えません。実際、近年は言語獲得の研究に、コンピューターによる模擬実験が取り入れられています。分野の壁を越えて話し合ってこそ、見えてくる景色があるのです。
cards.en: When linguists and neuroscientists work together, the simple question “why can children use grammar nobody taught them?” suddenly becomes fascinating. Toddlers, for example, start using conjugation rules they were never taught before you know it. It is hard to think of it as anything other than the brain discovering the rules of language by itself. Indeed, in recent years computer simulation experiments have been brought into research on language acquisition. There are views that only emerge when people talk across the walls between fields.

words.defJa: やっとのことでどうにか、ぎりぎりの状態で

cards.ja: 試験の前の晩、私は三章分も残したまま、辛うじて目を開けているだけでした。ところが翌朝の本番では、夜に読んだ数行がなぜかすらすら出てきたんです。脳は眠っている間に記憶を整理するからこそ、徹夜は逆効果になりかねません。実際、睡眠不足のまま受けた模擬試験では、問題文の読み違いが目立ち、見直しの時間さえ残りませんでした。大事なのは、自ら睡眠まで勉強計画に組み入れることです。
cards.en: The night before the exam, I had three chapters left and was only barely keeping my eyes open. Yet the next morning, during the test itself, the few lines I had read at night somehow came out smoothly. Precisely because the brain organizes memories while we sleep, an all-nighter can easily backfire. In fact, in a mock exam I took short on sleep, misreadings of the questions stood out and I did not even have time left to check my work. What matters is to build sleep itself into your study plan on your own initiative.

words.defJa: 人口が減って地域の人が少なくなっていくこと

cards.ja: インド北部ラダックなど、ヒマラヤの仏教圏の山あいでは、地元に雇用が乏しく、若者が都市へ出ていって村の過疎化が進んでいる。僧院を長く支えてきた村人が少しずつ減り、祭りの担い手も年ごとに足りなくなっている。それでも夏の巡礼や観光の季節になると、谷は人であふれ、暮らしは外から来る旅行者や巡礼者に頼らざるを得ない。村を守ろうとするほど、静けさという財産が削られていく皮肉がある。
cards.en: In the mountain valleys of the Himalayan Buddhist regions such as Ladakh in northern India, local jobs are scarce, young people leave for cities, and the depopulation of villages is advancing. The villagers who have supported the monasteries are fewer, and there are not enough people to carry festivals. Even so, when the season of summer pilgrimage and tourism comes, the valleys overflow with people and livelihoods have no choice but to depend on visitors from outside. There is an irony that the more a village tries to protect itself, the more its quiet, its real asset, is whittled away.

words.defJa: 全体の中で高齢者の割合が増えていくこと

cards.ja: 高齢化という言葉を、数字だけで語ると暗くなります。ところが九十歳で新しい楽器を始めた人の話をすると、聞き手の表情はぱっと明るくなるものです。たとえば、八十代の方が毎朝畑を耕している姿を一言添えるだけで、数字だけでは冷たかった話に体温が宿ります。話し手は、統計と一人の物語を交互に差し出すことで、頭と心の両方に届く文章を組み立てられます。数字は地図、人の話は風景だと考えてみてください。
cards.en: If you talk about population aging with numbers alone, it turns gloomy. Yet when you tell the story of a person who took up a new instrument at ninety, listeners' faces tend to brighten at once. For example, just adding a line about an eighty-something person who tills their field every morning gives warmth to a story that numbers alone left cold. By offering statistics and one person's story in alternation, a speaker can build writing that reaches both head and heart. Think of the numbers as the map and the person's story as the landscape.
